job.title: Material Handler/Inventory Support Specialist
job.description:
Material Handler/Inventory Support Specialist needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s client L3Harris located in Henrietta, NY.


What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Ability to perform all physical and administrative tasks involved in the shipping of orders, both government and commercial orders.
  • Unpacks and checks goods received against purchase orders or invoices, maintains records of received goods, rejecting unsatisfactory items where necessary.
  • Examines stocks and distributes materials in inventory and on production line as requested
  • Packaged products as required for shipment to company’s customers and suppliers
  • Unpacks and checks goods received against purchase orders or invoices, maintains records of received goods, rejecting unsatisfactory items where necessary and work with planner to return to vendor.
  • Distributes materials in inventory and on manufacturing lines.
  • Mechanical Assembly work, read schematics
What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • Previous shipping experience packaging equipment required
  • Previous knowledge of material handling procedures
  • Ability to maintain records associated with shipping orders
  • Must be able to lift a minimum of 30lbs. regularly.
  • 3-5 years’ experience
  • High School Diploma
  • Flexible to work OT and off schedules as needed
  • Must have reliable transportation/ not bus line accessible
  • Pre-Employments Check/Education Verification/ Criminal & Drug Testing

job.title: Assistant Nurse Manager (Onsite in Piscataway, NJ)
job.description:
Assistant Nurse Manager needed for an opportunity with Yoh’s University client located in Piscataway, NJ. The Behavioral Health Care Campus – Adult, Child, and Adolescent Unit is seeking an Assistant Nurse Manager to support Addiction Services. This position is responsible for supervising and coordinating patient care services for an assigned shift/unit. The Assistant Nurse Manager will provide clinical leadership to nursing staff, promote patient safety and quality care, assist with operational issues, serve as a resource regarding policies and standards of practice, and work closely with other members of the interdisciplinary healthcare team.
 
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 3p-11p OR 11p-7a; every other Saturday and Sunday (with 2 days off during the week)
Type: Contract to Hire OR Permanent Placement
Pay: $40-60/hr DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Supervise clinical staff and ensure delivery of quality patient care.
  • Provide clinical leadership and direction during the assigned shift.
  • Serve as a resource to nursing and support staff regarding standards of practice, policies, and procedures.
  • Coordinate with other departments and healthcare professionals to resolve operational and patient-care issues.
  • Complete employee performance appraisals as required.
  • Promote patient safety, quality improvement, and infection prevention.
  • Provide psychiatric nursing support and respond appropriately to medical and psychiatric crises.
  • Assist and coach staff during challenging patient situations.
  • Maintain required nursing licensure, certifications, and professional knowledge.
  • Serve as a role model and resource for new and existing staff.
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Graduate of a state-accredited school of nursing.
  • Previous experience directing or supervising staff.
  • Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the State of New Jersey.
  • Previous Charge Nurse, Clinical Lead, Assistant Nurse Manager, or nursing supervisory experience.
  • Behavioral health, psychiatric nursing, addiction treatment, substance-use disorder, detoxification, or related clinical experience strongly preferred.
What’s In It For You?
  • Join Yoh’s extensive talent community that will provide you with access to Yoh’s vast network of opportunities.
  • Weekends and holidays off
  • Direct deposit & weekly epayroll
 
APPLY NOW!

Clinical Trial Manager
Hybrid (1-2 days onsite)
Greater Boston Area, MA
Contract
Pay Rate $70-80/hr
 
Our client is seeking a Clinical Trial Manager support global clinical studies. 
 
Key Responsibilities:

job.title: EDI Manager
job.description:
Now Hiring: EDI Manager / Architect | McKinney, TX | Direct Hire
Are you passionate about EDI architecture, modern integration technologies and leading technical teams while remaining hands-on?
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for an experienced EDI technical leader to take ownership of enterprise-wide EDI strategy, modernize integration capabilities and help shape a growing engineering organization. This newly created position offers the opportunity to influence architectural decisions, lead a technical team and drive innovation across fulfillment, logistics and partner integrations.
We're looking for someone with:
  • Deep technical expertise in EDI architecture, standards and integration patterns.
  • Fulfillment, logistics and order-to-cash integration experience.
  • Strong Azure, .NET/C#, REST API and cloud-native integration experience.
  • Experience leading, developing and mentoring technical teams.
  • Interest in AI-enabled engineering and emerging integration technologies.
Position Highlights:
  • Direct-hire opportunity
  • McKinney, TX — 4 days onsite per week
  • Base salary: $155K, with potential flexibility depending on experience
  • 10%–20% bonus potential
  • 401(k) with 4% company match
IMPORTANT – APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS:
  • Candidates MUST CURRENTLY reside in the Dallas-Fort Worth area.
  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring employment sponsorship now or in the future.
  • No C2C or third-party candidates.
  • This is not a remote opportunity.
As our client continues to grow and enter new markets, they are investing in their integration capabilities to support business expansion and improve connectivity with customers and trading partners. Their business includes third-party fulfillment services, making experience in distribution, logistics and complex supply chain environments especially valuable.

This newly created position offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future of EDI across the enterprise, modernize existing technologies and build a high-performing technical team.

We are looking for a technically driven EDI leader who enjoys staying close to the technology while managing and mentoring engineers. The ideal candidate brings the architectural expertise to make informed technology decisions, solve complex integration challenges and determine how traditional EDI and modern API solutions can best support evolving business needs.

Key requirements include:
  • Deep specialization in EDI, rather than a general integration manager who happens to have both API and EDI experience.
  • Strong understanding of EDI architecture, integration patterns, and design decisions.
  • Ability to understand where traditional EDI is appropriate versus when an API-based approach makes more sense.
  • Ability to manage integration events and oversee EDI across multiple business verticals.
  • Strong technical leadership. The individual needs to be capable of guiding the team on architecture, technology selection, and appropriate design patterns.
  • Experience with fulfillment and/or logistics integrations is highly desirable.
  • Comfortable working in an Azure environment with .NET and C#.
  • Interest in and enthusiasm for AI and emerging development approaches, including MCP and no-code/low-code software development. The organization is progressive in its adoption of AI.
Leadership Opportunity
The successful candidate will lead an established technical team of approximately 10 professionals, initially consisting primarily of consultants. As the business continues to expand, this individual will have the opportunity to grow the team through permanent hires and influence its long-term structure and technical capabilities.
We welcome experienced EDI Managers as well as EDI Architects who have demonstrated success leading and managing technical teams and are interested in expanding their leadership responsibilities.

What Sets the Ideal Candidate Apart
This opportunity is particularly well suited for a technical leader who has maintained their architectural and engineering expertise throughout their management career. The successful candidate must be comfortable providing technical direction, evaluating integration approaches, making architectural decisions and guiding engineers through complex EDI challenges.

This is not a traditional project or delivery management position. Our client is seeking someone who can effectively balance people leadership with hands-on technical ownership.

The ideal candidate should be able to personally provide technical direction, including:
  • Evaluating architecture and integration approaches
  • Helping determine which technology should be used
  • Selecting appropriate integration and design patterns
  • Guiding developers and consultants through complex EDI decisions
  • Knowing when EDI versus APIs is the right solution
  • Challenging or validating technical recommendations from the team
In short, our client needs someone who can manage the people while still owning the technical direction.

If you're an EDI Architect, EDI Engineering Manager, EDI Integration Manager or hands-on EDI Technical Leader ready to make a meaningful impact, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply today with your updated resume.
#Hiring #EDI #EDIArchitect #EDIManager #Azure #IntegrationArchitecture #APIIntegration #Fulfillment #SupplyChain #EngineeringLeadership #DFWJobs #McKinneyJobs #DallasTech #DirectHire

job.title: FULLTIME Senior Electronics Engineering Technician
job.description:
FULL TIME SENIOR ELECTRONICS ENGINEER 
WOOD DALE ILLINOIS 
NO THIRD PARTY CANDIDATE 
ROLE OVERVIEW
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Senior Electronics Engineering Technician to work directly with our electrical engineers on advanced power electronics development and testing.
This is an engineering laboratory role, not routine production assembly.
The technician will support projects from early prototype hardware through troubleshooting, qualification, validation, and production.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Set up and operate oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, digital multimeters, power supplies, electronic loads, and other laboratory test equipment.
  • Perform electrical and functional testing of power supplies, printed circuit boards, and electronic subsystems.
  • Measure and document switching waveforms, voltage and current characteristics, regulation, ripple, load transient response, and other electrical performance.
  • Support prototype bring-up, system integration, hardware modifications, and circuit troubleshooting.
  • Investigate unexpected test results, isolate likely causes, and communicate findings to engineering.
  • Assemble, modify, solder, desolder, and rework prototype PCB assemblies and test hardware.
  • Research and evaluate replacement electronic components using datasheets, samples, and directed comparison testing.
  • Program micro-controllers using approved firmware supplied by engineering and verify hardware functionality.
  • Build and maintain test fixtures, wiring assemblies, and repeatable laboratory setups.
  • Support EMI/EMC and environmental qualification testing, including applicable MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-810 activities.
  • Maintain accurate records of hardware revisions, firmware versions, test configurations, results, troubleshooting activities, and engineering changes.
  • Prepare technical reports, plots, data tables, and summaries for engineering review.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Approximately 5+ years of significant hands-on electronics development, test, troubleshooting, repair, or similar technical experience.
  • Strong understanding of electronic components, electrical fundamentals, schematics, and analog and digital circuits.
  • Ability to independently set up and use an oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, digital multimeter, power supplies, and similar test equipment.
  • Ability to read schematics, wiring diagrams, and component datasheets.
  • Ability to perform systematic electronic troubleshooting and recognize abnormal circuit behavior.
  • Strong technical documentation and organizational skills.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience troubleshooting switching power supplies, power converters, or other power electronics.
  • Experience with programmable electronic loads, power analyzers, differential probes, current probes, and automated test equipment.
  • PCB soldering and rework experience, including surface-mount and fine-pitch components.
  • Experience with micro-controllers, firmware loading, and functional verification.
  • Experience with MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, EMI/EMC testing, or other electronics qualification work.
  • Experience with LabVIEW, VISA, or computer-controlled test equipment.
COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
Compensation: $75,000-$95,000 per year, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Annual year-end bonus

job.title: Senior Mechanical Technician Billerica, MA
job.description:
Sr. Mechanical Technician Applied Materials | Billerica, MA ? 100% Onsite

Pay Rate: $45.00 per hour
Shift: Monday-Friday | 7:30 AM - 4:00 PM (40 Hours per Week)

Join an Industry Leader in Semiconductor Technology Yoh is seeking a Sr. Mechanical Technician to support our client, Applied Materials, in Billerica, Massachusetts.

Applied Materials is the world's leading provider of materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every advanced semiconductor chip and display in the world. Their technologies power artificial intelligence, cloud computing, smartphones, electric vehicles, medical devices, and countless innovations that shape our daily lives.

If you're an experienced mechanical or electro-mechanical technician looking to work on sophisticated equipment with one of the most respected names in technology manufacturing, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Build, repair, test, and troubleshoot electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies and subassemblies.
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, work orders, and technical instructions.
  • Perform complex electro-mechanical assembly operations and diagnostics.
  • Audit incoming parts and materials to ensure completeness and quality.
  • Utilize electronic measurement equipment, test fixtures, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps.
  • Complete production documentation, labor tracking, and data entry requirements.
  • Support software installations, system repairs, and programming activities as needed.
  • Partner with engineering teams to develop and improve manufacturing processes.
  • Provide training and technical guidance to lower-level technicians.
  • Assist supervisors in coordinating daily production priorities and resources.
  • Serve as a Quality Lead when required and support resolution of customer quality concerns.
  • Recommend improvements to manufacturing processes, equipment, and product designs.
Qualifications Required
  • Mechanical, electro-mechanical, manufacturing, or semiconductor equipment experience.
  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and assembly instructions.
  • Experience working with precision tools, measurement equipment, and testing devices.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work onsite in Billerica, MA.
Preferred
  • Semiconductor industry experience.
  • Vacuum systems knowledge.
  • Electro-mechanical assembly experience.
  • Experience supporting engineering teams and production environments.
  • Leadership or mentoring experience.
Why Applied Materials? Work on Technology That Matters At Applied Materials, you'll contribute to the equipment used to manufacture the world's most advanced semiconductor chips.

Benefits of working with Applied Materials include:

? Exposure to cutting-edge semiconductor technology

? Experience with advanced electro-mechanical and vacuum systems

? Opportunity to collaborate with world-class engineers and technical experts

? Build highly marketable skills in one of the fastest-growing industries in the world

? Gain experience with innovative products used throughout the global technology sector

? Work in a safety-focused, team-oriented environment that values continuous improvement

Why Work Through Yoh? For more than 80 years, Yoh has connected talented professionals with industry-leading employers.

When you work with Yoh, you gain:

? Weekly pay

? 401(k) program eligibility

? Referral bonus opportunities

? Dedicated recruiter support

? Access to exclusive opportunities with premier technology companies

? Interview preparation and onboarding assistance

Our goal is to help you succeed throughout the hiring process and beyond.

Why Work with Patty Vogel? As your recruiter, I will be your advocate throughout the process.

I specialize in semiconductor, manufacturing, engineering, and technical recruiting and work directly with hiring managers to help qualified candidates stand out. You'll receive honest feedback, interview preparation, timely communication, and support from application through onboarding.

Principal Recruiter | Yoh Staffing Services

job.title: Sr. IT Project & Program Manager - Hybrid in Boston!
job.description:
Sr. IT Project Manager with Program Management experience - Hybrid in Boston

*This is a senior level role. Need someone with enterprise level experience/background. Open to any type of technical experience managing project. This is a complex, large, busy and  highly visible environment! Need someone very seasoned. 

Client: Higher Education Industry
Location: onsite 3 days/week in Boston 
Duration: 12 month contract
Pay Rate: $85-95/hr on W2

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. NO C2C!!


Senior ITS Project Manager Position Overview The Division of Information Technology Services (ITS) is seeking a highly experienced and motivated Senior ITS Project Manager to join our team. This role is responsible for driving the successful delivery of large-scale, complex IT projects and programs that support the university’s strategic priorities.
The Senior ITS Project Manager will lead cross-functional teams, manage diverse stakeholder expectations, and ensure all initiatives are delivered within scope, schedule, and budget while aligning business value with user needs.
Qualifications Education
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Project management certification and/or training preferred (e.g., PMP, Agile, PRINCE2).
Experience
  • 8+ years of progressive IT project management experience, including management of large, complex, cross-functional IT initiatives within matrixed organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-level technology projects, including CRM, ERP, infrastructure, data integration, and cloud-based systems.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience partnering with business units, technical teams, and executive stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable project plans.
  • Proven ability to lead diverse project teams, establish direction, communicate vision, and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Experience navigating organizational change, managing competing priorities, and driving projects forward in ambiguous or evolving environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizational change efforts for enterprise technology implementations, including user adoption and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Strong track record of leveraging data-driven insights to guide project planning, decision-making, and risk management.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Expertise in project management methodologies, including Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid approaches.
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, ServiceNow, and Jira.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Strong systems-thinking capabilities to understand and manage interactions between technology and business processes.
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly and effectively to drive alignment and informed decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships, foster collaboration, and resolve conflicts across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Deep understanding of business processes and IT alignment, with the ability to deliver measurable business value.
  • Experience with resource planning and budget management for large-scale projects.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and capable of working independently in fast-paced environments.
  • Good understanding of current and emerging technologies and how organizations leverage them to drive digital transformation and business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of business needs, with the ability to establish and maintain a high level of customer trust and confidence.
Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities Project Leadership & Execution
  • Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple large and complex IT projects across departments, ensuring alignment with university priorities and strategic objectives.
  • Develop and manage detailed project plans, milestones, scope statements, budgets, schedules, and resource allocations.
  • Ensure project scope and plans address technology delivery, organizational change management, readiness activities, and operational transitions.
  • Conduct risk assessments and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor project activities to ensure the accuracy, quality, integrity, and consistency of project information and deliverables.
Stakeholder Engagement & Communication
  • Serve as the primary liaison between technical teams, business units, and executive sponsors.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
  • Facilitate effective communication among cross-functional teams to ensure a shared understanding of objectives, progress, risks, and changes.
  • Present project updates, performance metrics, risks, and recommendations to governance groups and senior leadership.
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  • Provide direction, leadership, and support to cross-functional project teams, including internal staff and external vendors.
  • Establish clear goals, roles, and responsibilities while promoting accountability across team members.
  • Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, ownership, continuous improvement, and problem-solving.
Monitoring, Reporting & Financial Oversight
  • Track and report project progress, milestones, risks, issues, and financial performance.
  • Develop and publish regular status reports, and prepare or modify project schedules and plans as needed.
  • Ensure completion of post-project evaluations, lessons learned documentation, and knowledge transfer activities.
  • Manage project budgets responsibly, identify cost-saving opportunities, and maintain financial accountability throughout the project lifecycle.

job.title: Shipping and Receiving Specialist
job.description:
Shipping and Receiving Specialist

Job Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented, organized, and motivated Shipping and Receiving Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will manage the daily flow of goods entering and leaving our facility, handle the physical movement of inventory, and ensure the accuracy of shipments. You will also help develop, document, and continuously improve the shipping, receiving, and storage protocols that keep our operations consistent and auditable, and you will track work and requests in JIRA. This position offers opportunities for growth within our Logistics and Operations team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Receiving: Unload incoming deliveries, verify contents against purchase orders (POs) or packing slips, inspect goods for damage or discrepancies, and log exceptions promptly in JIRA and the inventory system.
  • Protocol Development: Create, document, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for shipping, receiving, and storage, including receiving inspection, put-away, labeling, location naming, packing standards, and hand-offs with carriers. Review protocols regularly, incorporate team feedback, and recommend improvements.
  • Shipping: Pick, pack, and label outgoing orders accurately. Prepare necessary shipping documentation (e.g., Bills of Lading, manifest logs) and confirm carrier pickups and tracking.
  • Inventory Management & Storage: Assist with regular cycle counts and physical inventory audits. Ensure all items are stored in their designated, labeled locations in accordance with storage protocols (including any temperature, handling, or segregation requirements).
  • Data Entry: Update the Inventory Management System or ERP software to reflect real-time movements, keeping records accurate and complete.
  • JIRA & Request Tracking: Use JIRA to create, update, prioritize, and close tickets for shipments, receiving exceptions, inventory discrepancies, and protocol changes. Keep ticket status, comments, and attachments current, and use JIRA dashboards/queues to report on open items.
  • Quality Control: Ensure that all products shipped meet company quality standards and are packaged securely to prevent transit damage.
  • Safety & Maintenance: Maintain a clean, organized, and safe workspace. Adhere to all safety protocols and report any equipment malfunctions.
  • Operations: Work closely with the operations and logistics team to resolve shipping delays or inventory errors and to keep stakeholders informed of status.

Required Skills & Qualifications
  • Experience: 1–3 years of experience in shipping, receiving, warehouse, or inventory control, preferably including writing or following standard operating procedures.
  • Software Proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) is required.
  • Organizational Skills: Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing tasks, meet strict deadlines, and keep a workspace, inventory, and documentation orderly.
  • JIRA: Working knowledge of JIRA (or similar ticketing/project tracking tool), or willingness to learn quickly, including creating and updating tickets and following workflows.
  • Physical Ability: Ability to lift up to 50lbs consistently and stand/walk for the duration of a shift.
  • Technical Literacy: Willingness to learn shipping software (e.g., UPS WorldShip, FedEx Ship Manager).
  • Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy when checking part numbers, quantities, and shipping addresses.
  • Process Documentation: Ability to write clear, step-by-step procedures and follow them consistently; comfort suggesting improvements to existing processes.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Reliability: A track record of punctuality and consistent attendance.

Preferred Qualifications
  • International Shipping: Familiarity with international shipping processes, including customs documentation and international carrier requirements.
  • Previous experience in a retail stockroom or distribution environment.
  • Experience operating a pallet jack (manual or electric).
  • Forklift certification (willingness to obtain one).
  • Familiarity with LTL (Less Than Truckload) shipping processes.

Work Environment
  • Exposure to varying temperatures within the facility.
  • Fast-paced setting with strict shipping deadlines.

job.title: Azure/Databricks platform engineer - Onsite in Jersey City, NJ -Hybrid
job.description:
Please share your resume to suman.dabbeta@yoh.com 
Suman Dabbeta | Sr. Recruiter | Yoh
https://www.linkedin.com/in/sumandabbeta/ 


Hybrid: Ideally 5 days onsite, ok with 3-4 days (will discuss during interview)

Location: Jersey City, NJ // CANDIDATES LOCALS TO NJ/NY AREA //

Must Haves:
-Azure/Databricks platform engineer
-Terraforms
-Azure infrastructure, platform automation, networking, security, migrations, and working with third-party implementation partners
-Azure
-Databricks
-Apache Spark
-CI/CD

Databricks / Azure Consultant – Job Summary
Seeking two experienced Databricks / Azure Consultants to support the design, implementation, and ongoing development of the Databricks data platform. The consultants will work with technology and data teams to build and enhance scalable data solutions using Databricks and Microsoft Azure, with a strong focus on data engineering, integration, security, automation, and platform best practices.
Ideal candidates will have strong hands-on experience across the Databricks ecosystem, including Databricks Workspace, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Spark, and MLflow, along with experience developing solutions in Microsoft Azure. Candidates should be comfortable working in a large enterprise environment and collaborating across application development, infrastructure, cloud, security, architecture, and data teams.
Key Skills and Experience
  • Databricks Ecosystem: Hands-on experience with Databricks Workspace, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Spark UI, and MLflow.
  • Programming & Data Engineering: Strong development experience with Python, PySpark, SQL, and/or Java, including the development and optimization of data processing and ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Cloud Platforms: Strong Microsoft Azure experience, particularly Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2), and Azure Data Factory. Experience with AWS, including S3 and IAM, is also desirable.
  • Apache Spark: Experience developing, troubleshooting, and performance-tuning Spark-based workloads and data processing pipelines.
  • DevOps & MLOps: Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, OpenShift, Kubernetes, and Terraform / Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Security & Governance: Experience implementing or supporting Databricks security, access controls, secrets management, identity integration, data governance, and Unity Catalog.
  • Automation & Operations: Experience with Databricks workflows, job orchestration, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support.
  • Enterprise Delivery: Ability to collaborate across technical teams and operate within established enterprise architecture, security, change-management, and governance standards.
  • Knowledge of Apache Airflow
Preferred Experience
Experience designing and delivering production-grade Databricks solutions in a large enterprise environment, particularly where security, data governance, resiliency, automation, and operational support are key requirements.

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
Network Engineer – Direct Hire | $125K | Hybrid – Irving, TX
Are you a hands-on Network Engineer who enjoys solving complex network challenges, implementing new technologies and working on enterprise-wide infrastructure projects?
Yoh has an exciting direct-hire opportunity with a growing, nationwide organization seeking a Network Engineer with strong Cisco routing and switching, enterprise data center and Fortinet firewall experience. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact through network modernization, infrastructure upgrades, security enhancements and the integration of newly acquired companies.

Please review the following requirements before applying:
  • Candidates MUST currently reside in the Dallas/Fort Worth metroplex. Please do not apply if you are not local.
  • Must be comfortable working onsite in Irving Monday through Thursday, with Fridays remote.
  • Hands-on Fortinet firewall experience is REQUIRED.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.
  • No C2C or third-party submissions.
If you're looking for a permanent opportunity where you can leverage your technical expertise and contribute to a growing enterprise environment, we'd love to hear from you!

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Manage all network and security systems across a large-scale enterprise while maintaining the availability and integrity of these systems.
  • Implement, and maintain network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, and wireless networks. 
  • Resolve network issues, provide technical support, and guide junior engineers in troubleshooting
  • Implement and maintain network security measures, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and access controls. 
  • Assist with the network integration of multiple companies we acquired.
  • Monitor network performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to optimize performance. 
  • Create regular reports; provide the necessary analytics to make technical and business decisions.
  • Effectively manages multiple projects involving installations of infrastructure software and hardware.
  • Ensures all issues regarding system or network automated alerts are logged, tracked, and resolved; manage alerts and events through and the enterprise trouble ticketing tool.
  • Follow the change management process to production systems with regards to physical or system configuration updates
  • Make process and systems improvement.
  • Develops and maintains capacity planning analysis, recommendations, and procedures.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of network infrastructure, including diagrams, procedures, and configurations. 
  • Resolve operational issues through support tickets and alerts from the network and system monitoring tools.
  • Stay current with new technology and tools.
  • Ensure global switching and routing consistency and troubleshoot where necessary.
  • Configure, manage, and administer routers, firewalls, switches, and other IP based communication equipment.
  • Track and log all activity, both incidents and resolutions, to system users
  • Coordinates with the other Information Technology team members to build a knowledge base.
  • Work with cross-function organization teams to ensure the coordination of resources for technology projects and that all services have needed information regarding the implementation of technology 
REQUIRED SKILLS:
  • 5+ years as an enterprise Network Engineer w/Datacenter experience.
  • 2 - 5+ years of Cisco Nexus 7k,9k, Catalyst routers and switches
  • 2+ years of Fortinet Firewall experience. FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer
  • Preferred - CCNE, CCNA, or CCNP
  • Strong experience with Multiple routing protocols 
PREFERRED SKILLS:
  • SolarWinds.
  • Fortinet
  • Ruckus Wireless
  • Cisco ISE
  • SDWAN
  • Site to Site VPN, IPsec, SSLVPN
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
  • Experience: broad experience (5+ years) in network engineering, including experience with network hardware and software, routing protocols, and security technologies. 
  • Certifications: Industry-recognized certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or equivalent are highly desirable. 
  • Skills: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Experience with various networking technologies, including Cisco, Juniper, and Palo Alto.

job.title: Sr. IAM Project Manager - Hybrid in Boston
job.description:
Sr. IAM Program Manager - Hybrid in Boston!

- For a higher education client
- 12 month contract
- onsite 3 days/week in Boston
- Pay Rate: $85-95/hr (denpending on experience)

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. No C2C!!

IAM Program Manager (Identity & Access Management) Position Overview The Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program Manager will lead Northeastern University's IAM program across multiple concurrent projects and initiatives. This role is responsible for program delivery, governance, vendor oversight, and strategic planning while partnering closely with senior leadership, Information Technology Services (ITS), Information Security, and stakeholders across the university.
The successful candidate will oversee large-scale IAM implementations, establish governance structures, manage vendor relationships, and ensure IAM technologies and processes support the university’s security, compliance, and operational objectives.

Work Arrangement: Full-time hybrid position based on the Boston campus. The contractor is required to work onsite at the Boston, Massachusetts campus a minimum of three (3) days per week.
Role Overview Lead Northeastern’s IAM program across multiple concurrent projects. This role owns program delivery, governance, and vendor oversight, while working closely with senior leadership and stakeholders across the university.

Required Qualifications Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field required.
  • Master’s degree preferred.
Experience
  • 7+ years of IT program and/or project management experience, including at least 5 years in Identity and Access Management (IAM), cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience delivering large-scale IAM implementations, including:
    • Single Sign-On (SSO)
    • Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
    • Privileged Access Management (PAM)
    • Identity Governance solutions
  • Proven track record managing large-scale IAM implementations within complex, distributed environments.
  • Strong experience working with authentication protocols and directory services, including:
    • SAML
    • OAuth
    • OpenID Connect (OIDC)
    • Active Directory
    • LDAP
  • Experience leading IAM projects involving cloud identity platforms, including:
    • Microsoft Azure AD / Entra ID
    • AWS IAM
    • Google Cloud Identity
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent, complex projects and programs.
  • Strong vendor and contract management experience.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to influence and drive outcomes within a matrixed organization without direct authority.
  • Higher education experience is strongly preferred.
Preferred Qualifications
  • PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification.
  • Experience working within higher education environments and familiarity with student, faculty, and staff identity lifecycle management.
  • Exposure to Zero Trust security models and compliance frameworks, including:
    • FERPA
    • HIPAA
    • GDPR
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
  • Deep understanding of IAM concepts, technologies, and industry best practices.
  • Experience with Azure AD/Entra ID, AWS IAM, and Google Cloud Identity.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Single Sign-On (SSO)
    • Identity Federation
    • Identity Lifecycle Management
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust security principles and architectures.
  • Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams while demonstrating empathy and awareness of different working styles and personality types.
  • Ability to influence, negotiate, and drive consensus within matrixed environments without direct authority.
  • Strong vendor, contract, and third-party relationship management experience.
  • Skilled at managing multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with project management methodologies and tools, including PMI, Agile, and PRINCE2.
  • Experience developing IAM roadmaps, conducting maturity assessments, and aligning IAM initiatives with institutional strategic goals.
  • Comfortable navigating complex organizational dynamics and building alignment among diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Ability to effectively engage executive leadership and key decision-makers.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to establish trust and confidence with stakeholders.
  • Unique blend of business, technology, financial, and communication skills suited for a highly visible leadership role.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to executive audiences and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Ability to create clear, comprehensive documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Understanding of IAM challenges in academic environments and the identity lifecycle needs of students, faculty, and staff is a plus.
  • Awareness of emerging technologies and their application within digital business and higher education environments.
Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities
IAM Program Leadership & Strategy (50%)
  • Develop and maintain the university’s IAM strategic roadmap and governance framework.
  • Lead the IAM Steering Committee and coordinate activities with IT governance bodies.
  • Establish IAM policies, standards, and procedures aligned with university policies and security objectives.
  • Manage relationships with IAM technology vendors and service providers.
  • Oversee multiple concurrent IAM projects, including implementations, upgrades, and integrations.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans, timelines, budgets, and resource allocation strategies.
  • Coordinate with application owners and stakeholders on IAM integration requirements.
  • Ensure projects are delivered within scope, quality, schedule, and budget expectations.
  • Identify program and project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with academic and administrative departments to understand IAM requirements and business needs.
  • Provide regular program updates, metrics, and strategic recommendations to university leadership.
  • Build alignment and consensus among diverse stakeholder groups.
Program Governance (25%)
  • Define and maintain the IAM program governance structure, including decision rights, escalation paths, and RACI models across ITS and university stakeholders.
  • Establish and lead governance forums, including:
    • Steering Committee meetings
    • Program reviews
    • Change Advisory processes
  • Prepare agendas, executive briefings, decision logs, and governance documentation.
  • Adhere to established project intake and prioritization processes, ensuring IAM initiatives are properly submitted, approved, and sequenced.
  • Maintain program-level RAID logs, including:
    • Risks
    • Assumptions
    • Issues
    • Dependencies
  • Drive timely resolution and escalation of program risks and issues.
  • Produce recurring program dashboards and status reports covering:
    • Delivery progress
    • Schedule performance
    • Budget status
    • Risks and issues
  • Ensure compliance with ITS PMO standards, change management processes, and documentation requirements.
  • Support audits and reviews of program controls.
Vendor Management (15%)
  • Lead vendor sourcing and selection activities, including:
    • RFI development
    • RFP development
    • Evaluation criteria creation
    • Product demonstrations
    • Vendor recommendations in partnership with Procurement

job.title: QC Chemist (HPLC/UPLC/Stability)
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for an  QC Chemist (HPLC/UPLC/Stability) to join a combined Analytical Development and Quality Control organization supporting a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in GMP analytical testing and hands-on HPLC/UPLC and Stability Testing experience and be able to execute established analytical methods with minimal ramp-up time. The role will initially focus heavily on routine analytical, stability, and release testing, with opportunities to expand into analytical development and method generation as the individual gains experience within the organization.

Location: Bristol, PA

What We're Looking For:
  • The strongest candidates will have a GMP QC/analytical testing foundation with strong stability testing and HPLC/UPLC skills and the ability to begin executing established methods quickly.
  • Sability Testing and HPLC/UPLC is a a must have!
  • Candidates who demonstrate curiosity and the ability to learn new techniques will have the opportunity to expand beyond routine testing and eventually contribute to analytical development and method generation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform routine stability testing and analytical testing using HPLC and UPLC in a GMP-regulated laboratory environment.
  • Execute established analytical methods supporting release testing, stability studies, and manufacturing operations.
  • Accurately prepare samples, standards, buffers, and reagents in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Review and interpret analytical data while identifying and escalating atypical or unexpected results.
  • Maintain accurate and compliant laboratory documentation in accordance with GMP requirements.
  • Follow established SOPs, analytical methods, laboratory procedures, and data-integrity requirements.
  • Support laboratory investigations, troubleshooting, and resolution of analytical issues as appropriate.
  • Train on additional analytical techniques and instrumentation as required by the organization.
  • Collaborate with QC, Analytical Development, and Manufacturing teams to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
  • Over time, contribute to analytical method development, optimization, and method generation as experience and training progress.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and compliant laboratory environment.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant analytical laboratory experience.
  • GMP experience is required.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HPLC/UPLC and stability testing is required.
  • Experience executing established analytical methods in a regulated laboratory environment.
  • Understanding of fundamental analytical chemistry principles and chromatography.
  • Ability to accurately document laboratory activities and analytical results.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team.
  • Willingness to work a flexible/rotational schedule, including potential weekend coverage, to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
#IND-SPG

job.title: Inventory Specialist
job.description:
Inventory Specialist

The Inventory Specialist will own inventory accuracy and control for the site's materials and equipment. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate inventory records, running cycle count and reconciliation programs, investigating variances, and driving improvements that reduce errors and shrinkage. Shipping responsibilities are limited. The Specialist hands off inventory to the Shipping and Receiving Specialist for outbound movement and partners with that role to design and implement an organized storage solution. This role requires an analytical, detail-oriented individual who can balance hands-on work in the storage area with accurate data management and process compliance.

What you'll be able to do: Responsibilities:
  • Maintain accurate inventory records in the inventory/WMS/ERP system, including receipts, transfers, adjustments, and issues.
  • Plan and perform cycle counts and periodic physical inventory audits; investigate and reconcile variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
  • Monitor stock levels, identify shortages, surpluses, and obsolete or slow-moving items, and recommend replenishment or disposition actions.
  • Partner with the Shipping and Receiving Specialist to design, implement, and maintain an organized storage solution, including location schema, labeling, slotting, and shelving/racking layout.
  • Establish and maintain standard work for storage, labeling, and item location practices to ensure items are easy to locate and retrieve.
  • Prepare inventory for handoff to the Shipping and Receiving Specialist, including verifying quantities, confirming location and documentation, and updating system status at transfer.
  • Track and report inventory metrics (inventory accuracy, variance trends, shrinkage, location accuracy) and present findings to leadership.
  • Support continuous improvement projects to improve inventory accuracy, space utilization, and material flow.
  • Use RF scanners, barcode systems, and inventory software to track item movement and status.
  • Operate material handling equipment (pallet jack, hand truck, forklift if certified) safely, and maintain housekeeping and safety standards.
  • Follow EH&S and company safety protocols, including proper handling and storage of hazardous or regulated materials when applicable.
  • Communicate with procurement, production, quality, and operations teams to resolve inventory discrepancies and meet timelines.

Minimum Requirements:
  • High school diploma or GED.
  • 3+ years of experience in inventory control, materials management, or warehouse operations.
  • Hands-on experience with WMS/ERP systems, RF scanning, and cycle counting programs.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., formulas, pivot tables, lookups) and Outlook.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail, analytical skills, and data-entry accuracy.
  • Ability to safely operate basic material handling equipment.
  • Capable of frequently lifting and moving items up to 50 lbs and performing prolonged standing, walking, bending, and reaching.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and adapting to changing priorities.

Preferred Requirements:
  • Forklift certification, or willingness to obtain one.
  • Experience designing or implementing storage layouts, slotting, 5S, or Lean/visual management practices.
  • Experience with root cause analysis and inventory reconciliation processes.
  • Previous experience in automotive, manufacturing, laboratory, or high-mix environments.
  • Familiarity with EH&S standards relevant to storage and material handling.
  • Associate's degree or relevant certification in supply chain, logistics, or operations management (e.g., APICS CPIM) is a plus.

job.title: Transmission Engineer
job.description:
Transmission Engineer - Transmission & Distribution

Join a dynamic team at the forefront of energy infrastructure development as a Transmission Engineer specializing in Transmission & Distribution. This vital role offers the opportunity to design and deliver cutting-edge projects across high voltage transmission lines—both underground and overhead—in regions like Minneapolis and Duluth. Be part of a collaborative environment that shapes the future of power delivery, working through all project phases from conception to construction, ensuring reliable, efficient, and innovative transmission solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering or related field from an ABET-accredited program (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in transmission engineering, with 5+ years preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of civil/structural engineering techniques, codes (NESC, NERC, FERC), and standards.
  • Proficiency with design software such as CAD and PLS-CADD.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to analyze, problem-solve, and apply critical thinking in complex environments.
  • Experience in preparing specifications, technical bid summaries, and reports.
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Prior consulting experience in transmission or civil engineering projects.
  • Successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam or EIT certification.
  • Experience performing economic conductor selection, grounding calculations, and lightning performance studies.
  • Knowledge of project management and client communication.
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil or related Engineering Technology; a Master’s in Civil Engineering is a plus.
  • At least 3 years of relevant transmission engineering experience, with a preference for 5+ years.
  • Hands-on experience with project design, field inspections, and technical report compilation.
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 10% for project site visits.
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to work in both office and field environments.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and timely project delivery.
Step into a transformative role where your expertise guides the development of essential energy infrastructure. Bring your skills to a team that values innovation and dedication—apply now and help shape the future of transmission systems!

job.title: Software Engineer In Test - Onsite, Durham, NC
job.description:
Senior Software Engineer in Test The Opportunity We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer in Test to join a collaborative Quality Engineering team focused on continuous integration, test automation, test data, and software delivery. This role will help design and implement scalable automation solutions, improve testing practices, and support development teams across the technology organization.

The ideal candidate is a multi-stack engineer with strong programming skills, experience building automation platforms, and the ability to work across web, mobile, API, and backend technologies.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, document, and maintain automated tests and software utilities
  • Build and enhance automation frameworks and testing platforms
  • Develop solutions that improve delivery speed, product stability, and testing efficiency
  • Collaborate with technical teams to understand requirements and solve complex problems
  • Apply test-driven design concepts to test and debug automated solutions
  • Identify opportunities to improve the maintainability and scalability of automation platforms
  • Establish testing tools and frameworks for multiple development teams
  • Support continuous integration and continuous delivery initiatives
  • Contribute to development pipelines and automated quality processes
  • Evaluate and adopt new technologies, tools, and testing techniques
  • Monitor application quality and support proactive incident resolution
  • Deliver accurate, reliable, and maintainable automation code
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment
  • Take ownership of deliverables and drive results across multiple initiatives
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • 10+ years of experience architecting test automation platforms and implementing CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong experience with Java and Angular or similar front-end frameworks
  • Experience working across multiple technology stacks, including web, mobile, API, and backend systems
  • Hands-on experience with JavaScript, Jenkins, and uDeploy or comparable tools
  • Experience with automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, REST Assured, Playwright, Cucumber, and Karate
  • Strong SQL experience
  • Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform
  • Experience creating and supporting testing platforms used by multiple development teams
  • Knowledge of monitoring, observability, and proactive incident resolution
  • Strong experience delivering software solutions in an Agile environment
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and cross-functional teams
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills
Additional Information This role offers the opportunity to work across the full software development lifecycle while contributing to test automation, cloud technologies, CI/CD, monitoring, observability, and software quality initiatives. A single 60-minute interview is expected.

job.title: Letter of Credit / Client Processing Specialist
job.description:
Job Description
 
Position Summary:
 
The Senior Specialist, Client Processing will be responsible for handling Complex Letter of Credit structuring and manage the Letter of Credit life cycle for High-priority Trade clients by providing timely and quality support to the clients in facilitating their transactions and processes.  This role may also involve working with various stakeholders like Clients, FIs and NBFIs, simultaneously. 
 
Responsibilities: 
  • Ensure transactions and inquiries of High-priority clients are handled timely and accurately.
  • Applies in-depth knowledge and expertise on service offerings, proactive assessment and resolution of complex transaction issues. 
  • Assist Product and Relationship team with Operational/ transactional insights to manage client expectations. 
  • Participate in the risk review sessions conducted by the Team to identify mitigate inherent and residual risk of the processes.
  • As a documentary credit specialist, support the Team in crafting solutions and methods to resolve issues at hand and similar issues in the future.
  • Responsible for structuring Letter of Credit & Guarantees vetting by collaborating with the Clients, Legal, Product, Risk & Compliance.
  • Contribute to workflow optimization and process improvement using best practices and technology.

job.title: Qualtiy Manager
job.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Quality Manager to lead and continuously improve our Quality Management System and quality organization. This is a working leadership role with direct involvement in AS9100D, manufacturing quality, customer issues, supplier quality, corrective action, inspection, and continuous improvement.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Maintain and continuously improve a robust Quality Management System aligned with AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015.
  • Serve as the management representative for the QMS.
  • Oversee incoming component quality, in-process inspection, and final product quality activities.
  • Lead root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, 8D, SCAR, and related problem-solving activities.
  • Work with suppliers to address material quality issues and enforce quality requirements.
  • Manage, train, and mentor quality inspectors, technicians, and quality engineering personnel.
  • Track and report quality metrics, including customer PPM, scrap, defects, and Cost of Poor Quality.
  • Support internal, customer, and certification audits.
  • Work closely with Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, and Production to resolve quality issues and improve processes.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • 5+ years of hands-on quality leadership experience in industrial or electronics manufacturing.
  • Strong knowledge of root-cause analysis, PFMEA, statistical process control, corrective action, and manufacturing quality systems.
  • Experience maintaining or leading an ISO 9001 and/or AS9100 quality system.
  • Strong leadership, organization, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work directly with customers, suppliers, engineers, and production personnel to resolve quality issues.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Direct AS9100D experience.
  • Electronics manufacturing or PCBA quality experience.
  • Bachelor degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, or a related technical field; equivalent substantial experience considered.
  • Experience with customer corrective actions, supplier quality, and aerospace/defense requirements.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ISO internal auditor, or similar credentials.
COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
Compensation: $90,000-$110,000 per year, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Annual year-end bonus

Our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. Phoenix, Arizona | $32.00-$38 per Hour | Monday-Friday | 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM | 100% Onsite Join a World Leader in Semiconductor Technology Yoh is actively seeking an experienced Safety Representative to support Applied Materials at TSMC in Phoenix, Arizona. Applied Materials is the global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every advanced semiconductor chip in the world. This opportunity places you at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing technology sectors while helping protect engineers working in a state-of-the-art semiconductor manufacturing environment.

For more than 80 years, Yoh has connected top professionals with industry-leading organizations. We are proud to partner with Applied Materials to identify safety professionals who are passionate about creating safe workplaces, preventing incidents, and promoting a strong safety culture. Location Suite 128, 25800 N Norterra Parkway, Phoenix, AZ 85085 Compensation and Schedule
  • $29.00 - $38.00 per hour
  • Monday through Friday
  • 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
  • 100% Onsite
  • No holiday, weekend, or overtime eligibility
What You Will Do
  • Represent Applied Materials Safety in the field supporting engineers at TSMC.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA, TSMC, and Applied Materials safety standards.
  • Maintain a strong boots-on-the-ground safety presence inside the fab.
  • Participate in daily engineering pass-down meetings and reinforce safety expectations.

  • 2+ years of safety experience, preferably within manufacturing or semiconductor environments.
  • CHST, OHST, ASP, GSP, or similar EHS certification.
  • OSHA 510 or OSHA 511 certification.
  • Science-related degree.
  • Semiconductor industry experience.

  • Career growth opportunities within the semiconductor industry.

job.title: Identity & Access Engineer
job.description:
Identity & Access Engineer
6-12 month contract/contract to hire (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
Peachtree Corners, GA (Hybrid)

Must have experience migrating Duo to Okta experience!

Job Overview
We are seeking an experienced Identity & Access Engineer to support enterprise identity and access management initiatives, including platform modernization, application integrations, authentication migrations, and identity lifecycle automation.
This hands-on role focuses on enterprise identity platforms, directory services, single sign-on (SSO), multifactor authentication (MFA), application federation, and hybrid identity environments. The engineer will help strengthen security, streamline authentication, improve identity administration, and deliver reliable identity services across complex enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with the ability to independently execute identity engineering projects, troubleshoot complex authentication issues, automate identity processes, and coordinate integrations across multiple technical teams.

Responsibilities
  • Identity Platform Engineering: Configure, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise identity platforms, including Okta, Duo, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • SSO & MFA Migration: Support migrations from legacy authentication and MFA solutions to modern identity platforms. Configure authentication policies, validate application functionality, and coordinate production cutovers.
  • Application Federation: Implement and troubleshoot authentication and federation integrations using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and related protocols.
  • Directory Services Integration: Configure virtual directory services and LDAP integrations to support authentication for legacy applications and enterprise resources.
  • Identity Lifecycle Automation: Integrate identity platforms with HR systems and other enterprise applications to automate user provisioning, profile updates, and deprovisioning.
  • Hybrid Identity Management: Configure and troubleshoot directory synchronization, identity mapping, authentication, and access across multiple Active Directory domains and identity platforms.
  • Identity Integration & Migration: Execute identity integration and migration initiatives associated with organizational changes, acquisitions, and consolidation of identity environments.
  • Automation & Scripting: Develop PowerShell scripts, REST API integrations, and automated workflows to improve identity administration, reduce manual effort, and increase provisioning accuracy.
  • Technical Project Delivery: Independently manage engineering activities from requirements gathering and dependency analysis through implementation, testing, cutover, validation, documentation, and operational handoff.
  • Security & Troubleshooting: Diagnose complex authentication and authorization issues, implement secure configurations, and support least-privilege access practices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with identity, security, infrastructure, and application teams to resolve technical dependencies and deliver successful integrations.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Create technical documentation, integration diagrams, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks while transferring knowledge to support teams.

Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience in identity and access management engineering within enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and troubleshooting Okta and Duo.
  • Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP, and hybrid identity architectures.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing SSO and MFA integrations using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC).
  • Experience migrating applications between identity providers or authentication platforms, including testing, validation, and cutover planning.
  • Experience with virtual directory services, LDAP proxying, identity mapping, and authentication across multiple directory environments.
  • Experience implementing automated identity provisioning and deprovisioning, including HR-driven lifecycle processes.
  • Knowledge of SCIM, directory synchronization, and identity provisioning technologies.
  • Strong PowerShell scripting skills and experience using REST APIs to automate identity administration and integrations.
  • Ability to independently deliver complex identity engineering projects from requirements through implementation and operational handoff.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across authentication flows, federation, directory services, and application access.
  • Experience collaborating with security teams, application owners, infrastructure engineers, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical documentation, communication, and knowledge transfer skills.
  • Okta certifications, such as Okta Certified Administrator or Okta Certified Consultant.
  • Experience integrating identity platforms with HR systems, such as Workday.
  • Experience with Radiant Logic or comparable virtual directory technologies.
  • Experience supporting identity integration initiatives following mergers and acquisitions.
  • Familiarity with privileged access management and enterprise identity security best practices.

job.description:
Architectural Project Engineer (Data Center Systems) 

Role Description:
This role will support a technical program owner while partnering closely with technical leads responsible for facility developments within large?scale data centers. In this role you will drive execution, ensuring programs are scoped, aligned, and delivered efficiently across multiple engineering disciplines. You will collaborate closely with TPMs, engineers, and leadership to streamline processes, drive accountability, and support decision-making with clear documentation and reporting. You’ll help to manage program schedules, facilitate design reviews, track progress across cross-functional teams, and ensure alignment between engineering, construction, and operations. You’ll also support the development and optimization of program tracking tools and systems, helping to scale controls program management practices across the organization.

Must Haves:

  • Background in Civil Engineering / Architecture with building?systems exposure (preferred), or Background in Structural Engineering experience
  • Experience with CAD/BIM modeling tools (Revit, SolidWorks, BIM, or similar)
  • Ability to understand structural loading and how increased compute density impacts the built environment
  • Strong technical understanding of electrical engineering / background supporting electrical functions
  • Proven ability to support and coordinate engineering programs across complex, multi-program portfolios
  • Demonstrated experience in managing electrical engineering deliverables, schedules, and dependencies
  • Proficiency with engineering tracking platforms and collaboration tools
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical scenarios into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders

job.title: Research Scientist - Biochemistry/Automation
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Research Scientist – Biochemistry/Automation opportunity with a trusted, long-term client located in Waltham, MA.
 
This position is part of a major pharmaceutical company, and requires a PhD in Biochemistry, Protein Chemistry, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline with 2+ years of post-doctoral or industry experience (or MS with 5+ years of relevant experience). Schedule is full-time M-F (7am-8am start time, 8 hour shift) and may require flexibility to work some evenings and overtime due to projects.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and execute high-throughput protein expression studies across multiple expression systems (e.g., mammalian, bacterial).
  • Develop and optimize purification processes (e.g., affinity, ion exchange, size exclusion chromatography) for high-throughput and scale-up applications.
  • Perform comprehensive biochemical and biophysical characterization of proteins, including purity, identity, aggregation, stability, and structural integrity (e.g., HPLC, BLI, DLS, DSF, SDS-PAGE, capillary electrophoresis).
  • Establish and maintain robust analytical methods and ensure data quality and integrity in line with GxP/regulatory expectations where applicable.
  • Lead or contribute to the implementation and optimization of automated liquid handling and workflow platforms for expression, purification, and assay execution.
  • Analyze and interpret complex datasets, communicate findings clearly through reports, presentations, and cross-functional meetings.
  • Document work accurately in compliance with internal SOPs and data management standards.
  • Contribute to troubleshooting, method transfer, and continuous improvement of laboratory processes.
 
Qualifications:
  • PhD in Biochemistry, Protein Chemistry, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline with 2+ years of post-doctoral or industry experience (or MS with 5+ years of relevant experience).
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in protein chemistry, including expression, purification, and characterization of recombinant proteins.
  • Proven experience with high-throughput protein expression and purification workflows.
  • Strong working knowledge of chromatography techniques (FPLC/HPLC) and analytical methods for protein characterization.
  • Solid understanding of protein structure, folding, stability, and aggregation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on experience with laboratory automation platforms (e.g., Tecan, Hamilton, or similar liquid handling systems) and workflow scripting or programming.
  • Experience with biologics developability assessments or formulation screening.
  • Experience with mammalian expression systems (e.g., CHO, HEK293).
  • Experience with electronic lab notebook systems.

job.title: Materials Coordinator - Ohio
job.description:
Materials Coordinator – Ohio.

Scope:
• Handle the following – Receive, unpack, check & verify merchandise/product ensuring accuracy.
• Will work out of the Fremont location but will also travel to San Francisco, and Mountain View frequently.
• Work closely with the engineering team on activities such as – “Car-On-Bench” (COB).
• SW tools like SAP, Reynolds and Reynolds, Lightspeed, etc..
• Utilize handheld RF tools to receive merchandise/products into WMS.
• Conduct the following – Stock checks, part # verification, Cycle Count, support physical inventory.
• Consolidate loads as required – Pack, Re-Pack, wrap product for shipping.
• Label parts during put away, picking or shipping process.
• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, etc.
• Ensure orders/shipping materials are accompanied with proper delivery docs: Revised BOL, Manual tag, Packing slip, etc.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures & safety guidelines.
• Perform organization tasks to maintain a clean/safe work environment.
• Cross train to learn other warehouse functions.
• Fill requisitions, work orders, or requests for materials, tools, or stock items & distribute items to production workers or assembly line.
• Always maintain accuracy, provide required reports, measurements and logs to KPI guidelines.
• Expertise utilizing a warehouse ERP inventory system, Excel, shipping, receiving, safety management, materials handling, data entry, reporting, etc.

Required:

• Experience in the automotive industry in some fashion. Examples are Associates in automotive tech, wholesale parts at dealerships, parts to service, body shop work, military, large automobile manufacturers, etc.
• Will work out of the Fremont location but will also travel to San Francisco, and Mountain View frequently.
• Experience and ability working with pallet jacks - Forklifts are not required.
• Experience with basic supply chain skills.
• Experience putting together spreadsheets and tables.
• Willing to put in extra work during down times by organizing the shop, stacking tires, disposing of tires, picking up deliveries, etc.
• Must be comfortable working as a team.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer (Semi-solids and Liquids)
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Manufacturing Engineer to join a pharmaceutical manufacturing organization supporting semi-solids and liquids in Rosenberg, TX. This is a hands-on, floor-oriented engineering position supporting day-to-day pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.

The Manufacturing Engineer will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Packaging, Validation, and R&D to troubleshoot equipment and process issues, improve manufacturing performance, support new product and equipment initiatives, and ensure compliance with FDA and cGMP requirements.

The ideal candidate will have direct pharmaceutical manufacturing engineering experience, with liquid and/or semi-solid products, and be comfortable spending significant time on the manufacturing floor.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Provide hands-on engineering support to pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing and packaging equipment issues to minimize downtime and improve equipment reliability.
  • Support equipment installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, and validation activities.
  • Develop and execute engineering and validation documentation, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
  • Support process validation and cleaning validation activities.
  • Investigate manufacturing deviations and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Develop and implement CAPA and change controls.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve throughput, productivity, labor efficiency, equipment reliability, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
  • Support manufacturing process improvements and cost-reduction initiatives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Packaging, Validation, and R&D teams.
  • Develop and revise SOPs, manufacturing procedures, and work instructions.
  • Support regulatory, customer, and internal audits.
  • Ensure engineering and manufacturing activities comply with applicable FDA, cGMP, safety, and quality requirements.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial, Manufacturing, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Strong knowledge of FDA requirements, cGMP, and regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing practices.
  • Direct experience manufacturing semi-solid products, such as creams, ointments, and suppositories, and/or liquid products, including solutions and suspensions.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting manufacturing and packaging equipment.
  • Experience with equipment installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, and validation.
  • Working knowledge of IQ/OQ/PQ, process validation, and cleaning validation.
  • Experience with deviations, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA, and change control.
  • Ability and willingness to spend significant time on the manufacturing floor supporting daily operations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

job.title: Materials Coordinator - Wittmann, AZ.
job.description:
Materials Coordinator – Wittmann, AZ.

Scope:
• Handle the following – Receive, unpack, check & verify merchandise/product ensuring accuracy.
• Will work out of the Fremont location but will also travel to San Francisco, and Mountain View frequently.
• Work closely with the engineering team on activities such as – “Car-On-Bench” (COB).
• SW tools like SAP, Reynolds and Reynolds, Lightspeed, etc..
• Utilize handheld RF tools to receive merchandise/products into WMS.
• Conduct the following – Stock checks, part # verification, Cycle Count, support physical inventory.
• Consolidate loads as required – Pack, Re-Pack, wrap product for shipping.
• Label parts during put away, picking or shipping process.
• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, etc.
• Ensure orders/shipping materials are accompanied with proper delivery docs: Revised BOL, Manual tag, Packing slip, etc.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures & safety guidelines.
• Perform organization tasks to maintain a clean/safe work environment.
• Cross train to learn other warehouse functions.
• Fill requisitions, work orders, or requests for materials, tools, or stock items & distribute items to production workers or assembly line.
• Always maintain accuracy, provide required reports, measurements and logs to KPI guidelines.
• Expertise utilizing a warehouse ERP inventory system, Excel, shipping, receiving, safety management, materials handling, data entry, reporting, etc.

Required:
• Work closely with the engineering team on activities such as – “Car-On-Bench” (COB). This is the most critical requirement.
• Experience in the automotive industry in some fashion. Examples are Associates in automotive tech, wholesale parts at dealerships, parts to service, body shop work, military, large automobile manufacturers, etc.
• Will work out of the Fremont location but will also travel to San Francisco, and Mountain View frequently.
• Experience and ability working with pallet jacks - Forklifts are not required.
• Experience with basic supply chain skills.
• Experience putting together spreadsheets and tables.
• Willing to put in extra work during down times by organizing the shop, stacking tires, disposing of tires, picking up deliveries, etc.
• Must be comfortable working as a team.

Applied Materials | Billerica, MA

Applied Materials is the world's leading provider of materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every advanced semiconductor chip and display manufactured today.
