job.title: QC Chemist (HPLC/UPLC/Stability)
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for an  QC Chemist (HPLC/UPLC/Stability) to join a combined Analytical Development and Quality Control organization supporting a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in GMP analytical testing and hands-on HPLC/UPLC and Stability Testing experience and be able to execute established analytical methods with minimal ramp-up time. The role will initially focus heavily on routine analytical, stability, and release testing, with opportunities to expand into analytical development and method generation as the individual gains experience within the organization.

Location: Bristol, PA

What We're Looking For:
  • The strongest candidates will have a GMP QC/analytical testing foundation with strong stability testing and HPLC/UPLC skills and the ability to begin executing established methods quickly.
  • Sability Testing and HPLC/UPLC is a a must have!
  • Candidates who demonstrate curiosity and the ability to learn new techniques will have the opportunity to expand beyond routine testing and eventually contribute to analytical development and method generation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform routine stability testing and analytical testing using HPLC and UPLC in a GMP-regulated laboratory environment.
  • Execute established analytical methods supporting release testing, stability studies, and manufacturing operations.
  • Accurately prepare samples, standards, buffers, and reagents in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Review and interpret analytical data while identifying and escalating atypical or unexpected results.
  • Maintain accurate and compliant laboratory documentation in accordance with GMP requirements.
  • Follow established SOPs, analytical methods, laboratory procedures, and data-integrity requirements.
  • Support laboratory investigations, troubleshooting, and resolution of analytical issues as appropriate.
  • Train on additional analytical techniques and instrumentation as required by the organization.
  • Collaborate with QC, Analytical Development, and Manufacturing teams to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
  • Over time, contribute to analytical method development, optimization, and method generation as experience and training progress.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and compliant laboratory environment.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant analytical laboratory experience.
  • GMP experience is required.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HPLC/UPLC and stability testing is required.
  • Experience executing established analytical methods in a regulated laboratory environment.
  • Understanding of fundamental analytical chemistry principles and chromatography.
  • Ability to accurately document laboratory activities and analytical results.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team.
  • Willingness to work a flexible/rotational schedule, including potential weekend coverage, to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
#IND-SPG

job.title: Full Stack Engineer - Onsite - Nashua, NH - W2 Only
job.description:
Full Stack Engineer - Onsite
Nashua, NH - W2 Only

The Opportunity We are seeking a Software Engineer to help build and enhance cloud-based applications within a collaborative technology environment. This role is ideal for someone with strong Java and Spring Boot experience who enjoys developing reliable software, solving technical problems, and learning new technologies.

The successful candidate will contribute to application development, API integration, testing, code reviews, production support, and continuous improvement efforts.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technology field
  • Hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs
  • Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills
  • Commitment to engineering excellence and continuous improvement
  • Ability to learn and experiment with new technologies, tools, and development patterns
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and maintain cloud-based applications and services
  • Complete coding tasks using established Java development practices and coding standards
  • Build and integrate REST APIs
  • Write unit tests and contribute to maintaining a reliable, high-quality codebase
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Assist with identifying, isolating, resolving, and communicating application issues
  • Support production and nonproduction environments
  • Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver software enhancements
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and technical practices
Additional Information This role offers the opportunity to work on modern cloud-based applications while developing skills across Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, automated testing, production support, and software engineering best practices.

job.title: MANUFACTURING TECHNICIAN - GLOUCESTER, MA
job.description:
ELECTRO MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER OR Manufacturing Technician
Gloucester, MA

Schedule: 
  • Competitive pay ranging from $23.00 to $26.00 per hour, plus shift differentials
  • First Shift:  from 5 am to 3:30 pm Monday through Thursday
  • Second Shift:  from 3 on to 11:30 pm Monday through Thursday has an additional 10% differential 
  • Mid Shift:  from 11 am to 7 pm 
  • Third Shift:  from 7:30 pm to  6 am Monday through Thursday has an additional 13% differential 
  • Fourth Shift:  from 6 am to 6:30 pm Friday, Saturday, and Sunday with an additional 11% differential 
Are you a hands-on Manufacturing Technician who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and working with cutting-edge technology? Join a team where your skills directly support advanced semiconductor manufacturing—an industry driving innovation in everything from AI to electric vehicles.
This is an excellent opportunity for technicians who thrive in electro-mechanical environments, enjoy problem-solving, and want long-term career growth in a high-tech manufacturing setting.

What You’ll Be Doing
In this role, you will support the production, testing, and repair of complex semiconductor equipment by:
Building, repairing, and testing electrical, electro-mechanical, pneumatic, and vacuum assemblies and subassemblies
Working from work orders, schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal or written instructions
Performing electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, and repair, while identifying and correcting errors
Using test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps to validate assemblies
Entering production data, labor details, and work progress into computer systems
Receiving and auditing parts to ensure build readiness; inspecting components for defects
Troubleshooting issues and contributing to process improvements
Documenting completed work clearly and accurately
Safety & Work Environment
Properly use PPE, tools, equipment, and materials
Proactively report hazards, incidents, or injuries
This position may involve working in a cleanroom environment, requiring PPE such as coveralls, hoods, booties, gloves, safety glasses, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Physical & Environmental Requirements
This is an active, hands-on role that may include:
Standing for extended periods, walking, bending, squatting, kneeling, twisting, climbing stairs or ladders, and working in tight spaces
Lifting and handling components and tools
Operating hand and power tools
Working in environments with moderate to high noise levels
Driving or operating heavy machinery, including forklifts
Ability to distinguish between colors

What We’re Looking For
Experience in manufacturing, assembly, or production environments
Strong ability to follow technical instructions and schematics
Hands-on skills with electro-mechanical assemblies and tools
Comfort working in structured, process-driven environments
Interest in or experience within semiconductor or high-tech manufacturing (highly valued)

Why Join Us
4 day workweek with Fridays off
Day shift schedule for better work-life balance
Entry point or growth opportunity into the semiconductor industry
Work with advanced manufacturing technology
A role where your technical skills truly matter

Working With Yoh
Benefits
Medical, dental, vision insurance
401(k), life & disability coverage
Weekly pay, employee discounts
Ready to Build the Future

If you’re a driven Manufacturing Technician who enjoys hands-on work and wants to be part of a high-impact industry, we want to hear from you.
Apply today and take your next step in semiconductor manufacturing!

Patty Vogel]
patty.vogel@yoh.com

job.title: Senior HRBP (Hybrid to Johnston, IA)
job.description:
Send updated resumes to Tymir Black
https://www.linkedin.com/in/tymir-black-035914111/
Tymir.Black@yoh.com 

Senior HR Business Partner (Hybrid — Johnston, IA) We’re partnering with a leading organization to hire a Senior HR Business Partner to support business leaders across U.S.-based teams with connections to global stakeholders. This is a high-impact, consultative role with a true “seat at the table,” focused on people strategy, organizational effectiveness, change leadership, and talent planning. Location & schedule - Hybrid: must live within 50 miles of Johnston, IA (Des Moines metro) - Expect to be onsite frequently (approximately 2–4 days per week) - Travel: less than 25% annually (occasional travel to Wayne, PA) What you’ll do - Serve as a strategic HR partner and trusted advisor to senior leaders; coach and influence leadership decisions - Build and execute people strategies that support business goals, workforce planning, and capacity needs - Lead organizational development initiatives (re-orgs, restructuring, efficiency improvements), including change management planning and execution - Drive succession planning, career pathing, and development plans for high-potential talent - Partner with Employee Relations to address complex employee relations matters in a compliant, ethical manner - Support job architecture work such as job descriptions, compensation analysis, grading, and recognition initiatives - Advise leaders on compensation activities (promotions, market adjustments, annual merit, and incentive planning) - Help implement engagement and “Great Place to Work” improvement initiatives, including DEI and wellbeing efforts - Deliver/facilitate training and working sessions to improve manager effectiveness and team dynamics What we’re looking for - HR Business Partner experience required; ideally 8–10+ years of overall HR experience - Experience in a complex, matrixed environment (global experience strongly preferred) - Demonstrated success in change management and organizational development (restructuring experience is a plus) - Strong business acumen, executive presence, and influencing skills; comfortable challenging the status quo - Excellent communication skills, including leading facilitated sessions and formal presentations - Solid knowledge of U.S. employment law - Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously - Bachelor’s degree in a related field prefer

  • Monday, Wednesday, and Friday 8am-5pm
  • Tuesday and Thursday 10am-7pm
What You’ll Be Doing:
The clinic offers primary and preventive care along with mental health, chiropractic, and physical therapy services
  • Interviews patients, measures vital signs, such as pulse rate, temperature, blood pressure, weight, and height, and records information on patients' charts
  • Prepares treatment rooms and patients for examination
  • Cleans and sterilizes instruments
  • Inventories and orders medical supplies and materials

Total on-line courses will not be accepted. Course must also meet the American Heart Association (AHA) standards but need not be an AHA certificate.

job.title: System HW Design Engineer - SI/PI
job.description:
System HW Design - SI/PI

As System HW Design Engineer- SI/PI, you will be part of the Systems Hardware Engineering Team that designs, builds, brings-up, and productizes PCB boards. This showcases our Machine Learning SoC across bring-up and debug, characterization, customer samples, and eventual production. In this role, you will define and drive SI/PI strategy across our entire MLSoC product line — spanning System-on-Module designs, PCIe add-in cards, chip-down BGA reference designs, and full development platforms. This is a significant technical contributor role that will define how signal and power integrity (SI/PI) is implemented across the hardware organization. Working with internal teams and external vendors, the role will guide PCB design, simulation, and lab validation to ensure reliable high-speed signaling and power delivery across our hardware platforms.     

Role & responsibilities:     
• Define, document (including simulation reports and design decisions),own SI/PI architecture, design guidelines, review processes, and sign-off criteria across the full product portfolio (SoM, PCIe HHHL card, chip-down BGA design, DevKit carrier, and future platforms).  
• Serve as the technical specialist on high-speed interface margin closure: PCIe Gen5 (root complex, up to 32 GT/s/lane), MIPI CSI/DSI (C-PHY/D-PHY), USB 3.x/Type-C, 10 Gigabit Ethernet SerDes, and LPDDR memory channels  
• Drive stack-up, impedance, and channel budget decisions across concurrent board programs, resolving trade-offs between cost, manufacturability, and signal margin at the product-line level  
• Own power delivery network (PDN) architecture for high-transient-current AI accelerator silicon, setting design targets and review standards used across all boards  
• Set the long-term connector/interconnect strategy across product generations (board-to-board, M.2 NVMe, PCIe edge-card interfaces)  
• Define lab validation standards and own escalation-level debug for the hardest SI/PI bring-up issues across programs  
• Own the SI/PI simulation tool strategy and flow (Ansys HFSS/SIwave, Cadence Sigrity/Clarity, Keysight ADS, or equivalent) — evaluate and select tools, and build reusable methodology assets for the team  
• Own or support compliance testing (PCIe-SIG, USB-IF, MIPI Alliance) for interfaces on production and pre-production boards  
• Engage with component/module vendors and standards bodies as needed to stay ahead of emerging high-speed interface requirements  

Minimum Requirements:    
• Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering or a related field. Master’s degree preferred with 15 years of industry experience in signal integrity and power integrity engineering for high-speed digital systems, including experience leading SI/PI strategy across multiple concurrent programs  
• Deep, demonstrated expertise with PCIe Gen4/Gen5, DDR4/DDR5/LPDDR, USB 3.x, and MIPI D-PHY/C-PHY signaling, including having driven margin closure on production designs  
• Proven track record owning PDN architecture for high-power SoCs/ASICs (AI accelerators, GPUs, or comparable compute silicon) at a product-line level  
• Expert-level proficiency with SI/PI EDA tools: Ansys HFSS/SIwave, Cadence Sigrity/Clarity, Keysight ADS, or similar, including tool selection and methodology development  
• Extensive hands-on lab validation experience — VNA, TDR, high-bandwidth oscilloscopes — and experience owning escalation-level debug  
• Expertise in PCB stack-up design, transmission line theory, S-parameters, and channel modeling.  
• Strong working knowledge of industry compliance standards (PCIe-SIG, USB-IF, MIPI Alliance)  
• Demonstrated ability to set technical direction and standards across a hardware organization, and to mentor senior/staff-level engineers  
• Good cross-functional leadership skills — comfortable driving alignment across ASIC, package, hardware, layout, and firmware teams at a strategic level  
• Knowledge of ASIC characterization, PCB manufacturing, assembly, test, quality & reliability is a plus.   

Personal Attributes:       
• Demonstrates a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and takes ownership of outcomes  
• Collaborates effectively across cross-functional teams and fosters a strong team culture  
• Intellectually curious, with a creative approach to problem-solving and technical challenges  
• Execution-focused and results-driven, with a track record of delivering under ambiguity  
• Self-motivated and highly accountable, with the ability to think strategically and drive long-term impact  
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.

job.title: Site Administrator
job.description:
Site Administrator
12+ month contract
Lubbock, TX (Onsite)

Position Summary
The Site Administrator independently coordinates day-to-day administrative services. The role owns local execution, maintains accurate records, anticipates upcoming needs, and collaborates with other sites to improve consistency.
Occasional remote assistance may be assigned within agreed capacity. A designated Site Administrator may also support IAH on an ongoing basis while developing toward a Lead role, where mutually agreed.

Key Responsibilities
Daily Site Operations
  • Prepare for expected visitors, new hires, deliveries, and scheduled badge activities.
  • Support approved visitor and badge workflows without making access-authorization decisions.
  • Coordinate PPE distribution, inventory counts, and reorder notifications.
  • Reconcile designated onsite records with Envoy/XOC or other approved systems.
  • Coordinate parking, food service, shuttle, supplies, and administrative-space needs.
  • Support executive visits, badge days, onboarding activities, and other approved events.
  • Maintain issue logs, daily handoffs, and reporting inputs.
  • Escalate missing approvals, supply gaps, process exceptions, and competing priorities.

New-Hire Readiness
  • Confirm badge, orientation, PPE, seating, and other agreed prerequisites.
  • Complete readiness checks at least two business days before the start date.
  • Notify the onsite hiring manager of missing items before arrival.
  • Track unresolved prerequisites through handoff or escalation.

Collaboration and Assigned Remote Support
  • Share useful practices and participate in agreed cross-site coordination.
  • Help maintain site-specific procedures and onboarding materials.
  • Provide remote assistance without compromising essential primary-site duties.
  • Where assigned to IAH, perform its defined food-service, readiness, and inventory-coordination tasks.
  • Guide Site Coordinators on assigned activities when designated.

Required Qualifications
  • Experience in site administration, office operations, facilities support, hospitality, logistics, or a comparable role.
  • Ability to organize daily work independently and respond to changing priorities.
  • Accurate recordkeeping and clear communication.
  • Proficiency with email, spreadsheets, collaboration tools, and administrative systems.
  • Ability to follow controlled-access procedures and recognize exceptions requiring escalation.

Preferred Experience
  • Construction, industrial, data center, or other controlled-access environments.
  • Visitor coordination, onboarding, inventory management, vendor coordination, or event support.

Working Relationships and Authority
The Site Administrator works under Yoh’s Engagement Manager, with operational direction from an assigned Lead where applicable. The role coordinates with site contacts without making them responsible for managing the Yoh resource.
The role has no default formal people-management responsibility. Access, purchasing, security, scope changes, and additional spending remain with authorized personnel.

job.title: SAFETY ENGINEER ENTRY LEVEL
job.description:
Safety Compliance Auditor (Contractor) Location: Suite 128, 25800 N Norterra Pkwy, Phoenix, AZ 85085
Work Type: 100% Onsite
Shift: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (First 6 months)
Pay Rate: $28 – $37 hour

Position Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented Safety Compliance Auditor to join our team. This role is critical in ensuring workplace safety and compliance with 6S standards within a high-tech manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have strong organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a proven commitment to maintaining a safe and compliant work environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Conduct daily audits of assigned areas or tool groups to ensure compliance with 6S standards.
  • Verify that work areas are free of hazards, and that barricading and signage are properly placed and legible.
  • Review completion of required documentation (Pre-Task Plans, LOTO tags, interlock defeat tags) for compliance.
  • Validate that LOTO devices and interlock defeat tags match Pre-Task Plan documents and are correctly installed.
  • Communicate unresolved issues or violations to the Ramp Safety Coordinator (RSC).
  • Document and report findings and corrective actions at the end of each shift using provided templates.
  • Participate in incident investigations as needed.
  • Maintain a professional attitude when interacting with internal teams and customer staff.
  • Spend approximately 80% of time on the fab floor, requiring extended periods of standing and walking.
Requirements
  • OSHA 30 Certification (or higher) – Mandatory.
  • Strong organizational and reporting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills for internal and external interactions.
  • Ability to work in a physically demanding environment.
Additional Details
  • Contract Role
  • Must be able to work onsite full-time.
  • Professional demeanor and adherence to safety protocols are essential.

Location: Amelia, OH 
Schedule: 2 days onsite per week (Tuesday & Wednesday)

Position Summary

We are seeking an Accounting Analyst t to support two Senior Accountants with month-end close, reconciliations, commission accounting, and financial reporting activities. This role is ideal for someone with strong Excel skills, a solid accounting foundation, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Assist with month-end close activities, journal entries, and account reconciliations
  • Prepare and analyze financial results for key business partners

  • Experience with SAP

  • Experience creating and maintaining process documentation

job.title: Site Administrator - Snyder
job.description:
Site Administrator
12+ month contract
Snyder, TX (Onsite)

Position Summary
The Site Administrator independently coordinates day-to-day administrative services. The role owns local execution, maintains accurate records, anticipates upcoming needs, and collaborates with other sites to improve consistency.
Occasional remote assistance may be assigned within agreed capacity. A designated Site Administrator may also support IAH on an ongoing basis while developing toward a Lead role, where mutually agreed.

Key Responsibilities
Daily Site Operations
  • Prepare for expected visitors, new hires, deliveries, and scheduled badge activities.
  • Support approved visitor and badge workflows without making access-authorization decisions.
  • Coordinate PPE distribution, inventory counts, and reorder notifications.
  • Reconcile designated onsite records with Envoy/XOC or other approved systems.
  • Coordinate parking, food service, shuttle, supplies, and administrative-space needs.
  • Support executive visits, badge days, onboarding activities, and other approved events.
  • Maintain issue logs, daily handoffs, and reporting inputs.
  • Escalate missing approvals, supply gaps, process exceptions, and competing priorities.

New-Hire Readiness
  • Confirm badge, orientation, PPE, seating, and other agreed prerequisites.
  • Complete readiness checks at least two business days before the start date.
  • Notify the onsite hiring manager of missing items before arrival.
  • Track unresolved prerequisites through handoff or escalation.

Collaboration and Assigned Remote Support
  • Share useful practices and participate in agreed cross-site coordination.
  • Help maintain site-specific procedures and onboarding materials.
  • Provide remote assistance without compromising essential primary-site duties.
  • Where assigned to IAH, perform its defined food-service, readiness, and inventory-coordination tasks.
  • Guide Site Coordinators on assigned activities when designated.

Required Qualifications
  • Experience in site administration, office operations, facilities support, hospitality, logistics, or a comparable role.
  • Ability to organize daily work independently and respond to changing priorities.
  • Accurate recordkeeping and clear communication.
  • Proficiency with email, spreadsheets, collaboration tools, and administrative systems.
  • Ability to follow controlled-access procedures and recognize exceptions requiring escalation.

Preferred Experience
  • Construction, industrial, data center, or other controlled-access environments.
  • Visitor coordination, onboarding, inventory management, vendor coordination, or event support.

Working Relationships and Authority
The Site Administrator works under Yoh’s Engagement Manager, with operational direction from an assigned Lead where applicable. The role coordinates with site contacts without making them responsible for managing the Yoh resource.
The role has no default formal people-management responsibility. Access, purchasing, security, scope changes, and additional spending remain with authorized personnel.

job.title: Nurse Practitioner - Corporate Health
job.description:
Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner needed for a full-time, hybrid, contract-to-hire opportunity supporting Yoh’s well-known corporate office client based in Downtown Los Angeles, CA. 
  • Work 9:00am to 5:00pm onsite 3 days/week in Downtown LA (including alternating Wednesdays & Fridays); telemedicine on non-clinic days
  • Travel required to Century City when needed, in addition to San Diego, Orange County, and San Francisco (frequency TBD - likely monthly for SoCal and quarterly for NorCal).

This is a newly created position joining an established onsite medical clinic team that already includes a Nurse Practitioner, Physical Therapists, and Mental Health Counselors. You'll serve as the highest level of medical care for a high-performing workforce of 700+ employees. Must be comfortable working autonomously as you will likely be solo onsite, alternating with the other NP.


Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active Nurse Practitioner (FNP/ANP) license in state of California
  • Current prescription authority
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a provider
  • Previous experience in Occupational/Employee Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Corrections, Primary Care, Internal Medicine, or Family Practice
  • Comfortable performing blood draws
  • Prior experience with telehealth

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Injury/illness triage and treatment
  • Immunizations and travel vaccines
  • Perform onsite physical assessments (pre-placement, return-to-work, fitness-for-duty)
  • Ambulatory care (sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.)
  • Onsite testing for strep, UTI, influenza, hyperglycemia/hypoglycemia
  • Dispense OTC medications (back pain, headache, pharyngitis)
  • Phlebotomy

What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse license in California
  • National Certification (ANCC or AANP)
  • Current BLS/CPR (AHA or Red Cross)
  • NPI
  • Annual TB Test or QuantiFERON Gold
  • Annual flu vaccine (preferred)
  • Strong computer skills; EMR experience required; Quest experience a major plus
  • Interpersonal skills to interview, teach, counsel, and interact with employees and clients

What’s In It For You?
  • Grow your experience with a trusted, well-respected organization
  • Work in a unique, rewarding environment where you make a real impact on individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Competitive compensation with weekly direct deposit every Friday


KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONAL LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY AND LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR $750 REFERRAL BONUS PROGRAM!

*Yoh Healthcare specializes in occupational/employee health and staffs healthcare professionals nationwide with well-known Fortune 500 companies. Reach out to learn about current openings for Medical Assistants, Nurses, Physician Assistants, and Nurse Practitioners.

job.title: Engineering Technician - Newburyport, MA
job.description:
Engineering Technician - 4th Shift Applied Materials | Newburyport, MA
Schedule: Friday, Saturday, and Sunday | 5:45 AM - 6:15 PM
Pay Rate: $28.00 - $32.00 per hour + 11% Shift Differential
Join Applied Materials, a global leader in semiconductor manufacturing technology. This is an exciting opportunity to work on advanced equipment and systems that help produce the semiconductor chips powering artificial intelligence, smartphones, cloud computing, medical devices, and next-generation technologies worldwide. Key Responsibilities
  • Perform routine to moderately complex electro-mechanical technical functions including testing, checkout, fabrication, modification, troubleshooting, and assembly activities.
  • Test and troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum, and subsystem-level issues.
  • Support new system installations, NPI activities, and field upgrades.
  • Work from schematics, diagrams, layouts, written instructions, and verbal directions.
  • Compile logbooks, test records, and technical documentation using strong written communication skills.
  • Perform mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, vacuum, and process testing to Applied Materials specifications.
  • Follow all safety procedures and maintain a clean, healthy, and secure work environment.
  • Assist with process improvements and problem resolution activities.
  • Perform rework activities as needed and generate Quality Notifications.
Why Applied Materials? Applied Materials is one of the most respected companies in the semiconductor industry and a technology leader whose equipment is used by the world’s largest chip manufacturers. Employees gain exposure to advanced manufacturing processes, cutting-edge technologies, continuous learning opportunities, and a collaborative culture focused on innovation and quality. Why Work with Yoh? Yoh partners with leading companies to connect talented professionals with exceptional career opportunities. As a Yoh employee, you may be eligible for competitive compensation, medical benefits, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) participation, referral bonuses, weekly pay, and dedicated recruiter support throughout the hiring process and assignment. Your Yoh Recruiter Patty Vogel
Principal Recruiter, Yoh Staffing Services

Patty has extensive experience supporting semiconductor and advanced manufacturing organizations and is committed to helping candidates navigate the hiring process from application through onboarding and beyond.

job.title: NE Administrative Operations & Support Manager
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Administrative Operations & Support Manager opportunity with a trusted client located in Waltham, MA. 

Position Overview
This individual will be responsible for supporting Yoh and Client project initiatives. It is expected that this individual will have a 90% onsite presence.
The Admin Operations & Support Assoc. will function in the capacity of an onsite Yoh representative, to include assistance with resources, employees, and to ensure daily continuity of business and operation. Initial training and instruction will be provided by existing Yoh management and Yoh Sr. Management.
It is expected that the Admin Operation & Support Assoc. will support the current Yoh Manager, and while gaining, fostering the client relationship become familiar with the Yoh onboarding process, site training requirements, and the daily operations of the Yoh staff.

Administrative & Operational ResponsibilitiesThis individual will be responsible for:
  • Maintaining Yoh email distribution list(s).
  • Updating and enhancing the Yoh open positions spreadsheet.
  • Updating the monthly changes spreadsheet.
  • Maintaining the Yoh Recognition Awards program at our client site.
  • The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for maintaining the absence (Discretionary Leave, FMLA, and absence Spreadsheet).
Client & Organizational Communications
The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for communications within the organizational structure of our client, and have some limited responsibility to other sites and departments which contain Yoh employees.
This individual will have the responsibility to liaison between Yoh D&Z and our employees as it relates to creating BetterNet Tickets, & Yoh Portal Issues, and working out employee concerns with Yoh PA office management.
This individual will be responsible for informing Yoh Management of any escalatory situations within the Yoh organization and our it’s employees.

Candidates & Open Positions
The Yoh AO & S Mgr. will function as liaison to all departments in respect to Yoh candidates and open positions. This requires keeping spreadsheets up to date and potentially in a state of presentation ready as requested by the client.
The goal of this presentation is to provide a weekly (as necessary & dependent upon openings) but on a proactive basis.
In theory, we should keep the client up to date so that they don’t need to ask for information because we proactively provide it to them.

Work Ethic & Communication
This individual will have a strong and collaborative work ethic, be results oriented and demonstrate a focus on achieving (business) results.
The AO & S Mgr. will have strong written and oral communication skills, with demonstrated experience managing multiple communications. Progressively onsite and presenting / representing the Yoh business function.

Financial & Confidential Information
Financial responsibility will be minimal within this position; however, they may have exposure to sensitive information and understand that the information is to remain confidential.

Meeting Coordination
Facilitate meetings through issuance of meeting agendas. Track and follow up on action items and determine what action items need to be addressed.

Microsoft Office Skills
The AO & S Mgr. will have excellent knowledge in all aspects of MS Office including MS Project, Excel, Sharepoint and MS Teams.

New Yoh Employee Program & Onboarding
This individual supports and within time take over the new Yoh employee program:
  • Setting up and scheduling new candidates for Meet and Greet sessions.
  • Providing feedback to the Yoh recruiters.
  • Liaison information between our team and the client.
This individual will be the come to person for onboarding new employees, from ensuring they are enrolled in NHO and are met upon release from NHO.

Benefits, Timekeeping & HR
This individual will be required to learn about the Yoh benefits, programs, and functionality of the Yoh time keeping system.
They will be required to assist in making sure that Yoh employees enter their time as required.
Have knowledge of HR process and procedures and work with Yoh HR and Employee Relations.

job.title: Materials Coordinator - Miami - Weekend/Part Time/AM
job.description:
Materials Coordinator - Mesa/Part Time Weekend Graveyard Shift

Days/Shift Hours: 
Saturday and Sunday, 12-hour shifts.
6AM-6PM.

Scope:
• Handle the following – Receive, unpack, check & verify merchandise/product ensuring accuracy.
• As needed take receiving exceptions.
• Utilize handheld RF tools to receive merchandise/products into WMS.
• Conduct the following – Stock checks, part # verification, Cycle Count, support physical inventory.
• Consolidate loads as required – Pack, Re-Pack, wrap product for shipping.
• Label parts during put away, picking or shipping process.
• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, etc.
• Ensure orders/shipping materials are accompanied with proper delivery docs: Revised BOL, Manual tag, Packing slip, etc.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures & safety guidelines.
• Perform organization tasks to maintain a clean/safe work environment.
• Cross train to learn other warehouse functions.
• Fill requisitions, work orders, or requests for materials, tools, or stock items & distribute items to production workers or assembly line.
• Always maintain accuracy, provide required reports, measurements, and logs to KPI guidelines.
• Expertise utilizing a warehouse ERP inventory system, Excel, shipping, receiving, safety management, materials handling, data entry, reporting, etc.

Required:
• Experience in the automotive industry in some fashion. Examples are Associates in automotive parts specialist, wholesale parts at dealerships, parts to service, body shop work, military, large automobile manufacturers, etc.
• Experienced in positions such as – parts advisor, parts specialist, inventory technician, materials handlers, parts coordinator, etc.
• Experience with a DMS (Dealer Management System) – CDK, Reynolds and Reynolds, Oracle JDE, Lightspeed, etc. (SAP experience would be great but not required).
• Experience and comfortability working around technicians.
• Experience and ability working with pallet jacks - Forklifts are not required.
• Experience with basic supply chain skills.
• Experience putting together spreadsheets and tables.
• Willing to put in extra work during down times by organizing the shop, stacking tires, disposing of tires, picking up deliveries, etc.
• Must be comfortable working as a team.

job.title: Senior Buyer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Senior Buyer to join our client’s team in Rancho Cordova, CA to lead complex purchasing, procurement, and strategic sourcing activities in support of major capital projects and ongoing business operations.

This role will play a critical part in supporting the construction and development of a new manufacturing facility, overseeing the procurement of capital equipment, industrial materials, construction components, and project-related services.
The ideal candidate must have a strong background in industrial purchasing and capital equipment procurement, with demonstrated experience supporting large-scale capital projects, facility expansions, or industrial construction initiatives. Experience within chemical manufacturing, industrial construction, engineering, or similar industrial environments is highly relevant.

This position requires a highly independent, results-driven procurement professional with exceptional negotiation skills and demonstrated experience managing high-value purchases, developing supplier relationships, and negotiating complex commercial agreements, including million-dollar purchase orders.

Industry: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
Location: On-site in Rancho Cordova, CA
Pay: $51-58/hr
Type: 6 months with possibility of extension 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:
  • Lead strategic sourcing and procurement activities for major capital projects, ensuring competitive pricing, quality, and timely delivery.
  • Manage the purchasing of industrial equipment, capital assets, construction materials, mechanical systems, and facility-related services.
  • Source and procure equipment such as vessels, boilers, piping, valves, fittings, structural components, temperature control units, controllers, and air handling systems.
  • Negotiate complex, high-value purchase orders and supplier contracts, including transactions valued at $1 million or more.
  • Develop sourcing strategies, evaluate supplier proposals, conduct competitive bid reviews, and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, contractors, and service providers.
  • Monitor supplier lead times, procurement schedules, and delivery commitments to support aggressive project timelines.
  • Partner with engineering, construction, project management, and operations teams to coordinate purchasing requirements and resolve procurement challenges.
  • Procure project-related services, including construction, calibration, waste management, janitorial, and facility support services.
  • Participate in capital project teams and cross-functional initiatives, representing the Purchasing department.
  • Manage supplier contracts, commercial terms, and procurement documentation in accordance with company policies and procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to improve purchasing processes, sourcing strategies, and procurement efficiencies.
  • Utilize procurement systems and technology to manage sourcing activities, evaluate bids, and support purchasing decisions.
  • Provide guidance and mentoring to other purchasing team members as needed.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable safety, health, environmental, and quality requirements

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
  • 9-13 years of related experience with a bachelor's degree, 7-11 years of related experience with a master's degree, or equivalent experience.
  • Extensive experience in purchasing, procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management.
  • MUST HAVE: Demonstrated industrial purchasing and capital equipment procurement experience.
  • Hands-on experience sourcing and purchasing industrial equipment, capital assets, mechanical systems, construction materials, and facility-related products and services.
  • Significant experience supporting large-scale capital projects, facility expansions, or industrial construction projects.
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex, high-value purchase orders and supplier agreements, including million-dollar transactions.
  • Experience managing supplier relationships, contracts, commercial negotiations, and procurement schedules.
  • Experience within chemical manufacturing, industrial construction, engineering, or other industrial environments is essential.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; an equivalent combination of education and extensive relevant hands-on procurement experience will be considered.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
  • The successful candidate will be an established industrial procurement professional with a proven track record of purchasing capital equipment and managing complex procurement activities for large-scale industrial or manufacturing projects.
  • Candidates must have hands-on experience sourcing industrial equipment and materials, negotiating high-value purchase orders, working with engineering and construction teams, and managing strategic supplier relationships.
  • Industrial purchasing and capital equipment procurement experience are mandatory requirements for this position.

job.title: Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing Technician-Billerica,MA
job.description:
Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing echnician needed for an 18-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Billerica, Massachusetts.


Pay Rate: $40 to $45 per hour



Monday-Friday First shift 7:30am-4pm (40 hours a week)




The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change


What You Will Be Doing:
  • Use work orders (including schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and instructions) to build, repair and/or test equipment of various kinds (electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies and components)
  • Perform a wide variety of electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting and repairs
  • Receive parts and perform audits to ensure all necessary parts are available and free of defects
  • Use test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors and/or vacuum pumps to test assemblies, subassemblies and components
  • Complete required job documentation (data entry) about progress, work expense and labor details
  • Perform computer programming, repair or software installs, as needed
  • Work closely with engineering on developing and proposing new processes and procedures, and provide input on new product design and integration
  • Provide training and support to lower-level technicians; assist supervisor in aligning resources for daily production needs
  • Serve as a Quality Lead for processes, as needed; assist with quality issues at customer sites and provide feedback to improve manufacturing processes



What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • A Bachelor degree or technical degree
  • 2–4 years of semiconductor or display experience, or comparable industry or military experience
  • Related technical trainings and certifications
  • Solid analytical skills, and an ability to problem-solve using established operating procedures or scientific methods?
  • Demonstrated capability to operate as a peer leader and trainer
  • Demonstrated proficiency for required semiconductor manufacturing concepts and processes
  • ASSEET
  • BSEET (DeVry, TSTC)


Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
  • This is a physically demanding position that often requires standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, the use of hand and power tools, and driving or operating heavy machinery including forklifts.
  • Additionally, because this position may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.

job.title: Electrical Engineer - PM (2-10:30PM)
job.description:
Electrical Engineering Services - PM (2-10:30PM)

Scope:
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex electrical issues on autonomous vehicles.
• Perform root-cause analysis and drive issues to resolution, including cross-team collaboration.
• Support the bring-up and validation of autonomous vehicle systems.
• Design, execute, and analyze electrical tests.
• Develop, maintain, and improve electrical documentation and test procedures.
• Collaborate with hardware, software, and systems engineers to ensure successful project execution.
 
Required:
• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or related field.
• 3+ years of experience in electrical engineering, troubleshooting, or validation.
• Strong understanding of electrical systems, circuits, and components.
• Experience with electrical diagnostic tools (multimeter, oscilloscope, CAN diagnostics).
• Familiarity with software diagnostic tools (command line interfaces, interpreting log files).
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a focus on root-cause analysis.
• Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams.
• Strong communication and technical documentation skills.
• Comfortable using standard business tools (spreadsheets, email, documentation tools).
• Willing and able to travel for medium durations as needed.
 
Pluses:
• 5+ years of experience in electrical engineering or related field.
• Automotive familiarity (wiring harnesses, module diagnostics/troubleshooting).
• Linux OS familiarity (hands on experience, programming/ coding).
• Experience working with API development, evaluation, or testing.
• Experience with autonomous or electric vehicles.
• Experience with prototype or early-stage development engineering projects.
• Experience working in manufacturing, validation, or vehicle bring-up environments.

job.title: Sr User Experience Designer
job.description:
W2 only candidates ONLY

Senior User Experience Designer
Req #: 112600-1
Location: Mclean, VA, hybrid 3x/week (Richmond and NYC will be considered)
Duration: Approximately 3 months (maternity backfill) however other positions may be available at end of assignment

Notes:
  • Portfolio required
  • Enterprise Platforms LOB.  Supporting large scale enterprise risk management/governance platform that client uses to manage risk across the org, 19K users, one of the largest internal applications with complex workflows
    • Core platform horizontal interfaces across the enterprise, dashboard views, data tables, set of functionalities across the org horizontally, designing experiences where AI model is evaluating inputs and offering suggestions
  • Team
    • 8 total members, will work directly with manager and 2 other designers
  • Able to work with ambiguity and cross functional user base – manager mentioned ambiguity a few times, so this ability is critical
  • AI tooling is highly preferred as the other designers are utilizing these tools – Claude code used extensively as primary design tool, along with Figma MCP
  • Portfolio:  clarity in storytelling and how they work through problems, need to include artifacts not just final product. 

Position Overview
  • We are seeking a Senior User Experience Designer to support the design of enterprise applications and data-dense user interfaces. The ideal candidate will bring strong UX/UI design expertise, service design thinking, and experience creating intuitive solutions for complex, multi-step workflows.
  • This role will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders, conduct user research, contribute to design systems, and document design decisions and processes. Candidates should be comfortable working in collaborative environments and using modern AI tools to enhance their design workflow.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design intuitive, scalable user experiences for enterprise applications and data-dense interfaces.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, user flows, journey maps, and high-fidelity designs.
  • Apply workflow and service design principles to complex, multi-step user journeys.
  • Conduct user research and gather feedback from relevant audiences.
  • Translate research findings and business requirements into effective design solutions.
  • Utilize, extend, and help improve existing design systems.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, business stakeholders, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Clearly document design decisions, user research findings, workflows, requirements, and recommendations.
  • Present design concepts and effectively communicate rationale to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Use AI tools such as Claude Code, Google Gemini, and MCP to support research, ideation, documentation, and design-related workflows.
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative working environment through strong communication and emotional intelligence.

Required Qualifications
  • Senior-level experience in UX/UI design for enterprise applications or complex digital products.
  • Demonstrated experience designing data-dense interfaces.
  • Strong understanding of user-centered design, workflow design, service design, and journey mapping.
  • Experience conducting user research with target audiences.
  • Experience working with and augmenting established design systems.
  • Proficiency with Figma and Google Workspace.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and documentation skills.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management abilities.
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to build effective working relationships.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude Code, Google Gemini, MCP, or comparable technologies.

Portfolio Requirement
Candidates must provide a portfolio demonstrating comparable UX/UI work, particularly examples involving enterprise applications, data-dense interfaces, complex workflows, service design, or multi-step user journeys.

job.title: Biopharma QA Doc Control
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Document Control Support Contractor in Bristol, PA.    The individual will be responsible for assisting the Quality Assurance department with routine document management activities to ensure GMP documentation is organized, accurate, and properly controlled.  The contractor will work closely with QA staff to maintain compliance with site procedures and regulatory expectations.

Position: QA Doc Control - Biopharma 
Duration: 3 month contract
Pay: $30-$40/hr DOE 
Industry: Biopharma/pharmaceutical/biotech


Responsibilities
  • Maintain physical filing systems for QA documentation, including scanning, filing, archiving, and retrieval of controlled records.
  • Issue controlled copies of GMP documents following established document control procedures.
  • Support organization and archival activities for controlled documents, logbooks, forms, and training records.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and legibility of documents prior to filing or issuance.
  • Maintain logs and trackers associated with document issuance and filing activities.
  • Assist with the review of documents for formatting and compliance with document control expectations.
  • Prepare and organize new GMP logbooks for issuance; collect completed logbooks for archival.
  • Support QA team members with routine document control tasks as assigned.
  • Escalate issues or discrepancies to QA leadership in a timely and appropriate manner.
  • Ensure all activities are performed in accordance with GMP, ALCOA principles, and site Quality procedures.

Qualifications/ Skills Required:
  • High school diploma required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Experience working in a GMP or regulated environment preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling documents and records.
  • Ability to follow written procedures and maintain compliance with document control standards.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

job.title: Color Cosmetic Formulation Scientist
job.description:
Our client, a Cosmetic Manufacturer that specializes in personal care products located in Southern California, a hub for the beauty industry, is actively looking to add a Color Cosmetic Formulation Scientist to their team:

Industry: Cosmetics
Type: Direct Hire
Shift: Monday-Friday: 8:00am-5:00pm

KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 
  • Develop new formulas and reverse engineered formula based on customer’s briefs and price target.
  • Reformulate and improve existing formulas.
  • Follow new trends closely with new products launches, ingredients and new concept such as “free from” claims.
  • Be familiar with the formulation restrictions using these claims.
  • Be familiar with cosmetic ingredient especially their function, delivery system, interaction depending of media/base.
  • Meet with suppliers and keep product files (clinical and regulatory).
  • Work on Innovation, create new textures, concepts, actives to keep our R&D with cutting edge formulation.
  • Help creating marketing sheet to present to our customers in innovation seminars.
  • Request raw material pricing and input in our pricing matrix.
  • Evaluation/Selection/Advice regarding testing; Claims, Safety, Microbiology.
  • Assist Regulatory department requesting all the necessary ingredient information.
  • Be flexible with project priorities as they vary from time to time and manage a large workload under tight timeline.
  • Be able to make decisions to troubleshoot production or compounding.
  • Improve and/or revise manufacturing/filling process if needed.
  • Work closely with our chemists to help on challenging projects or when needed.
  • Work closely with our Quality department to improve knowledge about new formulas, establishing standards.
  • Maintain the laboratory clean and organized, respecting GLP’s.
 QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor of Science or higher degree in chemistry or related field.
  • Color formulation experience.
  • Creative thinking, technical writing and organizational skills.
  • At least 6 years and more of industry experience on the bench formulating.
  • Knowledge of cosmetic/personal care raw materials, functionality, and interactions.
  • Understanding of emulsion and surfactant technology as well as general formulation techniques.
  • Must be familiar with regulation for US market and other countries for globally approved formulas, especially for the natural and organic market (NSF, USDA/NOP, NPA).

job.title: Software Development Engineer - eCommerce
job.description:
Front-end React .NET Developer
6 month contract to hire
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
Ready to help build something from the ground up?
We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer to play a key role in the development of a new, modern B2B customer portal.
This is an opportunity to work on a highly visible platform built on a custom, cloud-based architecture using React, TypeScript, C#, Azure, .NET Core, and Microsoft SQL Server.

You’ll work closely with product owners, architects, program managers, and Agile development teams to design and deliver secure, scalable, high-performing solutions supporting customers and locations nationwide.
This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys hands-on development, solving complex technical challenges, and helping shape a platform built for long-term growth.

What You’ll Do
  • Design and develop responsive, high-performance B2B web applications using React and TypeScript.
  • Build backend services, business logic, and integrations using C#, .NET 8+, and RESTful APIs.
  • Contribute to the ground-up development of a new customer portal platform.
  • Implement secure identity and access solutions using Microsoft Entra ID and Entra External ID.
  • Apply security-first development practices, including secure coding, authorization, data protection, and applicable PCI requirements.
  • Develop customer and store-association logic that maintains appropriate data-access boundaries.
  • Design, query, and optimize Microsoft SQL Server databases and data models.
  • Develop and support event-driven data synchronization using SQL Server Service Broker and related integration patterns.
  • Integrate the portal with ERP, CRM, and other enterprise systems.
  • Build solutions designed for high-volume workloads, scalability, resiliency, performance, and observability.
  • Use Git-based development practices, including branching, pull requests, peer reviews, and continuous integration.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, technical design, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with business and technology teams to evaluate requirements, technical trade-offs, and solutions.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of software development experience.
  • Strong React web development experience, including component design, hooks, state management, responsive design, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Extensive C# and modern .NET development experience; .NET 8 or later is required.
  • Strong Microsoft SQL Server experience, including relational data modeling, complex queries, indexing, performance tuning, and data integrity.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating distributed enterprise systems.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative source-control workflows.
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment.
  • Proven ability to design, troubleshoot, and optimize scalable applications supporting high-volume workloads.
  • Strong understanding of secure application development, authorization, data-access boundaries, and identity-driven access control.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organization, initiative, accountability, and sense of urgency.
  • Ability to learn, support, and enhance event-driven, object-oriented systems.
Preferred Qualifications
  • .NET 10 experience.
  • Microsoft Azure and cloud-native application development experience.
  • Microsoft Entra ID and/or Entra External ID experience.
  • Salesforce integration or platform transition experience.
  • Microsoft SQL Server Service Broker, asynchronous messaging, or event-driven synchronization experience.
  • ERP integration or extension experience.
  • Experience within wholesale distribution or another decentralized, multi-location business environment.

job.description:
Electrical Engineering Services - AM Shift 

Scope:
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex electrical issues on autonomous vehicles.
• Perform root-cause analysis and drive issues to resolution, including cross-team collaboration.
• Support the bring-up and validation of autonomous vehicle systems.
• Design, execute, and analyze electrical tests.
• Develop, maintain, and improve electrical documentation and test procedures.
• Collaborate with hardware, software, and systems engineers to ensure successful project execution.

• Familiarity with software diagnostic tools (command line interfaces, interpreting log files).
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a focus on root-cause analysis.
• Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams.
• Strong communication and technical documentation skills.
• Comfortable using standard business tools (spreadsheets, email, documentation tools).
• Willing and able to travel for medium durations as needed.
 
Pluses:
• 5+ years of experience in electrical engineering or related field.
• Automotive familiarity (wiring harnesses, module diagnostics/troubleshooting).
• Linux OS familiarity (hands on experience, programming/ coding).
• Experience working with API development, evaluation, or testing.
• Experience with autonomous or electric vehicles.
• Experience with prototype or early-stage development engineering projects.
• Experience working in manufacturing, validation, or vehicle bring-up environments.

job.title: Director/ Senior Director of Engineering
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Director/ Senior Director of Engineering for our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing client in St. Louis, Missouri. This role will lead capital projects and engineering initiatives across North American operations, working closely with teams in Operations, Facilities, R&D, EHS, and other departments.

The position is responsible for managing capital budgets, overseeing project planning and execution, and ensuring projects meet scope, schedule, and budget objectives. Key responsibilities include developing capital project strategies, managing engineering teams, coordinating equipment design and contractor selection, and overseeing facility improvements and new product development projects. The individual will also provide regular project updates and performance reports to senior leadership.

Title: Director/ Senior Director of Engineering
Duration: Direct Hire
Pay: $175,000 - 220,000 DOE
Locations: STL
Shift: M-F 8-5pm

Job Functions:
  • Provide leadership to strategic and Maintenance of Business projects cross-functionally, partnering with key internal and external stakeholders.
  •  Interact with leadership team members and their respective functions to establish the capital budget, set capital priorities, and execute on capital requirements.
  • Closely work with portfolio management, R&D, PMO and site focus factory management.
  • Work with the engineering and PMO groups during concept phase to provide scoping, scheduling, and cost information for capital requirements for new products.
  • Conduct field inspections during implementation and installation of capital equipment for all New Product Development and Maintenance of Business projects.
  • Coordinate and organize meetings and provide input for site specific meetings such as Town hall meetings and the site monthly report out meetings.
  • Provide support to capital project managers.
  • Lead the upkeep and development of equipment standards on site.
Education and Experience Requirements:
  • Bachelor Degree in engineering or related experience.  Advanced degrees preferred
  • 15 or more years of experience in capital project management, including experience with Pharmaceutical or related industry capital projects.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing both department budgets as well as organizational capital budgets..
  • Experience in capital estimating.
  • Experience leading a group of pharmaceutical professionals and engineers, with focus on skills and performance development.

job.title: Lab Assistant -Buffer Prep
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Lab Assistant contractor to help support the bioconjugation team in Bristol, PA.   The Lab Assistant provides support to analysts to ensure testing needs can be completed in a timely manner by maintaining lab supplies, equipment, and materials.

Position:  Lab Assistant 
Location: Bristol, PA 
Duration: 3 months possible extension or conversion
Schedule:  M-F 7:30 - 4:30pm 
Pay:  $21-24/hr DOE 

Responsibilities
  • Performs daily checks and calibrations of equipment (e.g. balances, storage chambers).
  • Prepare cleaning solutions for laboratory use. Clean and maintain areas of the laboratory and equipment as needed.
  • Perform routine cleaning following proper procedures for equipment such as biosafety cabinets, incubators, water baths, etc.
  • Daily monitoring and restocking of laboratory supplies and chemicals; ensure proper cycling of supplies (first in first out) and monitor supply expiration dates.
  • Orders and receives samples, lab chemicals, and consumable materials/supplies; maintains inventory of received materials and ensures accuracy of information entered.
  • Prepares buffers and solutions used in the lab; cleans lab glassware and instruments used in reagent preparation.
  • Prepares and labels aliquots of samples and reagents.
  • Records laboratory activities in logbooks and lab notebook by following current good documentation practices (cGDP).
  • Assists with maintenance of laboratory equipment list and perform periodic equipment inventory.
  • Assists with periodic lab-wide cleaning schedule for refrigerators and freezer defrosts; assist with disposal of materials and organization of refrigerator/freezer shelves.
  • Setup and transfer materials for shipping to external clients and across internal sites.
  • Maintains laboratory 5S organization, perform additional duties as needed.

Qualifications:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent, AA/AS or BA/BS in chemistry, biology, or related field preferred.
  • Familiarity with analytical, chemical, or biological laboratory environment.
  • Ability to utilize email, word processing, and spreadsheet software.
  • Good oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

job.title: Sr Serverless DevOps Engineer (100% remote MST/CST/EST)
job.description:
*** THIS IS A DIRECT HIRE ROLE - NO THIRD PARTIES APPLY ****

Senior Serverless DevOps Engineer
Full-time (Direct Hire)
Location: 100% Remote (candidates must reside/work in MST/CST/EST time zones)
 
Overview
We’re seeking a senior-level DevOps engineer to help design, secure, and operate an AWS-first, serverless platform supporting multiple engineering teams. This is a hands-on role with significant ownership across infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, reliability, observability, and security.
 
What You’ll Do
  • Build and maintain shared cloud infrastructure and platform services used across engineering teams
  • Design and evolve Infrastructure as Code using Terraform/Terragrunt (modular, multi-account, well-governed)
  • Develop CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred) and modern release strategies (canary/linear, blue/green, automated testing)
  • Support and optimize serverless/event-driven systems (AWS Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, Step Functions)
  • Implement least-privilege IAM and security best practices (Secrets Manager, KMS, encryption in transit/at rest)
  • Improve observability and debugging (CloudWatch, Logs Insights, alarms, X-Ray/ServiceLens, structured logging)
  • Partner cross-functionally with software and data engineering to troubleshoot, unblock, and improve delivery velocity
  • Participate in code reviews, quality gates, and Agile ceremonies (standups, planning, refinement)
 
Required Experience / Skills
  • 7–10+ years in DevOps, software engineering, and/or systems administration (hands-on)
  • Strong AWS experience, including serverless production workloads
  • Strong Terraform experience; Terragrunt experience highly preferred - CI/CD pipeline ownership experience (GitHub Actions preferred; comparable tools considered)
  • Scripting/automation in Python and/or Node.js plus Bash
  • Solid fundamentals in cloud networking and security (VPC, subnets, security groups, NAT, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, IAM)
  • Containerization knowledge (Docker; Lambda container images and/or Fargate for longer-running workloads)
  • Familiarity with data-layer operations (DynamoDB, S3 lifecycle, Aurora Serverless)
  • Experience supporting organizations implementing multi-account governance (e.g., Control Tower concepts)
  • Comfort using AI-assisted developer tools (e.g., Copilot/Claude/Codex) to accelerate delivery

job.title: Lead Solution Architect, Cloud, DevSecOps & Platform Engineering
job.description:
Lead Solution Architect (AWS & Azure)
Direct Hire
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Technical Strategy
  • Define and own the target-state architecture for cloud, infrastructure, and platform engineering environments across AWS and Azure.
  • Design scalable, resilient, and secure reference architectures for networking, storage, identity, and container/orchestration platforms.
  • Establish architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails for infrastructure-as-code, cloud landing zones, and platform services.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud, infrastructure, and platform technologies and provide recommendations to modernize the technology stack.
  • Lead architecture reviews and governance forums to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and long-term strategy.
  • Architect and guide the evolution of CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices across the organization, leveraging tools such as Azure DevOps, Harness, and GitLab.
  • Define the architecture for embedding security into the software development lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, and vulnerability management tooling.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams to design self-service infrastructure, automation, and developer enablement capabilities.
  • Champion policy-as-code, secure configuration management, and compliance automation across cloud and platform environments.
  • Define architecture and standards for observability and monitoring using tools such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and Datadog.
  • Guide the design of monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks to improve reliability and reduce time to detect and resolve issues.
  • Champion site reliability engineering (SRE) principles, including SLIs/SLOs and proactive capacity and performance planning, across architecture decisions.
  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a team of architects and engineers, fostering technical growth and career development.
  • Set team goals, manage performance, and create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, application development, and business stakeholders to align architecture decisions with business priorities.
  • Communicate architecture strategy, trade-offs, and risk clearly to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor relationships and evaluate third-party tools and platforms that support the architecture roadmap.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field required.
  • AWS and/or Azure architecture certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) strongly preferred.
  • Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+) and/or Kubernetes certifications a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure, or platform engineering, including 3+ years in a people leadership or management role.
  • Deep hands-on expertise designing and implementing solutions on AWS and Azure, including compute, networking, storage, and identity services.
  • Proven experience architecting DevSecOps pipelines using Azure DevOps, Harness, and/or GitLab, including embedded SAST and DAST security scanning.
  • Strong experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and/or Datadog.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation) and container/orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Proven track record influencing enterprise architecture decisions and driving alignment across cross-functional and executive stakeholders.  
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, secure SDLC, and cloud security best practices.
  • Ability to balance strategic architecture vision with hands-on technical depth.
  • Ability to influence and drive alignment across engineering, security, and business stakeholders.
  • Business acumen in technology transformation and cloud cost management

job.title: Director of Defense
job.description:
Director of Defense (Defense Aviation Sales & Business Development) — On-site | Wichita, KS Help shape the future of defense aviation by driving sales strategy, business development, and contract acquisitions supporting U.S. military, DoD, Intelligence Community, and federal customers. In this role, you’ll build trusted customer relationships, navigate complex procurement environments, and lead growth programs that make a real mission impact.

Overview: As the Director of Defense, you will own and execute strategy to expand defense-market opportunities, pursuing and managing contracts while partnering across teams to deliver service and product programs. This is an on-site position in Wichita, Kansas, with up to 50% travel.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop and implement a strategic business plan for defense-focused groups.
  • Build and maintain relationships with military, DoD, IC, and federal government customers.
  • Navigate government procurement pathways (including OTAs, CSOs, consortiums, and FAR-based contracts), leading RFI/RFP efforts and pricing strategies.
  • Monitor federal procurement directives, compliance briefs, and defense agency priorities to keep the pipeline aligned to evolving requirements.
  • Assess competitive threats and perform competitive analysis to inform strategy.
  • Develop, review, negotiate, and manage business contracts, including Long-Term Agreements (LTAs) and Product Support Agreements (PSAs).
  • Coach, mentor, motivate, and develop direct reports.
Must-Have Qualifications:
  • U.S. citizenship (USC)
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration or related field
  • 10+ years of direct aviation experience (exposure to aviation electrical and avionics systems preferred)
  • 5+ years of direct supervisory experience
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government/DoD security clearance
  • Experience selling to government customers and defense primes; understanding of DoD acquisition processes and contracting
  • Strong program/project management, contract negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office; strong communication, organization, and attention to detail
Bring your defense-market expertise and leadership to a team that’s doing big things—apply today.

job.title: Physicians Assistant
job.description:
Physician Assistant needed for a contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s manufacturing client located near Newark, DE. This well-respected, industrial manufacturing client is seeking a Physician Assistant for a fully on-site position supporting a well-established occupational health clinic. Opportunity to convert to permanent.

Duration: ASAP-3/1 with strong probability of conversion to direct placement
Pay:  $65-88/hr, DOE

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Triage and management of work-related injuries and illnesses
  • Occupational health assessments: pre-placement/annual, return-to-work (occ & non-occ), fitness-for-duty, respirator medical evaluations (29 CFR 1910.134).

  • Active DEA registration (or eligibility)

  • Familiarity with OSHA recordkeeping and workers' compensation frameworks a plus

job.title: B2B Sales/Account Manager - Los Angeles
job.description:
B2B Sales/Account Manager - Los Angeles
Direct Hire
Los Angeles, CA
Base+Bonus+Full Benefits

A person in this role is responsible for driving new customer acquisition and incremental profitable growth within an assigned geographic market, with particular emphasis on high-density metropolitan markets and areas with significant untapped commercial opportunities.

The Market Business Development Manager is a hunter-focused outside sales position primarily accountable for identifying, prospecting, developing, and closing new B2B customers. This person builds a qualified pipeline through a combination of company-provided leads, self-generated prospecting, referrals, market intelligence, field activity, and collaboration with Territory Sales Managers (TSMs), branch teams, and Regional Sales leadership.
The Business Development Manager owns new opportunities from initial prospect identification through qualification, solution development, pricing, close, customer setup, initial activation, and successful transition to the assigned Territory Sales Manager for ongoing account management.

Experience:
  • 5+ years of progressive B2B outside sales, business development, territory development, or new-account acquisition experience preferred.
  • Experience within automotive aftermarket, heavy duty, commercial fleet, industrial, battery, parts distribution, or related B2B channels.
  • Demonstrated success prospecting and acquiring new commercial customers in a competitive B2B environment.
  • Proven ability to develop business through self-generated leads in addition to company-provided opportunities.
  • Experience managing a sales process from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation, close, and customer activation.
  • Experience selling products or services where pricing, margin, inventory availability, logistics, and service capabilities influence the customer buying decision.
  • Experience working collaboratively with territory sales, branch operations, customer service, pricing, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Experience using CRM platforms to manage prospecting activity, opportunities, pipeline, forecasting, and customer information.
