Clinical knowledge and experience in primary care, acute care, and occupational health are expected with an ability to provide comprehensive, patient-centered care across a variety of healthcare needs. Strong communication, teamwork, and clinical decision-making skills as well as exceptional customer service is a top priority, with an emphasis on creating a welcoming, respectful, and positive patient experience.
 
Schedule: Mon, Tues 6:30a-4:30p, Wed, Thurs 11a-7p, Fri 8a-12p

job.title: MS Dynamics AX / 365 Business Systems Analyst/Project Manager
job.description:
MS Dynamics AX / 365 Analyst/Developer
Direct Hire
Addison, TX (Hybrid)

We are seeking an experienced Techno-Functional Developer/Business Systems Analyst to play a key role in an upcoming Microsoft Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) migration and upgrade initiative.  Need to be able to contribute hands-on to develop test cases for testing.
 
This individual will serve as a primary liaison between internal business stakeholders, IT teams, developers, and our selected implementation partner. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience supporting or leading Dynamics AX to D365 upgrade/migration projects, with the ability to evaluate, coordinate, and implement moves, adds, changes, enhancements, configurations, and customizations within the ERP environment.
This is a permanent role that will support the organization throughout the implementation lifecycle and transition into an ongoing D365 application support, administration, enhancement, and optimization role following go-live.
We are looking to bring this individual onboard prior to project kickoff so they can gain a strong understanding of our current AX environment, business processes, integrations, data, customizations, and operational requirements.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • AX to D365 Migration & Project Delivery: Serve as an internal subject matter resource throughout the Dynamics AX to D365 F&O migration, partnering with the implementation vendor, internal IT, developers, and business stakeholders from discovery through go-live and stabilization.
  • Application Moves, Adds & Changes: Own and coordinate ongoing moves, adds, changes, enhancements, and modifications across the AX/D365 application environment. Evaluate business requests, determine system impact, document requirements, define acceptance criteria, and oversee changes through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Configuration & Customization: Evaluate whether business requirements can be addressed through standard D365 configuration, workflow changes, extensions, integrations, reporting changes, or custom development. Partner with technical resources on required customizations while helping the organization minimize unnecessary customization of the D365 platform.
  • Business & Technical Requirements: Lead requirements-gathering sessions to document current-state processes and define future-state requirements. Translate business needs into detailed functional requirements, technical requirements, user stories, process flows, and system specifications.
  • Application Enhancement Management: Manage requests for new functionality and enhancements following established change-management processes. Analyze requested changes for impacts to modules, integrations, data, security roles, workflows, reporting, and other business processes.
  • Fit-Gap & Customization Analysis: Perform fit-gap analysis between the organization's existing AX functionality and D365 capabilities. Identify which legacy AX customizations should be retained, redesigned, replaced with native D365 functionality, or retired as part of the migration.
  • Project Management & Vendor Coordination: Help manage project timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, change requests, and deliverables. Act as a knowledgeable internal advocate when working with the D365 implementation partner and challenge proposed solutions when they do not align with business or technical requirements.
  • Functional Configuration: Participate in the configuration and ongoing support of applicable D365 modules such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Inventory Management, and Warehouse Management.
  • Technical & Integration Coordination: Work closely with developers, architects, and vendors on interfaces, integrations, APIs, data entities, workflows, reports, batch processes, and custom extensions, ensuring technical solutions align with business requirements.
  • Data Migration & Mapping: Support source-to-target mapping, legacy AX data analysis, cleansing, transformation, conversion, financial reconciliation, validation, and cutover activities.
  • Testing & Release Validation: Develop and coordinate test scenarios for SIT, UAT, regression testing, and post-deployment validation. Ensure moves, adds, changes, configurations, and customizations are properly tested before being introduced into production.
  • Security & Role Changes: Partner with IT and business leadership to manage changes to D365 security roles, duties, privileges, user access, workflows, and segregation-of-duties requirements as the organization evolves.
  • Cutover & Go-Live: Support release planning, cutover, go-live readiness, deployment validation, issue resolution, and post-production hypercare.
  • Documentation & Change Management: Maintain documentation for business processes, system configurations, customizations, workflows, integrations, application changes, test results, and operating procedures.
  • Post-Go-Live Application Ownership: Following implementation, serve as a key resource for D365 application support, production issues, moves/adds/changes, configuration changes, enhancements, customizations, upgrades, release management, and continuous improvement.
 
Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX and Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
  • Experience participating in or leading an AX to D365 upgrade, migration, or transformation project.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting application moves, adds, changes, configurations, enhancements, and customizations within Dynamics AX or D365.
  • Ability to determine when a business requirement should be solved through configuration versus customization or development.
  • Experience gathering and translating requirements between business users, developers, architects, infrastructure teams, and implementation partners.
  • Strong understanding of the ERP lifecycle, including requirements, fit-gap analysis, configuration, customization, development coordination, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, cutover, and production support.
  • Experience coordinating SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management, and production validation.
  • Experience with ERP data migration, mapping, reconciliation, and legacy-system conversion.
  • Strong project management skills, including management of scope, timelines, risks, issues, dependencies, change requests, and vendor deliverables.
  • D365 configuration and application administration
  • AX-to-D365 upgrade/migration projects
  • D365 extensions and customizations
  • Workflows and business processes
  • Integrations, interfaces, APIs, and data entities
  • Azure DevOps
  • Lifecycle Services (LCS)
  • Power Platform / Power Automate
  • Power BI and D365 reporting
  • SQL and data analysis
  • Security roles, duties, and privileges
  • SIT, UAT, regression testing, and release management

job.title: QC Lab Technician
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a QC Laboratory Technician in Port Neches, TX. The QC Laboratory Technician will perform sampling and testing of raw materials, in-process materials, and finished products in a chemical manufacturing environment. Experience with GC, HPLC, wet chemistry, titrations, viscosity testing, and StarLIMS is preferred.

Duration: Temp-to-Hire
Location: Port Neches, TX
Salary Range: $22/hr
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 1st Shift then to rotating 12-hour day and night shifts; 4:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. / 4:00 p.m.–4:00 a.m.
Industry: Chemical/Polymer Manufacturing



Key Responsibilities
  • Collect samples from all areas of plant operations according to established hourly schedules.
  • Perform chemical and physical testing of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products.
  • Conduct testing using Gas Chromatography, HPLC, viscosity and rheological-property testing, titrations, chemical extraction techniques, and other wet chemistry methods.
  • Perform color, texture, appearance, and other product consistency analyses.
  • Accurately record test results in StarLIMS or applicable laboratory databases.
  • Apply basic Statistical Process Control and Statistical Quality Control methods to monitor process performance.
  • Complete retesting and additional analyses as required.
  • Communicate product quality concerns, out-of-specification results, and testing updates to shift supervision.
  • Notify laboratory supervision of equipment, testing, documentation, or process issues.
  • Operate, calibrate, troubleshoot, and maintain laboratory equipment, including GC, HPLC, balances, gauges, and precision measuring devices.
  • Conduct basic safety audits of laboratory equipment and work practices.
  • Perform basic mathematical calculations and use laboratory computer applications for data analysis and reporting.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant laboratory and work area.
  • Support plant and laboratory emergency procedures as directed by the Site Emergency Director.
  • Work overtime as needed to provide vacation, illness, staffing, or production coverage.
  • Perform other laboratory-related duties as assigned by management.

Required Qualifications
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Technology, Polymer Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of one year of hands-on quality-control laboratory experience; polymer-industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience with GC, HPLC, titration, extraction methods, viscosity, or rheological testing.
  • Familiarity with StarLIMS or comparable laboratory information management systems preferred.
  • Proficiency with basic mathematics, computers, data entry, and laboratory reporting.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work effectively under time pressure.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, flexible, and willing to work rotating shifts.
  • Ability to read and follow written procedures, policies, technical manuals, schedules, training materials, and handwritten or printed instructions.

Physical and Environmental Requirements
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 30 pounds routinely and up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods while performing laboratory testing.
  • Ability to bend, twist, stoop, kneel, reach, and perform fine-manipulation tasks.
  • Ability to collect samples throughout an active manufacturing plant in rain, heat, cold, and other weather conditions.
  • Ability to work in hot areas and around loud process equipment.
  • Ability to wear required PPE, which may include a hard hat, safety glasses, hearing protection, respirator, steel-toed footwear, gloves, or other protective equipment.
  • Ability to maintain good housekeeping practices in the laboratory and plant areas.
  • Ability to respond appropriately during site emergencies.
  • Ability to work rotating 12-hour day and night shifts and overtime when required.

#IND-SPG

job.title: Site Administrator - Barker
job.description:
Site Administrator
12+ month contract
Barker, NY (Onsite)

Position Summary
The Site Administrator independently coordinates day-to-day administrative services. The role owns local execution, maintains accurate records, anticipates upcoming needs, and collaborates with other sites to improve consistency.
Occasional remote assistance may be assigned within agreed capacity. A designated Site Administrator may also support IAH on an ongoing basis while developing toward a Lead role, where mutually agreed.

Key Responsibilities
Daily Site Operations
  • Prepare for expected visitors, new hires, deliveries, and scheduled badge activities.
  • Support approved visitor and badge workflows without making access-authorization decisions.
  • Coordinate PPE distribution, inventory counts, and reorder notifications.
  • Reconcile designated onsite records with Envoy/XOC or other approved systems.
  • Coordinate parking, food service, shuttle, supplies, and administrative-space needs.
  • Support executive visits, badge days, onboarding activities, and other approved events.
  • Maintain issue logs, daily handoffs, and reporting inputs.
  • Escalate missing approvals, supply gaps, process exceptions, and competing priorities.

New-Hire Readiness
  • Confirm badge, orientation, PPE, seating, and other agreed prerequisites.
  • Complete readiness checks at least two business days before the start date.
  • Notify the onsite hiring manager of missing items before arrival.
  • Track unresolved prerequisites through handoff or escalation.

Collaboration and Assigned Remote Support
  • Share useful practices and participate in agreed cross-site coordination.
  • Help maintain site-specific procedures and onboarding materials.
  • Provide remote assistance without compromising essential primary-site duties.
  • Where assigned to IAH, perform its defined food-service, readiness, and inventory-coordination tasks.
  • Guide Site Coordinators on assigned activities when designated.

Required Qualifications
  • Experience in site administration, office operations, facilities support, hospitality, logistics, or a comparable role.
  • Ability to organize daily work independently and respond to changing priorities.
  • Accurate recordkeeping and clear communication.
  • Proficiency with email, spreadsheets, collaboration tools, and administrative systems.
  • Ability to follow controlled-access procedures and recognize exceptions requiring escalation.

Preferred Experience
  • Construction, industrial, data center, or other controlled-access environments.
  • Visitor coordination, onboarding, inventory management, vendor coordination, or event support.

Working Relationships and Authority
The Site Administrator works under Yoh’s Engagement Manager, with operational direction from an assigned Lead where applicable. The role coordinates with site contacts without making them responsible for managing the Yoh resource.
The role has no default formal people-management responsibility. Access, purchasing, security, scope changes, and additional spending remain with authorized personnel.

job.title: Athletic Trainer (Licensed)
job.description:
Athletic Trainer needed for a permanent opportunity with Yoh’s automobile client located in Georgetown, KY at their Occupational Health clinic. Accepting new grads-ATs with extensive experience!
 
This clinic focuses on the prevention aspect of injuries versus the acute care following an injury. The AT will be responsible for 10-15 open cases as well as non-patient appointment-based activities on the production floor examining the physical demands of jobs.  The AT may also be leading group-based fitness, stretching, or educational classes.
 
Schedule: 2nd shift 2:30p-11p
Type: Direct hire, permanent placement to start ASAP
Salary: $30-40/hr with flexibility depending on experience

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Develop and implement early intervention program consisting of performing comprehensive musculoskeletal examination, providing first aid per OSHA standards and education on injury prevention  
  • Perform physical demand and ergonomic assessments to identify high-risk tasks and recommend preventive strategies  
  • Lead group and individual training on functional movement, job simulation, and injury prevention programs  
  • Collaborate with on-site medical and safety teams to coordinate care and recommend workplace countermeasures  
  • Document assessments, recommendations, and outcomes in a timely and accurate manner  
  • Maintains patient health records to ensure accurate and up-to-date record  
  • Participate in meetings and task forces  
  • Other duties as assigned

  • Bachelor's or master's degree from an accredited professional Athletic Training education program
  • Current BOC Certified Athletic Trainer
  • Current certification with hands-on training in AHA, ARC or equivalent Basic Life Support for health care providers is required; Advanced Cardiac Life Support may also be required based on contract scope of services
  • Certification and experience in Ergonomics preferred
  • Experience in Occupational Health and Safety; Knowledge of current OSHA regulations preferred

job.title: Seibi Press Technician
job.description:
Seibi Press Equipment Tech
Georgetown, KY (On-site)
7:00 am to 4:00 pm EST.
12+ month contract
Overtime:  20 – 30% throughout the year.
50% travel - KY, IN, ON, WV, NC, MO, TN, CA, MX, MS, AL, TX, Canada, Mexico

Job description:
Looking for a passionate and highly motivated individual who possesses exceptional technical skill.
The primary responsibility of this role is to support new equipment installations and modifications of existing equipment.
Perform confirmation and preparation of equipment for manufacturing production. Support various projects under the direction of the Lead Seibi while sharing fresh concepts and ideas in support of continuous improvement.
Reporting to the Engineering Manager, the person in this role will support the Press Production Engineering department's objective to deploy and / or modify press equipment to facilitate new model launch and support manufacturing operations.


Responsibilities:
  • Offline and/or online robot programming
  • Confirm that new model equipment meets set standards and performs as intended
  • Prepare and confirm new press equipment at the vendors
  • Support confirmation and adjustment of existing press equipment to meet standards and targeted running conditions.
  • Support Press Equipment Seibi activity at North American Manufacturing Companies with installation, modification, start of production, and GSPH improvement support
  • Develop equipment countermeasures during set up/trials
  • Engage in travel (or dispatch) to U.S., Canada and/or Mexico NAMCs and suppliers, as well as foreign travel including but not limited to Japan, Canada, Mexico.  Commonly work overtime, including weekends and holidays
  • Report, document, and summarize activities including reflections, standards, and work instructions.
 
Requirements:
  • 3+ years of experience press shop maintenance
  • Associate Technical Degree (or higher), or equivalent experience
  • Technical education specific to industrial maintenance
  • Read and understand Electrical, Pneumatic, and Hydraulic schematics/prints
  • Working knowledge of Mechanical and/or Servo Presses
  • Working knowledge with PLC’s / Safety PLC’s including A/B, Mitsubishi, Siemens, Yaskawa, and Toyopuc
  • Working knowledge with Servo and VFD Drive. Mitsubishi, Fanuc, Yaskawa, or Siemens
  • Working knowledge with Material Handling Robots including Yaskawa, Fanuc, Kawasaki, Nachi, ABB
  • Machining Experience (Mill, Lathe, Saws, Welding, etc..)
  • Experience Applying General Industry Safety Standards
  • Ability to travel up to 75% at times (including international travel)
  • Proficient with Microsoft products (Excel, Power-Point, Word, Outlook).
  • Experience in ACAD, Catia, or other design platforms

job.title: Zscaler Analyst/Engineer
job.description:
Zscaler Operations Analyst / Engineer
6 month contract/contract to hire (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
McKinney, TX (Hybrid 3 days a week, Must be local to Dallas)

We are seeking a hands-on Zscaler Operations Analyst / Engineer to support the rollout, administration, and ongoing operations of an enterprise Zscaler environment.
This individual will take ownership of the operational side of the Zscaler suite, including implementation support, day-to-day administration, troubleshooting, and break/fix activities. A key focus will be supporting the rollout of Zscaler for branch application connectivity, including App Connectors and Branch Connectors.
The ideal candidate will come from a strong network engineering or network operations background and have hands-on experience supporting Zscaler in a production environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own day-to-day operational support of the Zscaler platform.
  • Support the rollout of Zscaler across branch locations and branch application connectivity.
  • Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Zscaler App Connectors and Branch Connectors.
  • Provide hands-on break/fix support for Zscaler-related connectivity and operational issues.
  • Troubleshoot application access, connectivity, routing, DNS, and network-related issues involving Zscaler.
  • Support configuration changes, platform updates, testing, and ongoing optimization of the Zscaler environment.
  • Monitor the environment and investigate issues impacting users, branch locations, applications, or network connectivity.
  • Work closely with network, infrastructure, security, and application teams to troubleshoot cross-functional issues.
  • Help establish an internal Zscaler operational knowledge base, including configurations, troubleshooting procedures, known issues, and resolutions.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation and runbooks.
  • Serve as a subject-matter resource for ongoing Zscaler operational support.
  • Coordinate with Zscaler support and other vendors as needed to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Support the organization's broader network environment, which currently utilizes HPE/HP networking technology and is expected to transition toward Cisco Meraki.

Required Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience supporting Zscaler in a production enterprise environment.
  • Strong experience with Zscaler App Connector deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Zscaler Branch Connector or comparable branch connectivity implementations.
  • Strong network engineering or network operations background.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex network and application connectivity issues.
  • Solid understanding of:
    • TCP/IP
    • DNS
    • Routing
    • Network security
    • Firewalls
    • Application connectivity
    • SSL/TLS
    • Zero Trust networking concepts
  • Experience providing operational support and resolving production incidents.
  • Ability to independently investigate issues and drive problems through resolution.
  • Strong documentation skills with the ability to build technical procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Experience with multiple components of the Zscaler product suite.
  • Experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) and/or Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA).
  • Hands-on experience with HPE/HP networking technologies.
  • Cisco Meraki experience, especially supporting enterprise or branch networking environments.
  • Experience working within a Zero Trust or SASE architecture.
  • Experience supporting large, distributed environments with multiple branch locations.
  • Previous experience helping an organization establish operational processes around a newly implemented network/security platform.

job.title: Sr ServiceNow Developer - onsite in San Diego, San Mateo, or Austin
job.description:
Senior ServiceNow Developer - onsite hybrid in San Diego, San Mateo or Austin

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. NO C2C or third party!! 

- 12 month contract
- Ideally looking for someone who can go onsite 1X/week in San Diego, San Mateo, or Austin 
- $65-75/hr on W2

Position Summary:
We are seeking a Senior ServiceNow Developer to own the design, development, maintenance, and reliability of enterprise ServiceNow solutions, with a strong focus on integrations. This hands-on role requires strong JavaScript development, platform troubleshooting, and technical judgment. The successful candidate will improve existing code and workflows, deliver secure and maintainable integrations, and take changes from requirements through testing, deployment, and operational support. They will partner with platform owners and business stakeholders to simplify solutions, resolve root causes, and reduce technical debt.

Key Responsibilities:
Platform Engineering and Code Quality
  • Build and maintain Script Includes, Business Rules, scoped applications, catalog solutions, flows, Transform Maps, Import Sets, and custom APIs
  • Write and review efficient, reusable JavaScript and Glide API code with appropriate query filters, execution conditions, and error handling
  • Assess interactions among existing rules, flows, and integrations; eliminate duplicate automation and unnecessary processing, and evaluate downstream impacts
  • Prefer supported platform capabilities, document customization decisions, and improve inherited code and technical debt
Integration Architecture and Reliability
  • Design and maintain enterprise integrations using IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, Scripted REST APIs, MID Servers, and reusable patterns
  • Design for retries, duplicate prevention, pagination, rate limits, reconciliation, and recoverable failures
  • Provide actionable monitoring and diagnostic logging; evaluate performance, data integrity, and IntegrationHub transaction consumption
  • Apply appropriate access controls and authentication, protect credentials and sensitive data, and maintain environment-specific endpoints and configuration
Testing and Production Delivery
  • Own changes from acceptance criteria through peer review, functional and regression testing, deployment, and post-release validation
  • Prepare complete update sets and dependencies, test evidence, deployment instructions, and rollback plans
  • Support upgrades by assessing customizations and validating critical workflows and integrations
  • Investigate failures and performance issues across scripts, flows, imports, and downstream systems; demonstrate root causes and verify that fixes prevent recurrence
Collaboration and Documentation
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Security, HRIS, ITSM, ITOM, business teams, and vendors to clarify requirements and acceptance criteria
  • Explain design choices, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders
  • Maintain architecture diagrams, sequence flows, data mappings, design rationale, operational runbooks, and support handover documentation
  • Mentor developers, lead code reviews, and contribute to coding standards, governance, and deployment automation
  • Follow enterprise privacy, data retention, security, and audit requirements
Required Qualifications
  • 6+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience, including at least 3 years delivering and supporting enterprise integrations
  • Strong JavaScript, Glide API, and scoped application development skills, including reviewing and improving existing code
  • Hands-on expertise with IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, Scripted REST APIs, MID Servers, Import Sets, and Transform Maps
  • Experience integrating identity platforms, HRIS, ITSM tools, monitoring tools, CRM, or cloud services
  • Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, JWT, mutual TLS, and ServiceNow access controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues, optimize queries and automation, and validate fixes with evidence
  • Experience with peer review, regression testing, update-set dependencies, controlled deployments, and rollback planning
Preferred Qualifications
  • Relevant ServiceNow implementation or application development certifications
  • Experience with Automated Test Framework, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment frameworks
  • Experience with SOAP, webhooks, message queues, or asynchronous integration patterns
  • Hands-on experience with CMDB, Discovery, and lifecycle management
  • Familiarity with Now Assist, Virtual Agent, and AI Search
  • Experience in large global environments with high availability, data integrity, and strict security requirements
Working Style
  • Own delivery and operational outcomes, work independently, and raise risks early
  • Translate ambiguous requests into clear requirements and practical solutions
  • Communicate clearly, document decisions, and share knowledge through mentoring and support handovers

job.title: Semiconductor Manufacturing Tech ($1,000 Sign On Bonus)
job.description:
We have 18-month contract opportunities for Manufacturing Technicians in Austin Texas. These positions have a very real possibility to go temp to hire.

Sign-On Bonus is for intermediate and advanced candidate with multiple years of Manufacturing experience and/or in the Semiconductor industry.

Sign-On Bonus Structure: $1,000 after 100 Days worked

Entry Level Rate: $22.00/Hr. (Entry Level does not have a Sign-On Bonus)
Intermediate Rate: $25./Hr. (multiple years manufacturing experience)
Advanced Rate:
$28/Hr. (4+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry)

Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.
Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks on components and finished products.
  • Utilize testing equipment including:
  • Electronic Measurement Devices
  • Leak detectors, Vacuum pumps, and Test fixtures.
  • Maintain accurate production, labor, and work-order records in computer systems.
  • Receive & audit parts to ensure availability & accuracy before assembly or repair.
  • Complete detailing and finishing activities on completed products.
  • Follow Safety procedures and properly use required PPE, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • May assist with software-related tasks, or equipment repairs as needed.

Physical & Environmental Requirements:
  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Working in confined spaces
  • Bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching
  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials
  • Distinguishing between colors
  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

This role may involve work in a cleanroom environment and may require the use of:
Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

job.title: Site Administrator - Baton Rouge
job.description:
Site Administrator
12+ month contract
Baton Rouge, LA (Onsite)

Position Summary
The Site Administrator independently coordinates day-to-day administrative services. The role owns local execution, maintains accurate records, anticipates upcoming needs, and collaborates with other sites to improve consistency.
Occasional remote assistance may be assigned within agreed capacity. A designated Site Administrator may also support IAH on an ongoing basis while developing toward a Lead role, where mutually agreed.

Key Responsibilities
Daily Site Operations
  • Prepare for expected visitors, new hires, deliveries, and scheduled badge activities.
  • Support approved visitor and badge workflows without making access-authorization decisions.
  • Coordinate PPE distribution, inventory counts, and reorder notifications.
  • Reconcile designated onsite records with Envoy/XOC or other approved systems.
  • Coordinate parking, food service, shuttle, supplies, and administrative-space needs.
  • Support executive visits, badge days, onboarding activities, and other approved events.
  • Maintain issue logs, daily handoffs, and reporting inputs.
  • Escalate missing approvals, supply gaps, process exceptions, and competing priorities.

New-Hire Readiness
  • Confirm badge, orientation, PPE, seating, and other agreed prerequisites.
  • Complete readiness checks at least two business days before the start date.
  • Notify the onsite hiring manager of missing items before arrival.
  • Track unresolved prerequisites through handoff or escalation.

Collaboration and Assigned Remote Support
  • Share useful practices and participate in agreed cross-site coordination.
  • Help maintain site-specific procedures and onboarding materials.
  • Provide remote assistance without compromising essential primary-site duties.
  • Where assigned to IAH, perform its defined food-service, readiness, and inventory-coordination tasks.
  • Guide Site Coordinators on assigned activities when designated.

Required Qualifications
  • Experience in site administration, office operations, facilities support, hospitality, logistics, or a comparable role.
  • Ability to organize daily work independently and respond to changing priorities.
  • Accurate recordkeeping and clear communication.
  • Proficiency with email, spreadsheets, collaboration tools, and administrative systems.
  • Ability to follow controlled-access procedures and recognize exceptions requiring escalation.

Preferred Experience
  • Construction, industrial, data center, or other controlled-access environments.
  • Visitor coordination, onboarding, inventory management, vendor coordination, or event support.

Working Relationships and Authority
The Site Administrator works under Yoh’s Engagement Manager, with operational direction from an assigned Lead where applicable. The role coordinates with site contacts without making them responsible for managing the Yoh resource.
The role has no default formal people-management responsibility. Access, purchasing, security, scope changes, and additional spending remain with authorized personnel.

job.title: Building Maintenance (DAY SHIFT)
job.description:
Building Maintenance (DAY SHIFT) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Audubon, PA.
  • Pay Rate: $25-28/hr
  • ONSITE
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • The Facilities support contractor will support the Facilities Services Department’s responsibility for the maintenance of critical infrastructure systems supporting control rooms and computer rooms; as well as preventive/remedial maintenance and property management functions for other campus buildings including the mechanical, electrical, structural, environmental, and fire protection systems.
  • Perform monitoring and recording of equipment performance by periodic reading of gauges and displayed information, and appropriately responding to visual and building automation system generated alarms.
  • Assist installing electrical construction such as installation, termination, and inspection of electrical systems ranging up to 480 volts A.C.  
  • Utilize Building Automation Systems (BAS.) to monitor infrastructure environmental systems and address system alarm conditions and problems.
  • Perform mechanical tasks such as replacing/installing systems components, as air conditioning piping, pumps fans and air handler filters. Ability to correctly read pressure and temperature gauges.
  • Familiarity with inspection and basic diagnosis of fire protection systems including ionization detectors, rate-compensated temperature detectors and double-interlocked (pre-action) sprinkler systems.
  • Responsible for performing basic facilities support tasks such as furniture set up/knockdown, painting, basic carpentry, cable pulls and occasional / limited custodial duties.
  • Support the shipping / receiving staff as needed.
Required:

job.title: Senior Azure .NET Developer
job.description:
Senior Azure .NET Developer
irving, TX (Hybrid)
Direct Hire

Position Summary
As an experienced Senior Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving the design, development, and implementation of robust, scalable, secure, and modern application architecture, with deep expertise in .NET, Azure technologies, and Azure Cosmos DB.
Beyond technical execution, this role calls for someone who takes full ownership and accountability for outcomes — running toward problems, especially in production, rather than waiting to be asked. You will understand enterprise requirements end-to-end and think several steps ahead to design solutions that stand the test of time. You will act as a hands-on architect and the team's go-to technical resource, reasoning through trade-offs with data and bringing well-communicated recommendations to the Senior Management and architecture team.
What This Role Requires
  • Hands-On Ownership: Personally designs, builds, reviews, troubleshoots, and supports critical components — this is a hands-on technical lead role, not a coordination-only architect position.
  • Decision-Ready Judgment: Frames problems with supporting data, weighs tradeoffs, and brings a clear recommended path with business and technical impact — not just options.
  • Go-To Resource: The person developers and stakeholders bring hard technical questions to — across Azure and C#/.NET — and trust to give a clear, confident answer.
  • Constructive Challenge: Pushes back constructively on weak assumptions and shortcuts, balancing delivery urgency with long-term maintainability.
  • Accountability: Owns outcomes beyond code complete: requirements clarity, dependencies, test readiness, release planning, observability, rollback, documentation, and hypercare.
  • Force Multiplier: Builds reusable patterns, standards, templates, and runbooks, and develops secondary ownership so critical knowledge is never a single point of failure.
  • AI-Forward: Actively explores, adopts, and introduces AI-driven SDLC practices — then drives their adoption across the team, validating all AI-generated output through rigorous human review and testing.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Requirements & End-to-End Ownership
  • Understand requirements in full enterprise context — source-of-truth decisions, upstream/downstream systems, business rules, data ownership, security, and support impact.
  • Lead technical discovery into solution designs, technical stories, acceptance criteria, dependency and data mappings, exception scenarios, estimates, risks, and implementation plans.
  • Own delivery from design through testing, deployment, production validation, support transition, and continuous improvement — escalating risks early with options and recommendations.
  • Assess scope changes for architecture, schedule, testing, data, dependency, and operational impact before committing.
Architecture & Technical Direction
  • Own Azure and C#/.NET architecture, implementation, and engineering standards, aligning key architecture decisions with the Senior Manager and architecture team.
  • Design cloud-native, API-led, event-driven, and data-integration solutions; document decisions, alternatives, and tradeoffs in language suited to developers, leadership, and business partners.
  • Evaluate scalability, security, resiliency, performance, observability, maintainability, cost, and supportability before implementation.
  • Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing, and feedback; establish patterns for error handling, retries, idempotency, and reusable integration components.
Hands-On Engineering
  • Build industry-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and integrations using C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core, engineered to meet sub-150ms API response targets.
  • Must have strong, hands-on expertise with Azure Event Hubs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory (ADF), and Azure Cosmos DB.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Functions, App Service, Container Apps/AKS, API Management, Azure Front Door, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure DevOps.
  • Apply strong practices for asynchronous processing, concurrency, dependency injection, authentication/authorization, data modeling, API contracts, retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, and dead-letter recovery.
  • Front-end contribution (React.js, Next.js) as needed is a plus, not required — primary depth stays in backend and integration engineering.
Performance, Data & Cost Engineering
  • Diagnose end-to-end performance using correlated telemetry across edge, API, compute, messaging, database, and batch layers.
  • Use workload evidence — latency, throughput, error/retry rates, CPU/memory, Cosmos DB RU consumption and partitioning — to guide decisions rather than guesswork.
  • Tune Cosmos DB partitioning, throughput, and indexing; balance real-time and batch workloads without defaulting to capacity increases.
  • Evaluate Azure cost and capacity tradeoffs, and recommend savings without weakening reliability.
DevSecOps & Release Engineering
  • Champion automated unit, integration, contract, regression, and performance testing with meaningful coverage as part of CI/CD quality gates.
  • Build and improve Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, environment promotion, approvals, and reliable rollback strategies.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (Bicep or equivalent) for repeatable application and platform deployments.
  • Embed secure engineering practices: managed identity, secrets management, least privilege, and vulnerability remediation.
Observability, Reliability & Production Support
  • Design structured logging, correlation IDs, distributed tracing, metrics, and alerts that minimize noise and speed root-cause analysis.
  • Define production-readiness criteria, runbooks, failure modes, and post-deployment validation.
  • DR Champion: Own disaster recovery strategy end-to-end — RPO/RTO targets, failover, backup/restore, recovery automation, and periodic DR testing.
  • Lead complex incident investigation with urgency, converting lessons learned into durable engineering improvements.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation, remaining available to support production issues as needed.
AI-Enabled Engineering
  • Be a front-runner in adopting approved AI-assisted practices across the SDLC — planning, coding, testing, documentation, review, and troubleshooting.
  • Validate all AI-generated output through human review, automated testing, and security controls.
  • Build reusable prompts, repository instructions, and guardrails that capture team learning and promote consistent, secure AI usage.
  • Track and communicate AI's impact on delivery speed, quality, and incident resolution.
Collaboration & Communication
  • Partner with product, QA, security, infrastructure, data, support, and onshore/offshore engineering teams.
  • Lead with empathy and accountability: listen, explain reasoning, challenge respectfully, and follow through on commitments.
  • Provide concise, accurate status, risk, and completion updates, keeping delivery status current.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with strong depth in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and Azure backend/integration services.
  • Proven, end-to-end ownership of production Azure solutions — from requirements and architecture through deployment, observability, and support.
  • Demonstrated expertise with cloud-native applications, microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed-system failure handling.
  • Strong, hands-on expertise with Azure Event Hubs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Cosmos DB, including production troubleshooting and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with automated testing, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git, Infrastructure as Code, containers, and observability tooling.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor developers, conduct design/code reviews, communicate tradeoffs, and lead through ambiguity.
  • Practical, responsible experience using AI development tools, including output validation and data protection.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate; Azure Solutions Architect Expert strongly preferred.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, high-availability architecture, distributed tracing, and production on-call support.
  • Cosmos DB partitioning/RU optimization, Azure performance engineering, and FinOps practices.
  • Experience standardizing AI-assisted engineering workflows or reusable development automation.
  • Experience in retail, distribution, supply chain, or heavy-duty aftermarket domains.
Success Measures
  • Risks, dependencies, and non-functional requirements are surfaced before development and QA.
  • Solutions reach production with automated tests, observability, documented support ownership, and validated rollback/recovery.
  • Technical debt is prevented where practical, or explicitly documented and bounded when intentionally accepted.
  • Develops clean designs, and reusable engineering assets grow over time.
  • AI-assisted development shows measurable improvement while maintaining human validation and quality.

job.title: Scientist / Senior Scientist
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a Senior Scientist, Analytical Validation – NGS & Molecular Diagnostics for an exciting opportunity with an innovative biotechnology client in the South Bay Area.

This role will be responsible for designing, executing, analyzing, and documenting analytical validation studies supporting advanced molecular diagnostic and next-generation sequencing (NGS) assays. The successful candidate will play a key role in establishing assay performance, reproducibility, robustness, and readiness for future clinical and regulatory milestones.

We are looking for a scientist who combines strong molecular biology expertise with analytical rigor, statistical thinking, and hands-on experience in cell-free nucleic acid workflows, NGS technologies, and regulated assay development environments.

Department: Assay Development / Research & Development
Location: Sunnyvale, CA
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: $160,000 - $220,000 (DOE)

Responsibilities:

Analytical Validation Strategy & Execution
  • Design and execute analytical validation studies for molecular diagnostic assays and NGS-based testing platforms.
  • Develop scientifically sound study designs, acceptance criteria, sample size calculations, and statistical analysis plans.
  • Lead studies evaluating:
    • Limit of Blank (LoB), Limit of Detection (LoD), and Limit of Quantitation (LoQ), as applicable
    • Analytical sensitivity and specificity
    • Repeatability and reproducibility
    • Operator, instrument, reagent lot, and workflow variability
    • Method comparison and analytical agreement
    • Interference, contamination, carryover, and assay robustness
    • Specimen and reagent stability
  • Identify assay failure modes and implement corrective actions to improve performance and reliability.
Molecular Biology & NGS Assay Development
  • Perform and optimize workflows involving plasma processing, cell-free nucleic acid extraction, quantification, and quality assessment.
  • Execute NGS library preparation workflows including:
    • End repair
    • Adapter ligation
    • Indexing
    • Amplification
    • Target enrichment
    • Library quality control
  • Evaluate the impact of DNA input quantity, library efficiency, sequencing depth, and molecular background noise on assay performance.
  • Develop and qualify controls, reference materials, and test specimens for validation studies.
  • Support characterization of low-abundance molecular signals and assay sensitivity limits.
NGS Data Analysis & Performance Assessment
  • Operate and troubleshoot NGS instrumentation and associated workflows.
  • Analyze sequencing and library quality metrics, including:
    • Read depth
    • Coverage uniformity
    • Mapping performance
    • Library complexity
    • Duplication rates
    • On-target performance
  • Collaborate with bioinformatics teams to evaluate analytical pipeline performance and quality-control thresholds.
  • Perform statistical analyses using tools such as R, Python, JMP, SAS, or equivalent platforms.
  • Generate technical summaries, validation reports, and performance assessments.
Automation & Workflow Optimization
  • Partner with automation engineers to transfer molecular workflows onto automated liquid-handling platforms.
  • Evaluate variability introduced by automation and support workflow qualification activities.
  • Assess contamination control strategies, sample tracking systems, and recovery procedures.
  • Support high-throughput laboratory process development and operational scale-up.
  • Contribute to SOP development, troubleshooting guides, and workflow documentation.
Quality & Regulatory Support
  • Author validation protocols, reports, deviation investigations, and technical documentation.
  • Maintain traceable documentation for samples, instrumentation, reagents, software, and analytical methods.
  • Support quality-system initiatives and documentation practices consistent with regulated laboratory environments.
  • Collaborate with Quality and Regulatory teams on validation strategies, verification activities, design controls, and submission-support documentation.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Work closely with assay development, bioinformatics, automation, clinical, quality, and regulatory teams.
  • Present study results, technical findings, and recommendations to project stakeholders.
  • Lead technical investigations and support risk mitigation activities.
  • Contribute to assay development strategy, validation planning, and project execution.
Required Qualifications:
  • Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Genetics, Genomics, Biochemistry, Bioengineering, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with cell-free nucleic acid workflows, liquid biopsy technologies, or low-input molecular assays.
  • Strong background in NGS library preparation, sequencing workflows, and molecular assay development.
  • Experience designing and executing analytical validation studies for molecular assays or NGS-based products.
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Analytical sensitivity and specificity
    • LoB, LoD, and LoQ studies
    • Precision and reproducibility assessments
    • Interference and robustness testing
    • Statistical study design and analysis
  • Experience analyzing complex experimental data and applying appropriate statistical methodologies.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, experimental design, and scientific communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a multidisciplinary environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience supporting development or validation of liquid biopsy, cell-free DNA (cfDNA), or other advanced molecular diagnostic assays.
  • Experience with targeted sequencing, low-frequency variant detection, DNA methylation analysis, or related technologies.
  • Familiarity with FDA-regulated diagnostic development programs and analytical validation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of CLSI guidance and quality-system requirements applicable to molecular diagnostics.
  • Experience with laboratory automation and liquid-handling systems.
  • Proficiency in R, Python, JMP, SAS, or similar analytical tools.
  • Experience with design controls, risk management, CAPA, method transfer, and assay lifecycle management.
  • Experience supporting medium- to high-throughput laboratory operations.

#IND-SPG

job.title: iOS Team Lead
job.description:
Job Title: iOS Team Lead
Location: New York - 5 days onsite
Type - Full Time
Salary - $180000- $260000



Our client is  award-winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.Today, Our client  is an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.

They are  currently looking for an iOS Team Lead who will play a critical role on key projects for clients. Working in a collaborative and innovative project team, with direct client-facing interactions, you will have an opportunity to apply your skills and expertise to design innovative applications that solve complex problems and enhance performance and productivity at our marquee clients. In particular, you will help build and modernize large-scale consumer banking experiences, focusing on areas such as customer onboarding, account management, and money movement. As part of a greenfield initiative, you will lead the development of new mobile capabilities designed to support expansion into new markets and evolving regulatory requirements.

The Role As an iOS Team Lead, you are a true project leader. You own the technical direction and delivery of client engagements while multiplying the effectiveness of the engineers around you.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will design systems, write code when it matters most, guide architectural decisions, and ensure the team delivers high-quality outcomes even when you are not directly contributing code.
You will work closely with client stakeholders, designers, product partners, and COMPANY leadership to ensure solutions are technically sound, aligned with business objectives, and delivered with excellence.
This is an onsite role, five days per week in the WTC area of NYC.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Design, implement, deliver, and test innovative iOS Swift applications while understanding our products from both a technical and product perspective in the context of our client’s business.
  • Communicate with leadership, product owners, other technologists, and users to create working software based on an understanding of business and technical priorities.
  • Break down complex problems into elegant technical solutions to intelligently solve problems for COMPANY’s clients.
  • Actively contribute to the adoption of strong software architecture, development best practices, and new technologies. We are always improving the process of building software, and we’ll need your help to do that.
  • Bring a passion for staying on top of technology trends.
  • Experiment with and learn new technologies.
What Success Looks Like In your first 6 to 12 months, success means:

  • Your teams consistently deliver high-quality software that meets user and client objectives.
  • Engineers around you become more autonomous, capable, and effective because of your leadership.
  • Clients trust your judgment and rely on you for technical direction and clarity.
  • You demonstrate strong ownership of outcomes, proactively addressing risks before they become issues.
  • You can step away from day-to-day coding when needed without compromising delivery quality or team performance.
What You Should Have
  • 10–12+ years of experience designing and building complex, commercial-grade software systems, with 4+ years leading Agile teams
  • Proficiency in Swift and experience with native iOS development tools such as SwiftUI and UIKit
  • Experience in consumer banking, including account management and onboarding
  • Familiarity with integrating RESTful APIs and third-party libraries
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies
  • Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for mobile applications
  • Understanding of mobile UI/UX principles and best practices to create intuitive and engaging user experiences
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Bonus Points
  • Experience with fraud management, KYC/AML, and regulatory reporting
  • Experience using on-device biometrics for authentication
  • A strong portfolio of released applications on the App Store
  • Experience with AppConfig community standards and enterprise app distribution
  • College degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Claude Code, or Copilot to improve team velocity and code quality and help teams adopt them responsibly

job.title: Data Analyst - onsite in San Diego
job.description:
DATA ANALYST WITH POWER BI - onsite in San Diego 

Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. CANNOT WORK WITH 3rd PARTY!

- contract through 05/08/27
- onsite 3 days/week in San Diego
- $44-47/hr on W2 (contingent on experience)

MUST HAVE SKILLS: 
  • Power BI (power Query)
  • Excel

Job Description

The Data Analyst collects, analyzes, and interprets service operational and environmental compliance data to provide actionable insights that support business operations, regulatory compliance, and strategic decision-making. This role develops and automates reports, dashboards, KPI metrics, and analytical models using Power BI, Excel, SAP, Business Warehouse, and Microsoft 365 tools while ensuring data integrity and reporting accuracy. The position partners with cross-functional teams to improve reporting processes, support environmental stewardship and regulatory reporting, and communicate key insights that drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities
  • Develop, maintain, and automate reports, dashboards, KPI scorecards, and self-service reporting solutions using Power BI, Excel, SAP, Business Warehouse, Power Query, Microsoft Fabric, SQL, and Microsoft 365 tools.
  •  Collect, analyze, validate, and interpret operational and environmental compliance data, ensuring data integrity while identifying trends, insights, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Prepare business and regulatory reports, monitor changing environmental requirements, and recommend solutions to support compliance and operational objectives.
  • Design data models, automate reporting processes and workflows, and improve reporting efficiency through Power Automate and other analytics tools.
  • Support service operations, sustainability, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis through KPI reporting and data-driven recommendations.
  • Communicate analytical findings to stakeholders, maintain reporting documentation and standards, support audits and compliance activities, and collaborate across business units to improve reporting processes and decision-making.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or environmental compliance.
  • Advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, formulas, Power Query) and experience with Power BI.
  • Experience with SAP (and/or Business Objects or SAP BW).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data validation skills with experience managing large datasets.
  • Ability to interpret and communicate complex data clearly to stakeholders.
  • Experience with reporting automation tools such as Power Automate, SQL, or Microsoft Fabric is a plus.
  • Familiarity with environmental compliance or EPR programs and related regulations is a plus.

Location: Jersey City, NJ
Type: Full Time

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways:
Define and own the engineering vision and architectural roadmap for the transformation program
•Lead adoption of Applied AI / Generative AI capabilities into enterprise service delivery
•Drive API-first design strategy, governance, and integration patterns across internal and external systems
•Evaluate emerging technologies and provide recommendations aligned to business transformation goals
Program Delivery & Execution
•Own end-to-end engineering accountability for the 2-year transformation roadmap across all phases

•Partner within engineering, operations, and enterprise architecture to align engineering output to business outcomes
•Ensure program delivery velocity, quality, and reliability meet stakeholder expectations
Team Building & People Leadership
•Build a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, psychological safety, and continuous improvement

•Manage capacity planning, and workforce strategy for the program
Executive Stakeholder Engagement
•Collaborate with senior leadership and business stakeholders to shape and protect program scope
 
To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following:
Applied AI & Intelligent Systems
•Demonstrated experience leading the integration of Applied AI / Generative AI solutions into enterprise products or services
•Familiarity with LLM-based architectures, AI/ML pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and conversational AI platforms

•Deep expertise in Java Spring Boot microservices development, architecture, and governance

API Integration & Design

job.title: Engineering Drafter- Driving Required - 1 yr contract role Austin, TX - on site only $26-28/hr
job.description:
Monday through Friday
8 am to 5 pm
$27/hr 
Benefits Offered including health insurance
Contract role through Yoh Services at a client site
This job requires strong REVIT skills.  
Must have a valid driver's license.
Background check required


Job Description: Entry-Level Drafter / Engineering Support General Overview The Entry-Level Drafter performs drafting and basic engineering support activities under close supervision. This position develops foundational competencies through structured work assignments and receives instruction, guidance, and direction from supervisors, managers, and experienced colleagues.
The role may focus on drafting, engineering support, or a combination of both.
Primary Responsibilities
  • Perform field observations as assigned.
  • Prepare and update as‑built drawings based on field edits.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, construction drawings, and other technical documentation.
  • Use computer‑aided design (CAD) software to prepare detailed engineering drawings, maps, and graphs from provided materials, including previous drawings, sketches, layouts, and standard references.
  • Clearly document revisions and file drawings according to standard procedures.
  • Assist in drafting solicitation documents using established procedures, formats, and templates to support procurement and contract activities.
  • Support field and office research related to:
    • Field measurements
    • Historical engineering drawings
    • Equipment databases
    • Microfilm
    • Inventory records
    • Electronic document management system (EDMS) records
    • Other technical documentation
  • Contribute to the design of equipment and layouts and support development of equipment ratings and facility statistics.
  • Prepare basic specifications, materials lists, and fixed capital unit (FCU) lists.
  • Assist with creating work orders and requisition entries.
  • Perform data entry in the departmental engineering database.
  • Prepare basic reports related to projects, work plans, equipment, assets, and budgets; assist with more complex reporting as needed.
  • Operate office and drafting equipment such as plotters, printers, copiers, and scanners.
  • Collect engineering information by traveling independently to various company locations (such as substations, facilities, or plants).
The responsibilities above represent essential job functions but are not an exhaustive list. Employees may be required to perform additional job‑related duties as assigned.
Minimum Qualifications
  • One or more years of experience interpreting technical drawings/documents and performing technical analysis or CAD drafting.
  • A degree in computer‑aided design or a related field may substitute for equivalent experience, per company guidelines.
  • A valid driver’s license is required for travel to various company locations.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Knowledge of general engineering principles.
  • Knowledge of CAD principles, standards, and techniques.
  • Knowledge of electronic document management systems (EDMS).
  • Knowledge of work management systems.
  • Basic proficiency in CAD software.
  • Ability to read and interpret diagrams, prints, and technical information.
  • Basic proficiency in office productivity software (email, word processing, spreadsheets).
  • Skill in analyzing and solving technical problems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to operate plotters, printers, copiers, and scanners.
  • Ability to perform accurate data entry.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Work Environment
  • Work may be performed in an office, industrial setting, electrical substation, or plant environment.
  • Exposure to noise may occur.
  • Outdoor work may involve exposure to various or extreme weather conditions.
Physical Demands
  • Frequent finger/hand manipulation when using a keyboard and mouse.
  • Occasional climbing, crawling, crouching, or other non‑sitting positions for field duties (less than 20% of the time).
  • Occasional standing or walking during field work (less than 20% of the time).

job.description:
Software Engineer in Test
Onsite, Southlake, TX - W2 Only The Opportunity We are seeking a Software Engineer in Test to join a collaborative Quality Engineering team focused on test automation, continuous integration, test data, and software quality. This role will partner with development and business teams to design and implement automated testing solutions, improve engineering processes, and support the delivery of reliable applications.

The successful candidate will have a strong software engineering background, hands-on experience across multiple layers of the technology stack, and an interest in continuously improving automation practices and tools.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, document, and maintain automated tests and software utilities
  • Create automated testing solutions across user interfaces, APIs, and backend data stores
  • Follow established software engineering and test automation practices
  • Collaborate with developers, testers, business partners, and other technical resources
  • Understand requirements and translate them into effective automated solutions
  • Apply test-driven design concepts to test and debug software and automation frameworks
  • Identify opportunities to improve the maintainability, scalability, and reliability of automation platforms
  • Deliver accurate, reusable, and maintainable code
  • Recommend improvements to processes, standards, tools, and best practices
  • Provide and receive constructive feedback across development and Quality Engineering teams
  • Contribute to continuous integration and continuous delivery initiatives
Qualifications and Skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 10+ years of experience in software testing, software development, test automation, or quality engineering
  • Experience automating across multiple layers of the technology stack, including front-end UI, APIs, and backend data stores
  • Strong programming experience with Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies
  • Experience with Karate, Playwright, or comparable test automation frameworks
  • Experience with AWS services
  • Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with Jenkins, uDeploy, or similar development and deployment tools
  • Experience working in a collaborative Agile environment
  • Ability to deliver value incrementally through iterative development
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work across teams to gather information, solve problems, and deliver effective solutions
  • Passion for learning new technologies, services, tools, and testing techniques
Additional Information This role offers the opportunity to work with experienced Quality Engineering professionals on complex applications while contributing to automation, continuous testing, DevOps, and software delivery initiatives.

It operates through Securities Services, Market and Wealth Services, Investment and Wealth Management, and Other segments. The Securities Services segment offers custody, trust and depositary, accounting, exchange-traded funds, middle-office solutions, transfer agency, services for private equity and real estate funds, foreign exchange, securities lending, liquidity/lending services, and data analytics.

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways: 

  • Deliver operational support and drive issue resolution for AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, and associated production services.
  • Support the deployment, orchestration, and monitoring of AI/ML workloads across distributed environments using Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Apply hands-on expertise with NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, including A100, H100, and B200 nodes, to support provisioning, utilization, performance tuning, and ongoing platform operations.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize automation scripts and tooling using Ansible, Python and Shell scripting to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and change activity through enterprise workflow and ticketing platforms such as JIRA and ServiceNow.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across engineering, platform, and operations to implement DevOps best practices, including CI/CD using GitLab, containerized deployment models, and secure access management through Azure AD.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including runbooks, standard operating procedures, support guides, and infrastructure architecture artifacts.
  • Diagnose and resolve networking, storage, and system performance issues affecting AI infrastructure and high-performance compute workloads.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call support model, including occasional weekend coverage, to help maintain high availability and operational excellence.
 

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong experience supporting AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, or high-performance compute environments in enterprise or production settings.
  • Hands-on experience working with NVIDIA GPU nodes, including A100, H100, and B200 systems.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes and Docker for deploying, managing, and troubleshooting distributed workloads.
  • Proficiency in Ansible,  Python and Shell scripting for automation, tooling, and operational support tasks.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools, including GitLab CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and container-based delivery models.
  • Familiarity with enterprise ticketing and service management platforms such as JIRA and ServiceNow.
  • Good knowledge of networking, storage, Linux systems administration, and infrastructure troubleshooting in complex technical environments.
  • Understanding of identity and access management, including secure access controls such as Azure AD.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and provide occasional weekend support as needed.

job.title: Endpoint Support Engineer Manager/Lead
job.description:
Endpoint Support Engineer Manager/Lead
Direct Hire
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Own the strategy, engineering, and lifecycle management of desktops, laptops, and mobile endpoints for corporate and branch users.
  • Lead configuration, deployment, and management of endpoints using Microsoft Intune, including device enrollment, compliance policies, and application deployment.
  • Manage endpoint security posture using Microsoft Defender, including threat detection, response, and remediation across the device fleet.
  • Evaluate, implement, and manage Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) and virtual desktop solutions to support flexible and remote work needs.
  • Drive standardization of device imaging, patching, and configuration management to improve consistency and reduce support overhead.
  • Lead the endpoint support function, ensuring timely and effective resolution of desktop, laptop, and peripheral issues for corporate headquarters and branch locations.
  • Establish and monitor support SLAs, ticket queues, and escalation paths to drive consistent service delivery across the organization.
  • Drive root cause analysis and continuous improvement for recurring endpoint issues to reduce downtime and support volume.
  • Partner with security and infrastructure teams to ensure endpoints are compliant, patched, and aligned with security policy.
  • Manage relationships, contracts, and performance of hardware, software, and DaaS vendors supporting the endpoint environment.
  • Own the endpoint procurement, refresh, and asset lifecycle management process, including budgeting and forecasting for hardware needs.
  • Negotiate vendor agreements and service levels to optimize cost, quality, and support responsiveness.
  • Evaluate new endpoint tools, hardware, and services, and lead vendor selection and onboarding processes.
  • Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Build, mentor, and lead a team of endpoint engineers and support technicians across corporate and branch locations.
  • Partner with IT leadership, security, and business stakeholders to align endpoint strategy with business priorities and user needs.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders on endpoint health, security posture, project status, and support performance.
  • Develop and maintain documentation, standards, and training materials for endpoint support processes.
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field preferred, or equivalent work experience.
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., Modern Desktop Administrator, Endpoint Administrator Associate) strongly preferred.
  • Security certifications (e.g., Security+) a plus.
  • 6+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, desktop support, or end user computing, including 2+ years in a lead or supervisory role.
  • Hands-on experience managing endpoints with Microsoft Intune, including device compliance, configuration profiles, and application deployment.
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for endpoint security, threat detection, and response.
  • Experience evaluating and supporting Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) or virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) solutions.
  • Proven experience supporting a distributed environment with corporate offices and multiple branch or retail locations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendors, contracts, and hardware/software procurement.
  • Experience with Windows OS deployment, imaging, and patch management tools.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and team management skills.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across hardware, software, and network-related endpoint issues.
  • Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to support both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across corporate and branch locations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-service oriented mindset with a focus on end user experience.

job.title: IT Security Analyst - Financial Services
job.description:
IT Security Analyst - Financial Services
12+ month contract
Downtown Dallas, TX (Hybrid w/ onsite interview)

This role is ideal for a strategic thinker and hands-on individual contributor who thrives in a regulatory-driven environment and is passionate about improving cyber and IT risk processes. The successful candidate will play a key role in the U.S. Cybersecurity Program, helping drive oversight, coordination, and execution across a broad range of cybersecurity priorities that protect the Bank and support business growth. This individual will work hand-in-hand with enterprise security and technology teams to drive progress in key security areas such system governance and management.
 
Typical Day in Role:
  • Lead the Scotiabank U.S. Program for application inventory quarterly review processes
  • Meet with IT Stakeholders to identify business and technology use of application, understanding details regarding configurations, application management and change management processes.
  • Categorize technology into appropriate groupings and help facilitate Application Portfolio Management updates alongside the Application Owners.
  • Review and support key US cyber and technology issues through closure. Provide cyber and risk expertise for management action plan creation and remediation activities. Identify and correct pitfalls in existing remediation/planning/closure. Aid in reduction of failed issue closures and reduction in overall issues. Provide white glove assistance to Issue Owners where warranted.
  • Understand key technologies and processes within a given set of subdomains (mainly Vulnerability Management with exposure to other security technology functions and sub-domains, and general system management) to assist technology owners with understanding a sustainable solution.
  • Provide oversight of control activities in given set of subdomains, including but not limited to Vulnerability Management and IAM
  • Discuss, challenge, and support Control Owners discussions with Quality Assurance Teams, 2nd line, and 3rd line review
  • Serve as the primary liaison for U.S. IS&C teams, supporting issue inquiries.
  • Collaborate with global cyber and issue management colleagues to support initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Technology stakeholders
  • Collaborate with Front Office / CIB / Other corporate functions
  • Provide in-depth SME insight and knowledge sharing to Cyber and Risk colleagues
  • Manage deliverables within the assigned domains
 
Candidate Requirements/Must Have Skills:
  • 10+ years of proven experience in IT, cyber security or cyber risk
  • Strong knowledge and experience with understanding vulnerability details and vulnerability management practices
  • 3+ years experience with system architecture and general sysops (e.g. configuration, patching, IAM, automation, orchestration, golden images, cloud, etc.)
  • Strong knowledge of application security preferred
  • Previous development / scripting experience is a plus (Python, back-end development)
  • Data analysis experience is a plus (Excel, SQL)
  • Experience from FIs or major tech companies (e.g. Meta) would be an asset
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GCP/AWS certifications, OSCP, or equivalent are strongly preferred
