job.title: CAD Draftsman
job.description:
CAD Draftsman
Georgetown, KY (On-Site)
12+ months
50% travel – Michigan, Texas
 
Primary focus:
  • Follow engineering and management direction to update existing drawings from sketches, markups, comments, and approved design information, then issue the revised drawings to the A/E firm to help communicate and control owner design direction back to the detailed design.
  • Coordination and creation of 2D drawings, 3D building models/assemblies relating to facility layouts, utility main and branch piping, and overlay of process equipment layouts to promote accurate representation of the owners’ expectations during the building and facility design process.
  • CAD work coordination with A/E firm related to criteria drawings and design package drawing review comments during criteria and design phases.
  • Reports to the Engineering Manager in the TMNA Production Engineering, Plant Engineering group.
  • Expected traits: attention to detail, schedule ownership, clear communication, continuous improvement mindset, and ability to remove barriers while demonstrating values.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Create, revise, and maintain 2D CAD drawings and 3D BIM / Revit models under PE direction and project standards.
  • Modify and edit facility, utility, and process equipment installation layouts across mechanical, electrical, piping, HVAC, pneumatic, hydraulic drawing disciplines as directed.
  • Elevating any issues found during the design modifications that present issues to the construction ability (e.g. inconsistencies, dimension busts, interferences and model collision or interferences.)
  • Coordination / Document Control
  • Coordinate drawing/model updates with Plant Engineering and A/E Design Firm and support drawing sharing with various Production Engineering shops as needed.
  • Maintain CAD files, drawing registers, revisions, document-control records, and release workflows within Autodesk Forma while adhering to revision numbering, clouding while maintaining proper version control of criteria drawings, drawing review comments, and design drawings.
  • Support production and installation teams through drawing updates and drawing status reporting as directed.
 
Requirements:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Associate degree, technical certification, CAD/drafting certificate, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of CAD experience in industrial facility design and construction environments.
  • Advanced to Expert AutoCAD capability for modifying 2D/3D layouts, plant utilities, supplied equipment layouts,
  • Working proficiency with Autodesk Revit, Inventor, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Autodesk Forma and BlueBeam programs.
  • Manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.
  • Communicate clearly with engineers, program mangers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Own schedule follow-up, timely status reporting and issue escalation
  • Autodesk Vault experience, including check-in/check-out, revision history, lifecycle/release workflow, and drawing search/retrieval.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D, Civil 3D, SolidWorks, or other CAD/BIM/model coordination tools beyond the required Autodesk platform.
  • AutoCAD Electrical, UniDraf, or similar systems for electrical, controls, or schematic drawing updates.
  • Automotive or high-volume automated production experience.
  • Drawing support of new plant startup, brownfield equipment installation, major model change, or production ramp-up support.
  • Facility utilities such as compressed air, chilled water, process exhaust, HVAC, ventilation, chemical/process utilities, or electrical power distribution.
  • CAD automation, drawing templates, BOM export workflows, spare-part documentation, or maintenance-support drawings.
  • Mentoring junior CAD technicians or improving CAD standards, layer conventions, title blocks, and release processes.

job.title: Senior Accountant - E-Commerce Accounting
job.description:
Senior Accountant – E-Commerce Accounting within gaming industry

The role is leave coverage and will start ASAP. The team is off for holiday break December 24-January 3. This role will pick back up on January 4 and go through end of February.
Remote is an option but must be able to work PST hours!

$60-70/hr on W2

*CANDIDATES MUST BE ABLE TO WORK DIRECTLY ON A W2 WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP. NO C2C!! 

Inventory • COGS • Sales • Cash Application • SAP & System Integrations

Position Summary
The consultant will support full-cycle accounting for the online store, from customer orders and inventory movement through revenue, cost of goods sold, accounts receivable, cash application, refunds, and financial reporting. This role will partner with Accounting, Operations, E-commerce, Supply Chain, and IT to resolve reconciliation and system-integration issues involving e-commerce, order management, inventory, payment, and SAP platforms.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own full-cycle accounting for online store activity, including inventory, sales, cost of goods sold, accounts receivable, cash, refunds, credits, and related balance sheet accounts.
  • Perform monthly and quarterly close activities, including journal entries, account reconciliations, variance analysis, and review of transaction completeness and accuracy.
  • Reconcile inventory subledger activity to SAP, including receipts, transfers, adjustments, returns, write-offs, and inventory reserves where applicable.
  • Review and reconcile cost of goods sold to product sales and inventory movement, investigating unusual margins, timing differences, and data issues.
  • Support the complete order-to-cash cycle, including sales orders, fulfillment, billing, revenue recognition, customer receivables, refunds, credits, and cash application.
  • Reconcile payment processor and bank activity to customer orders, accounts receivable, and SAP postings; research unmatched or failed transactions.
  • Partner with Operations, E-commerce, Supply Chain, IT, and Finance teams to understand transaction flows across multiple systems and ensure accurate accounting in SAP.
  • Investigate integration issues between sales, order management, inventory/warehouse, payment, and SAP systems, and determine the accounting impact of incomplete, duplicated, delayed, or incorrect transactions.
  • Participate in system implementations, integration changes, user acceptance testing, and validation of automated accounting entries and interfaces.
  • Develop and maintain reconciliation tools and controls to confirm that data transferred between operational systems and SAP is complete and accurate.
  • Identify root causes of accounting and system issues, coordinate resolution with technical and operational teams, and help prevent recurring problems.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, system flow documentation, and internal controls for online store accounting processes.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and strengthen accounting processes as online store activity and systems evolve.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • Approximately 2–6 years of accounting experience, preferably including inventory, revenue, order-to-cash, e-commerce, retail, or consumer product accounting.
  • Strong understanding of general ledger accounting, reconciliations, month-end close, inventory accounting, revenue, accounts receivable, and cash.
  • Experience with SAP strongly preferred; experience with other large ERP systems is also valuable.
  • Experience working with e-commerce platforms, order management systems, warehouse/inventory systems, payment processors, or system integrations is a plus.
  • Strong Excel and data analysis skills, with the ability to work through large transaction populations and identify exceptions.
  • Ability to understand end-to-end transaction flows and translate operational or system issues into accounting impacts.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

job.title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
job.description:
Job Title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
Type: Full Time
Location: Holmdel, NJ
Salary: $200000 + 15% bonus



Position Summary The Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise observability strategy, operating model, and platform roadmap that enable proactive, predictive, and resilient technology operations.

This leader owns the enterprise capabilities for monitoring, telemetry, event intelligence, operational analytics, and observability engineering, ensuring technology services are observable, measurable, actionable, and continuously improving.
The role serves as the operational intelligence leader across Enterprise Technology, providing the platforms, standards, insights, and governance required to improve service reliability, accelerate issue detection and resolution, and support modern operational practices.
This leader partners closely with infrastructure, cloud, middleware, application, security, resiliency, and service management teams to build a unified enterprise-wide observability capability.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Observability Strategy
  • Define and execute the enterprise observability vision, strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap.
  • Establish standards and governance for monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, alerting, and service observability.
  • Lead the evolution of observability capabilities from reactive monitoring toward proactive, predictive, and automated operations.
  • Drive enterprise adoption of modern observability practices, frameworks, and engineering standards.

Observability Platform Ownership
  • Own the strategy, architecture, lifecycle, and operation of enterprise monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Lead platform modernization, tool rationalization, capability expansion, and service offering improvements.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, platform investments, and cost optimization efforts.
  • Ensure scalability, availability, resilience, and ongoing enhancement of observability tooling and services.

Monitoring and Telemetry Services
  • Establish enterprise monitoring and instrumentation standards across infrastructure, cloud, middleware, applications, databases, and digital services.
  • Improve monitoring coverage, telemetry quality, alert effectiveness, signal quality, and operational visibility.
  • Drive adoption of distributed tracing, service dependency mapping, and end-to-end transaction monitoring.
  • Ensure service health and operational data are consistently available across the technology landscape.

Operational Intelligence and AIOps
  • Lead implementation of operational analytics, event intelligence, anomaly detection, predictive insights, and AIOps capabilities.
  • Develop dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide actionable operational intelligence to technology leadership.
  • Enable intelligent event correlation, noise reduction, automated diagnostics, and automated operational workflows.
  • Partner with engineering and operations teams to use observability data for continuous improvement and outage prevention.

Reliability and Incident Enablement
  • Partner with technology teams to improve detection, response, recovery, and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Establish observability practices that improve service reliability, operational resilience, and customer experience.
  • Drive post-incident learning and identification of automation opportunities.
  • Provide enterprise visibility into technology health, performance trends, capacity risks, and reliability risks.

Leadership and Talent Development
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of observability engineers, platform engineers, and operational intelligence specialists.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, operational excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional partnership.
  • Lead organizational adoption of observability best practices through enablement, coaching, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Establish strong partnerships across technology, cybersecurity, architecture, engineering, operations, resiliency, and service management functions.

Qualifications
  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure operations, platform engineering, observability, reliability engineering, or related technology disciplines.
  • 5+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale engineering or operational teams.
  • Deep expertise in observability platforms, monitoring technologies, telemetry pipelines, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and operational analytics.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing enterprise monitoring strategies and improving operational reliability at scale.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, hybrid infrastructure, automation, DevOps practices, and modern operational architectures.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation and driving adoption of new operational capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.

Success Measures
  • Increased enterprise monitoring and observability coverage.
  • Reduced mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
  • Improved signal quality and reduced alert fatigue.
  • Increased adoption of observability standards and platform capabilities.
  • Improved service reliability, operational resilience, and operational efficiency.
  • Expansion of predictive analytics, automation, and AIOps capabilities across Enterprise Technology.

job.title: Senior Angular & NodeJS Developer - Onsite, Southlake, TX - W2 Only
job.description:
The Opportunity We are seeking a Senior Angular and Node.js Developer to join a collaborative engineering team responsible for building and supporting modern web applications and digital experiences.

This role will focus on developing features across the front-end and backend, working with Angular, Node.js, APIs, microservices, automated testing, and cloud-based delivery environments. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on Angular experience, understands modern Angular features, and can work effectively across the full technology stack.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, test, document, and maintain responsive web applications
  • Build and maintain applications using Angular and Node.js
  • Develop and consume APIs that integrate with downstream microservices
  • Read and interpret API contracts using tools such as Swagger or OpenAPI
  • Work with OAuth and other application security concepts
  • Develop comprehensive unit and end-to-end automated tests
  • Build and maintain test coverage using Playwright and other testing frameworks
  • Work within an Nx monorepo environment
  • Develop and support CI/CD pipelines and automated delivery processes
  • Apply blue-green deployment concepts and other release strategies
  • Collaborate with cross-functional Agile teams to design and deliver features
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Own small-to-medium-sized features from technical design through completion
  • Participate in iteration planning and contribute to consistent sprint delivery
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for applications and subsystems
  • Stay current with emerging technologies, cloud infrastructure, and software engineering practices
  • Use AI-assisted development tools, including prompt engineering and reusable development skills, where appropriate
Required Qualifications
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Strong experience developing responsive web applications using Angular
  • Experience with modern Angular features, including Angular Signals
  • Strong experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Hands-on Node.js development experience
  • Experience building and consuming APIs
  • Understanding of HTTP-based APIs, networking, and web application fundamentals
  • Experience with asynchronous JavaScript, including promises, callbacks, and event loops
  • Experience with API design, development, and microservices architectures
  • Experience with unit and end-to-end testing
  • Experience with Playwright or a comparable end-to-end testing framework
  • Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and automated software delivery
  • Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform
  • Strong understanding of Agile software development practices
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and documentation skills
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Nx monorepos
  • Experience with Angular 20 or newer
  • Experience with Swagger or OpenAPI
  • Experience with OAuth and API security
  • Experience with blue-green deployment strategies
  • Experience with Node.js frameworks such as Express
  • Experience with JavaScript tooling such as ESLint, Webpack, Gulp, or similar technologies
  • Experience with testing tools such as Mocha, Jasmine, Selenium, or Protractor
  • Experience with browser developer tools and visual design principles
  • Experience with rapid prototyping
  • Proficiency with an IDE such as VS Code or WebStorm
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools and prompt engineering
Additional Information The successful candidate will be comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative Agile environment and contributing across the full software development lifecycle, from technical design through deployment and ongoing support.

job.title: Sr Serverless DevOps Engineer (100% remote MST/CST/EST)
job.description:
Senior Serverless DevOps Engineer
Full-time (Direct Hire)
Location: 100% Remote (candidates must reside/work in MST/CST/EST time zones)
 
Overview
We’re seeking a senior-level DevOps engineer to help design, secure, and operate an AWS-first, serverless platform supporting multiple engineering teams. This is a hands-on role with significant ownership across infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, reliability, observability, and security.
 
What You’ll Do
  • Build and maintain shared cloud infrastructure and platform services used across engineering teams
  • Design and evolve Infrastructure as Code using Terraform/Terragrunt (modular, multi-account, well-governed)
  • Develop CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred) and modern release strategies (canary/linear, blue/green, automated testing)
  • Support and optimize serverless/event-driven systems (AWS Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, Step Functions)
  • Implement least-privilege IAM and security best practices (Secrets Manager, KMS, encryption in transit/at rest)
  • Improve observability and debugging (CloudWatch, Logs Insights, alarms, X-Ray/ServiceLens, structured logging)
  • Partner cross-functionally with software and data engineering to troubleshoot, unblock, and improve delivery velocity
  • Participate in code reviews, quality gates, and Agile ceremonies (standups, planning, refinement)
 
Required Experience / Skills
  • 7–10+ years in DevOps, software engineering, and/or systems administration (hands-on)
  • Strong AWS experience, including serverless production workloads
  • Strong Terraform experience; Terragrunt experience highly preferred - CI/CD pipeline ownership experience (GitHub Actions preferred; comparable tools considered)
  • Scripting/automation in Python and/or Node.js plus Bash
  • Solid fundamentals in cloud networking and security (VPC, subnets, security groups, NAT, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, IAM)
  • Containerization knowledge (Docker; Lambda container images and/or Fargate for longer-running workloads)
  • Familiarity with data-layer operations (DynamoDB, S3 lifecycle, Aurora Serverless)
  • Experience supporting organizations implementing multi-account governance (e.g., Control Tower concepts)
  • Comfort using AI-assisted developer tools (e.g., Copilot/Claude/Codex) to accelerate delivery

job.title: Solution Architect – Corporate Functions Finance, Risk, Investments
job.description:
Solutions Architect – Corporate Functions (Finance, Risk, Investments)
Direct Hire
Hybrid (NY/NJ/CT/PA)
 
Overview
We’re seeking a Solutions Architect to drive solution design and delivery architecture across a portfolio supporting corporate functions including Finance, Risk, and Investments. This role requires a strong blend of enterprise architecture + hands-on engineering mindset, with the ability to partner directly with business stakeholders and present technical direction to senior leaders.
This is a highly visible role where you will influence solution strategy, guide delivery teams, and ensure designs align to architecture standards, security requirements, and modern engineering practices.
 
Work Location / Schedule
Hybrid (3 days onsite per week) — candidates must be able to work onsite in one of the following locations:
  • New Jersey (Holmdel area)
  • New York, NY
  • Stamford, CT
  • Bethlehem, PA
 
What You’ll Do
  • Own product/team-level solution architecture and delivery design within a value stream.
  • Design and document end-to-end architectures across application, integration, data, and infrastructure.
  • Partner with product owners and technical leads to align roadmaps, MVP scope, and trade-offs.
  • Ensure solutions align to architecture standards, security requirements, and established patterns/guardrails.
  • Collaborate with enterprise/platform teams to reuse shared capabilities and reduce duplication.
  • Identify and help remove technical dependencies and delivery impediments.
  • Provide hands-on guidance on design quality, code structure, and technical approaches.
  • Lead proof-of-concepts and help evaluate emerging tools and frameworks (including GenAI where applicable).
  • Mentor engineers on architecture principles and decision-making.
  • Continuously seek opportunities to reduce technical debt, simplify designs, and improve delivery efficiency.
  • Participate as needed during major production incidents affecting business operations.
 
What We’re Looking For
  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale technology solutions.
  • Strong working knowledge of cloud platforms, APIs, data integration, and modern application architectures.
  • Experience designing hybrid architectures (mix of on-prem + public cloud).
  • Experience working in Agile / product-based delivery models.
  • Strong communication skills—able to translate technical concepts for business partners and delivery stakeholders.
  • Experience producing technical design documentation at product/team level.
  • Background supporting business-critical systems in regulated environments; insurance domain experience is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with GenAI frameworks/tools/best practices is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle strategic conversations, challenging discussions, and executive-facing presentations.
 
Work Authorization
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States. No sponsorship available.

job.title: Registered Nurse/Healthcare Instructor-remote
job.description:
Registered Nurse/Healthcare Instructor- needed for a full-time remote contract opportunity with Yoh’s client located around Saint Claire, Maryland.

Summary: Our client is seeking experienced healthcare professionals to serve as Service Delivery Healthcare Instructors.

In this role, instructor delivers Advanced Life Support (ALS), Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS), Neonatal Advanced Life Support (NALS) and in some cases Basic Life Support (BLS) courses to healthcare providers nationwide.

This position offers flexible scheduling opportunities and the ability to make a meaningful impact by preparing healthcare teams to respond effectively during emergencies. Instructors represent the client with professionalism while delivering high-quality, evidence-based education that supports improved patient outcomes and healthcare readiness.

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Deliver instructor-led ALS, BLS, PALS, and/or NALS courses in accordance with our client curriculum, policies, and quality standards.
  • Facilitate engaging educational experiences for healthcare professionals using classroom instruction, skills practice, and simulation-based learning.
  • Travel to training locations nationwide to conduct in-person courses and educational programs.
  • Prepare, set up, operate, and return training equipment and course materials in accordance with organizational standards.
  • Ensure accurate completion of course records, participant documentation, evaluations, and reporting requirements.
  • Maintain compliance with all administrative, instructional, and quality assurance requirements.
  • Represent the client professionally and uphold the organization's mission, values, and commitment to excellence.
  • Communicate effectively with Service Delivery regarding scheduling, travel logistics, equipment needs, and course delivery.
  • Maintain current knowledge of program updates, instructional methodologies, and healthcare resuscitation guidelines.
  • Participate in quality improvement and instructor development activities as required
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Current professional licensure or certification as one of the following:
    Nationally Registered Paramedic (NRP), Registered Nurse (RN), Certified Nurse Midwife (CNM) Certified Professional Midwife (CPM), Nurse Practitioner (NP),Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA),Respiratory Therapist (RT), Physician Assistant (PA)
  • Current certification as an ALS, PALS, and/or NALS
  • Current or recent clinical experience in emergency medical services, emergency medicine, critical care, neonatal care, pediatrics, or other relevant healthcare settings.
  • Previous experience delivering healthcare education, professional training, simulation-based learning, or clinical instruction preferred.
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to engage adult learners and adapt instruction to a variety of healthcare audiences.
  • Ability to travel extensively and independently throughout the United States.
  • Reliable transportation and ability to manage travel logistics.
  • Proficiency with basic technology and audiovisual equipment used in healthcare education.
  • Ability to work independently and maintain professionalism.

    Physical Requirements:
  • Ability to lift, transport, and set up training equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand and instruct for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to demonstrate healthcare skills, including CPR and emergency response techniques.
  • Ability to travel frequently by air and ground transportation.

job.title: Quality Assurance Manager
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Assurance Manager for our medical device manufacturing client in the Los Angeles Metropolitan Area. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company's Quality Management System (QMS).

The Quality Assurance Manager will ensure compliance with ISO 13485, FDA Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), EU MDR, MDSAP, and applicable regulatory requirements while leading quality initiatives, supplier quality programs, audits, CAPA investigations, and continuous improvement efforts. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on medical device quality experience, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to collaborate across Regulatory Affairs, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and executive leadership.

Industry: Medical Device / Healthcare Products
Location: Los Angeles Metropolitan Area – Onsite
Compensation: $129,000–$165,000 annually (based upon experience)
Type: Direct Hire / Full-Time
Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Vacation

Job Functions:
  • Manage, maintain, and continuously improve the company's Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with ISO 13485, FDA QMSR, EU MDR, MDSAP, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee document control, change control, training records, nonconformances, deviations, and other core Quality System processes.
  • Develop, review, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, quality procedures, and controlled documentation to ensure regulatory compliance.
  • Lead internal, supplier, customer, Notified Body, MDSAP, and regulatory audits while maintaining continuous inspection readiness.
  • Develop and execute risk-based internal audit schedules and coordinate audit preparation, execution, responses, and corrective actions.
  • Serve as a key Quality representative during external audits and regulatory inspections, including FDA and Notified Body inspections.
  • Lead the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) program, including investigations, root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and effectiveness verification.
  • Monitor CAPA, nonconformance, and audit trends to identify systemic quality issues and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs to support EU MDR compliance, technical documentation, post-market surveillance, risk management, and regulatory change assessments.
  • Manage supplier quality activities, including supplier qualification, audits, monitoring, quality agreements, corrective actions, and performance evaluations.
  • Evaluate supplier changes and quality events to determine potential impacts on product quality and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with Operations and Supply Chain to ensure appropriate controls are maintained for incoming products, materials, and components.
  • Oversee or support receiving inspections, product testing, sampling, and material disposition activities.
  • Support manufacturing, packaging, sterilization, and inspection process validation and qualification activities.
  • Oversee product complaint handling and quality investigations, ensuring appropriate documentation, escalation, and resolution.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs to support regulatory reporting and post-market surveillance requirements.
  • Develop, monitor, and report Quality KPIs, including CAPA performance, complaints, supplier quality, audit findings, nonconformances, and training compliance.
  • Analyze Quality System performance data and identify opportunities for corrective action and continuous improvement.
  • Prepare Quality Management Review reports and presentations for executive leadership.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop Quality team members while establishing performance expectations and departmental priorities.
  • Provide training and guidance on QMS requirements, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), documentation practices, and quality procedures.
  • Support the implementation and optimization of electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS).
  • Promote a culture of quality, regulatory compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organization.

Education and/or Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, Biomedical Sciences, or a related technical discipline required.
  • Minimum of five (5) to seven (7) years of progressive Quality Assurance experience within the medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Previous experience working within a medical device Quality Management System required.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485 and FDA medical device quality system requirements, including FDA QMSR.
  • Demonstrated experience with CAPA, nonconformance management, root cause investigations, document control, change control, complaint handling, and internal auditing.
  • Experience participating in and/or leading FDA, Notified Body, MDSAP, customer, supplier, and certification audits.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage audit findings, regulatory observations, and corrective actions through successful closure.
  • Strong understanding of risk-based decision-making and quality risk management principles.
  • Experience developing and analyzing quality metrics and presenting Quality System performance to management.
  • Strong technical writing skills with experience developing SOPs, work instructions, investigation reports, CAPAs, audit responses, and controlled documentation.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to train, mentor, and develop Quality team members.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple departments and organizational levels.
  • Ability to independently identify Quality System gaps, develop corrective solutions, and drive improvements through implementation.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with EU MDR 2017/745, including Quality System requirements and Notified Body audits.
  • Experience supporting MDSAP audits and regulatory inspections.
  • Experience with disposable or sterile medical devices, including syringes, needles, drug-delivery devices, blood collection products, or similar single-use medical products.
  • Experience managing supplier quality programs, global suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
  • Knowledge of ISO 14971 risk management, post-market surveillance, validation, sterilization, packaging, and medical device manufacturing controls.
  • Experience implementing or managing electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS).
  • Familiarity with international regulatory requirements and global supply chain quality management.
  • Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) are highly desirable.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Full-time, onsite work environment within a medical device manufacturing and distribution organization.
  • Position involves both office-based Quality Management activities and hands-on support of manufacturing, warehouse, and quality operations.
  • Regular use of computers and standard office equipment for documentation, data analysis, reporting, and communication.
  • May require standing, walking, or moving throughout manufacturing and warehouse areas during audits, inspections, and Quality System assessments.
  • Must be able to review detailed technical documentation, quality records, inspection reports, and regulatory information.
  • Must follow applicable safety procedures and facility requirements when working in manufacturing or controlled environments.

#IND-SPG

job.title: Senior Azure Data Engineer
job.description:
Senior Azure Data Engineer
Direct Hire
Plano, TX (Onsite)

Ready to put your Azure Databricks expertise to work on a modern, enterprise-scale data platform? This is an opportunity to tackle complex, high-volume data challenges while helping shape a sophisticated lakehouse environment built for scale, performance, and advanced analytics.

Our client is seeking a Senior Azure Data Engineer with deep hands-on experience in Azure Databricks to design, build, and optimize scalable data solutions using PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Python, SQL, and the broader Azure data ecosystem. You’ll work alongside data architects, data scientists, business stakeholders, and cloud teams while providing technical leadership and helping drive data engineering best practices.

Candidates must currently reside in the Dallas–Fort Worth (DFW) area and be able to work a hybrid schedule in Plano, TX. Relocation is not available. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

Overview
We’re partnering with a confidential, enterprise-scale organization to hire a Senior Azure Data Engineer with deep expertise in Azure Databricks to help design, build, and optimize a modern lakehouse data platform. You’ll develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, implement Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) patterns, and enable advanced analytics in a high-volume environment. This role collaborates closely with data architects, data scientists, business stakeholders, and cloud/infrastructure teams to deliver secure, reliable, high-performance data solutions.
What You’ll Do
  • Design and build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL).
  • Develop ingestion workflows from multiple source systems (e.g., Event Hub, APIs, Azure SQL, Blob Storage) into Bronze/Silver/Gold layers.
  • Implement best practices for Delta Lake and Unity Catalog (schema evolution, versioning, governance).
  • Optimize pipeline performance and cost through partitioning, caching, clustering, and Spark tuning.
  • Integrate Databricks with ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse, Event Hub, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps.
  • Implement secure access controls using managed identities, RBAC, and data protection practices (e.g., masking).
  • Partner with analytics and business teams to deliver trusted datasets, metrics, and KPIs.
  • Provide technical leadership through mentoring, code reviews, and architectural guidance.
  • Work with enterprise architecture and security teams to align with data privacy/security policies.
  • Implement data quality checks, alerting, and lineage tracking using tools such as Great Expectations, Unity Catalog, and data observability platforms.
  • Build monitoring dashboards, alerts, and recovery mechanisms for critical pipelines.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience, including 3+ years with Azure Databricks / Apache Spark (PySpark).
  • Strong experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks notebooks, and SQL-based warehousing patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with ADLS Gen2, Event Hub, ADF, Key Vault, Synapse.
  • Strong coding skills in Python and SQL; familiarity with Scala is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (OLTP/OLAP), star/snowflake schemas, and performance tuning.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD for Databricks using Databricks CLI, Terraform, and/or Azure DevOps.
  • Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional).
  • Streaming/real-time pipelines (Structured Streaming, Event Hub, Kafka).
  • ML platform exposure (e.g., MLflow or supporting ML pipelines).
  • Reporting/consumption layer experience (e.g., Power BI, Purview, Microsoft Fabric).
  • Knowledge of governance/compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2).

job.description:
Title: Z/OS Systems Programmer
Type: Full Time
Location: Nashville, TN - Hybrid

Our client is world's largest custodian bank and securities services company. 


In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: 

  • Oversee a broad range of delivery projects to fulfill both hardware and software Lifecycle Management. Responsible for managing the teams that administer multiple Mainframes running on z/OS systems using various technologies like JCL, DB2, IMS, CICS, Source code management, SDLC practices and Security mechanisms such as ACF2, RACF and TSS.
  • Responsible for rethinking the assumptions behind how traditional services are built and thinking about how to modernize, enhance and continuously improve capabilities through innovation and automation.
  • Leverage your breadth of experience to lead the organization through cross-functional and collaborative efforts. Partner with solutioning Data center services, Production Services Application Developers to shape new opportunities. 
  • An engaged and motivated contributor, you will see the value in our team. Coach, mentor and leverage our talent management processes to effectively lead managers, build your talent and create a highly engaged team.
     
To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: 

  • **EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS: ** - bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. - Advanced certifications in infrastructure engineering or related disciplines preferred.
  • **EXPERIENCE: ** Typically 6-10 years of experience. 
  • **SKILLS: ** - Expertise in infrastructure design and implementation. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Effective collaboration and communication abilities.
  • 10+ years of diverse experience in multiple areas of information technology required; experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus.
  • Experienced in diverse mainframe technical environments. Experienced in one or more mainframe infrastructure, hardware, system programming technologies and/or application development. Alternative experiences must include high learning agility to acquire mainframe technology knowledge and apply previous experiences to achieve operational outcomes.
  • Direct Mainframe experience is a necessity as is the ability to lead a technical team, build relationships, and possess a strategic mindset to drive the team to successful outcomes.
  • Possess communication skills to appropriately lead at the client/team/Business unit levels.
  • Experienced leading complex projects and programs.
  • Experience in tooling, utilities, and data transport,
  • Experience in Architecture and design principles
  • Skilled communicator that can influence internal and external stakeholders at multiple levels and be able to navigate complex technical topics and communicate them with clarity, brevity, and impact. Able to manage up, down and across organizations, clients and/or functions.
Preferred

  • Knowledge in one or more areas of mainframe discipline.
  • ITIL or ITSM oversight or expertise in Release, Change and CMDB
  • Installation knowledge of ISV SW and IBM Operating systems
  • Knowledge of z/OS, PARMLIB, Unix SYSTEMS services, HCD
  • Knowledge of SMP/E or maintenance routines if applicable
  • Knowledge in JCL
  • Knowledge system IPL processes
  • Knowledge of ISPF/TSO
  • Framework experience in building and maintaining a mainframe platform

job.title: Safety Engineering - Phoenix, AZ
job.description:
SAFTEY ENGINEER - Phoenix, AZ

Work Type: 100% on-site

Shift : Monday – Friday – 8 AM – 5PM

Bill rate : $29- $38.

We are seeking a Safety Representative to support the TSMC account in Phoenix, AZ. The Safety Representative will represent Applied Materials Safety in the field to ensure the health and safety of our engineers working at TSMC.

This position is not eligible for holidays, weekends, or overtime.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5 years of industrial, construction, or manufacturing experience
  • OSHA 30-Hour for Construction or General Industry (must provide proof)
  • Ability to identify hazards and assist with implementation of corrective actions
  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to operate independently with minimal supervision
  • Ability to spend up to 6+ hours a day in the cleanroom, comfortable wearing a cleanroom suit, and spending majority of their day on their feet / walking.
Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2 + years of safety experience (ideally in manufacturing or semiconductor)
  • EHS Certification (e.g., CHST, OHST, ASP, or GSP)
  • Science-related degree
  • OSHA 510 or 511
The Role of a Safety Representative:

  1. Safety Compliance?
    • Ensure adherence to OSHA, tsmc, and Applied Materials safety requirements by communicating expectations and enforcing standards across all Applied Materials employees working in the fab.?
  2. Hazard Identification and Intervention?
    • Proactively identify hazards, verify controls, and intervene to correct unsafe conditions and behaviors in real-time to prevent incidents.?
  3. “Boots-on-the-Ground” Safety?
    • Maintain a strong field presence as visible safety leaders, embedding safety into daily operations.
  4. Work Execution Support
    • Support safe work planning and execution through direct employee engagement.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain a strong field presence (required to spend a minimum 4 hours per day in the fab)
  • Participate in morning pass-downs with the engineering teams to understand work activities for the day and reinforce important safety messaging.?
  • Audit work activities performed by Applied Materials engineers for safety compliance against OSHA, tsmc and Applied Materials standards.
  • Audit all Applied workers, work areas, and laydown/storage areas for 6S compliance.
  • Actively identify hazards and assist with the implementation of immediate corrective actions.
  • Provide real-time guidance to Applied Materials employees and subcontractors.
  • Provide oversight during high-risk work tasks to prevent incidents.
  • Review and sign off on daily inspection forms.
  • Confirm required permits, PPE, and controls are implemented prior to the start of work.
  • Intervene and stop work when unsafe conditions or behaviors are observed.
  • Document audit results into the Applied Materials inspection platform.
  • Communicate issues and violations with the Safety Engineer or Manager that cannot be resolved otherwise.
Why Work with Yoh? Yoh has connected top talent with leading employers for more than 80 years. As a Yoh consultant, you will receive personalized recruiter support, competitive compensation, access to opportunities with industry-leading companies such as Applied Materials, and a dedicated team committed to helping you succeed throughout your career journey. Why Join Applied Materials? Excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer to gain hands-on manufacturing experience supporting advanced semiconductor products in a fast-paced production environment.

contact:  Patty Vogel at patty.vogel@yoh.com

job.title: BSA/Product Owner
job.description:
Job Title: Business Systems Analyst/Product Owner
Location: Plano, TX (Hybrid – Onsite 3 Days/Week)
Duration: 6-Month Contract
Work Authorization: W2 Only (No C2C)

Responsibilities:
  • Define, document, and prioritize business, system, and product requirements aligned with organizational goals and customer needs.
  • Lead requirement-gathering efforts, including JAD sessions, with stakeholders to ensure shared understanding and alignment across business and technology teams.
  • Gain and maintain deep knowledge of business processes and system capabilities to ensure requests align with operational constraints and best practices.
  • Serve as the liaison between internal/external stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring clear, timely, and positive communication.
  • Create and manage a structured product backlog with well-crafted user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature prioritization.
  • Own and refine the product vision and roadmap, adjusting strategy based on market trends, stakeholder feedback, and evolving business needs.
  • Conduct gap analyses between current system functionality and new business requirements, collaborating closely with architects and developers.
  • Partner with Project Managers to support end-to-end project delivery, from planning through release.
  • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Daily Stand-ups, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate that deliverables meet business and functional expectations.
  • Effectively manage competing priorities using strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and emerging technologies to help guide product and process improvements.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in business systems analysis or related roles, including 3+ years in Agile environments.
  • Proven experience in business requirements gathering, process documentation, and gap analysis.
  • Skilled in writing clear and actionable user stories, business requirements, and managing product backlogs.
  • Ability to translate complex business needs into technical specifications and product features.
  • Proficient in tools such as Azure DevOps, SharePoint, and Confluence.
  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving capabilities.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across levels.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adept at multitasking in fast-paced settings.
  • Capable of thriving in both team-driven and independent work environments.

job.title: Technical Vehicle Services (Service Excellence Tech Writer)
job.description:
Mid-Level Vehicle Systems Technician (Service Excellence Tech Writer)
Seeking a technician to support a vehicle systems program focused on documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and general system support. This role emphasizes electrical systems, wire harnesses, CAD navigation, and system-level software rather than traditional mechanical repair. Candidates with experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields are encouraged to apply.

Scope:
• Write and maintain service manuals, service SOPs, work instructions, troubleshooting guides, and technical reports.
• Convert engineering requirements and test results into clear, repeatable service procedures.
• Document test results, repairs, defects, system configurations, and corrective actions.
• Test, inspect, troubleshoot, and validate electrical and electromechanical vehicle systems.
• Read and interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, pinouts, and system documentation.
• Navigate and review existing CAD models, assemblies, drawings, and model trees.
• Locate components, dimensions, notes, features, and design information within CAD files.
• Use basic CAD functions such as view controls, section views, measurements, layers, and assembly navigation.
• Use diagnostic, logging, flashing, and network analysis tools to identify and resolve issues.
• Support root-cause analysis and collaborate with engineering, validation, service, and operations teams.
• Maintain organized lab, shop, vehicle, tool, and inventory areas.

Required:
• Automotive experience required.
• Technician experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields.
• Experience working in a lab or shop environment, including tool and inventory management.
• Comfortable working in a team environment; this is not a solo position.
• Proficiency with hand tools and electrical test equipment, including multimeters, continuity testers, oscilloscopes, and power supplies.
• Experience using diagnostic, logging, flashing, or network analysis tools to troubleshoot hardware and software systems.
• Ability to read and follow schematics, wiring diagrams, manuals, and technical procedures.
• Ability to navigate and interpret existing CAD files; CAD design or modeling experience is not required.
• Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.

Pluses:
• Experience troubleshooting vehicle or embedded system software.
• Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Ethernet.
• Experience with sensors, calibration, or system validation testing.
• Experience with CAD tools such as CATIA, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Creo, or similar platforms.



Estimated Min Rate: $35.00
Estimated Max Rate: $45.00/hr+. Depends on work experience

Whether you're looking to grow your manufacturing career, increase your income, or gain experience with an industry-leading employer, we want to hear from you!

✔ Competitive Pay: $20.00 - $22.00 per hour

✔ Multiple Shifts Available: Find a schedule that works for you

  • Performing inspections and quality checks using testing equipment

✅ 1+ year of recent manufacturing or production experience

✅ Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

job.title: Preclinical Study Manager, Research and Early Development, Hybrid Cambridge, MA
job.description:
Preclinical Study Manager, Research and Early Development, Hybrid Cambridge, MA
  The Opportunity We are seeking a Preclinical Study Manager to oversee externally contracted in vivo and in vitro studies supporting research and early development programs. This role will collaborate with internal research and development teams to design, manage, track, and report preclinical studies conducted through external Contract Research Organizations (CROs).

The Study Manager will help assess CRO capabilities, prepare requests for proposals, evaluate bids and timelines, coordinate study awards, and ensure outsourced studies remain aligned with approved budgets and development plans. The role will also support protocol development, study monitoring, data reporting, documentation, and long-term financial forecasting.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple studies, vendors, timelines, and priorities in a fast-paced biotechnology or pharmaceutical environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and submit study concepts and requests for proposals to qualified CROs
  • Obtain and evaluate CRO proposals, budgets, and timelines
  • Negotiate study scope, costs, and timelines as appropriate
  • Coordinate with Toxicology, DMPK, Bioanalysis, Biology, Pathology, CMC, Program Management, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Sample Management teams
  • Prepare statements of work and support CRO contract review and processing
  • Assist with protocol development, amendments, animal orders, test article projections, and shipments
  • Maintain complete and organized study files, including schedules, contracts, protocols, correspondence, and reports
  • Track internal and external report timelines and study deliverables
  • Coordinate test article supplies, orders, characterization, stability testing, and retesting
  • Conduct CRO site visits at key study milestones
  • Participate in pre-study, operational, progress, and pre-reporting meetings with CRO partners
  • Support budget forecasting, contract awards, invoice review, and financial tracking
  • Manage outsourced GLP and non-GLP preclinical studies, including pharmacokinetic, toxicology, and biodistribution studies
  • Serve as a primary contact for CRO partners and provide ongoing study oversight
  • Troubleshoot issues, communicate changes, and track study activities across vendors and project teams
  • Participate in CRO selection and qualification activities
  • Maintain integrated schedules for internal and external preclinical studies
  • Help coordinate meetings, resources, workloads, and study priorities
  • Support process improvement initiatives
  • Ensure studies are conducted in accordance with applicable global regulatory guidelines
  • Take on additional projects as needed
Qualifications
  • Ph.D. in Biology, Toxicology, or a related field preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Toxicology, or a related discipline with at least six years of relevant experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or a CRO environment
  • Previous study direction or study coordination experience within a CRO is highly preferred
  • Experience managing outsourced preclinical studies, preferably in a GLP environment
  • Knowledge of global regulatory guidelines, including ICH, GLP, and OECD standards
  • Experience with laboratory animal research studies is a plus
  • Working knowledge of invoicing, accounting, budgeting, or contract management
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to critically review study documentation
  • Excellent organizational, multitasking, time-management, and program-management skills
  • Experience with project scheduling and study-tracking tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and cross-functional project teams
  • Ability to manage changing priorities, timelines, and deliverables in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness to travel periodically for CRO site visits and study-related meetings
Additional Information This role may require onsite work and periodic domestic travel, with occasional international travel depending on business needs. The position involves managing multiple preclinical studies and CRO relationships across research and early development programs.

job.title: Materials Program Manager (MPM) - Bay Area
job.description:
Materials Program Manager (MPM) - SF Bay Area

Looking for a solid Materials Program Manager to support an autonomous vehicle companies Supply Chain department. This person should have a background in materials planning and understand the key vendors involved in electronics components, mechanical components, automotive components, etc.

 

The key responsibility for this job will be manual demand planning (Manual MRP experience). There is no SAP, ERP, or SW suite that will be utilized, this is all manual production planning/Manual MRP’s through Excel/GSheets, so advanced Excel or GSheet’s experience is a must have.

 

Scope:

• Strong understanding of the “Clear To Build” report AKA CTB. Some companies call it a shortage report or build status report. This is the MPM's primary task which will be focused on. Note: CTB “Clear to Build” is essentially an MRP. Building stuff in batches/batch building aka Batch Production, job production, lot production, etc. are all additional terms associated with CTB/MRP’s.

• Experience with Manual Demand Planning, Manual Production Planning, Manual MRP is the key requirement.

• Degree in Supply Chain or similar is ideal.

• Analyze manufacturing build plans against inventory/supply chain data in order to determine demand for materials replenishment.

• Retrieve quotes from suppliers & submit PO’s.

• Manage delivery schedules in order to ensure materials arrive ahead of required dates.

• Track/Mitigate Excess and Obsolescence.

 

Required:

• Strong understanding of the “Clear To Build” report AKA CTB. Some companies call it a shortage report or build status report. Note: CTB “Clear to Build” is essentially an MRP. Building stuff in batches/batch building aka Batch Production, job production, lot production, etc. are all additional terms associated with CTB/MRP’s.

• Experience with Manual Demand Planning, Manual Production Planning, Manual MRP is the key requirement.

• Advanced spreadsheet / Excel skills; Ability to generate complex dashboards, tools, and reports. Experience with excel formulas like - VLOOKUP, SUMIF, COUNTIF, IFERROR, INDEX, MATCH, MIN, etc.

• Solid experience working as a Materials PM, Buyer/Planner, Materials Planners, or similar.

• Understand how to read and understand bill of materials (BOM’s) and manage inventory accuracy.

• Strong knowledge of MRP (Materials Requirements Planning) system functionality.

job.title: Director of Analytical Sciences
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Director of Analytical Services to lead analytical development and QC capabilities supporting an oncology pipeline from early development through commercialization.

The ideal candidate will have a Ph.D. and 8–15 years of industry experience, with expertise in analytical method development, validation, troubleshooting, stability programs, CMC strategy, and GMP compliance. Experience with HPLC/UHPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, SEC, DLS, sterile injectables, lyophilized products, or novel excipients is highly valued. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring CRO/CMO oversight, regulatory filing support, team building, and the ability to work directly at the bench in a fast-moving biotech environment.

Industry: Clinical Diagnostics / Genetics / Molecular Cytogenetics
Location: Dover, DE
Type: Direct Hire

The Director of Analytical Services is a hands on CMC analytical leader responsible for running analytical development and QC capabilities to support our oncology pipeline from early development through clinical stages and eventual commercialization. This role combines strategic ownership of analytical control strategy with direct laboratory execution, vendor oversight, and cross functional leadership typical of a small, fast moving biotech environment.

The Director will establish analytical methods, systems, and workflows, ensuring phase appropriate rigor, regulatory compliance, and efficient use of internal and external resources. This position is ideal for a leader who thrives in a startup style environment, enjoys solving multidisciplinary problems, and is comfortable switching between high level CMC strategy and bench level execution.

Key Job Elements

Analytical Strategy & Execution
  • Own the analytical control strategy for drug products and novel excipients across all phases.
  • Develop, qualify, validate, and troubleshoot analytical methods (HPLC/UHPLC, LC?MS/MS, GC, SEC, DLS, solid state, microbiological, etc.).
  • Design and execute forced degradation, stability indicating method development, and characterization studies.
  • Establish practical, phase appropriate specifications and update them as programs mature.

Hands?On Laboratory Leadership
  • Work directly at the bench (10–30% depending on phase) to develop methods, generate data, and mentor scientists.
  • Oversee day to day lab operations, instrument strategy, qualification, and troubleshooting.

CRO/CMO Oversight
  • Lead method transfers, qualifications, and ongoing oversight of CROs and CMOs.
  • Ensure data integrity, technical alignment, and timely delivery of outsourced analytical work.
  • Participate in vendor audits and selection.

Regulatory & CMC Ownership
  • Serve as analytical lead for IND/IMPD filings and contribute to NDA/DMF content.
  • Draft and review analytical sections of Module 3.
  • Support responses to FDA/EMA information requests and inspection readiness.

Quality, Compliance & Data Integrity
  • Ensure adherence to GMP, ICH, and FDA expectations appropriate for clinical stage biotech.
  • Implement practical data integrity controls, documentation standards, and 21 CFR Part 11 practices.
  • Lead OOS/OOT investigations, CAPA and analytical improvements.

Stability & Specifications
  • Own stability program design, execution, and trending.
  • Manage reference standard qualification and lifecycle.
  • Establish and maintain phase appropriate specifications.

Team Building & Leadership
  • Build and mentor a small, high impact analytical team.
  • Provide hands on training, technical guidance, and career development.
  • Create a culture of scientific rigor, urgency, and accountability.

Safety & Lab Infrastructure
  • Ensure safe operation of analytical labs and compliance with chemical/biological safety requirements.
  • Support safety committee activities and continuous improvement of safety practices.
Qualifications
Knowledge/Experience
 
  • Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field with 8–15 years of industry experiences.
  • Demonstrated success in leading analytical development.
  • Expert in method development, validation, and troubleshooting across major analytical platforms.
  • Strong understanding of sterile injectable and/or nanoformulation analytical challenges a plus.
  • Experience supporting IND/DMF/NDA filings and interacting with regulatory agencies.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast changing environment.
  • Hands on leader comfortable working at the bench while driving strategy.
  • Strong documentation, communication, and crossfunctional collaboration skills.

Preferred
  • Experience with oncology injectables, lyophilized products, and novel excipients.
  • Experience building analytical labs, systems, or teams.
  • Familiarity with QbD principles and analytical lifecycle management.
  • Ability to manage multiple programs and shifting priorities typical of small biotech.

job.title: Entry Level Engineering Process Technician
job.description:
Entry Level Engineering Process Technician needed for an 18-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Santa Clara, California.


Pay Rate: $28 to $33 per hour



 Shifts Available:Mon-Thur 5am-3:30pm (10Hr Day)


The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change



What You Will Be Doing:
  • Prepare samples for experiments, including sample coating, wafer cleaving, mounting/unmounting samples, and preparing jobs for experimentation to evaluate the performance of the process system.
  • Prepare transmission electron microscope (TEM) lamella samples using focused ion beam (FIB), optimize sample preparation procedures and conditions, and identify cutting locations based on pattern instructions
  • Operate metrology tools in the FIB & TEM lab to understand cross-section or top-view critical dimensions (CD), identify patterns of interest, understand image quality requirements and sample/beam interactions to determine optimized conditions, and complete requested jobs under limited supervision after training
  • Understand the basic principles of scanning electron microscopy (SEM), focused ion beam (FIB), and transmission electron microscopy (TEM)
  • Perform SEM/FIB system and routine maintenance procedures such as flash, plasma cleaning, and image calibrations.
  • Perform routine troubleshoot procedures, identify problems, restart or standby the tool. Coordinate instrument repair and maintenance.
  • Interface with requestors, understand their detailed requirements, and communicate results. Coordinate with engineering on job request status.
  • Help monitor job queue and maintain lab throughput.
  • Document redo and lessons learned to lower redo rate.
  • Adhere to lab protocols and SOPs.
  • Operate supportive metrology equipment in a lab environment.
  • Operate supportive metrology equipment for FIB-TEM lamella samples.
  • Monitor data and track performance of metrology equipment and production activities per equipment requirements
  • Understand written instructions to perform assigned tasks.
  • Create and update procedures and documentation.
  • Perform basic operations of Microsoft Outlook and Office software.Follow safety protocols and processes.

Work shifts may include compressed work week schedules to meet production needs.



What You Need to Bring to the Table:

job.title: Architect - Data Center Migration
job.description:
Senior Infrastructure Architect

Position Summary:
Our client is seeking a highly experienced Infrastructure Architect to help lead enterprise-wide data center transformation and infrastructure modernization efforts. This individual will provide architectural oversight and technical direction for a large-scale migration involving compute, storage, networking, database, virtualization, and disaster recovery environments.
A major component of this initiative involves transitioning infrastructure from existing legacy data center locations, including Charlotte, into Equinix facilities in Ashburn. The architect will help define the future-state infrastructure design, establish migration strategies, and ensure the organization's technology environment is positioned for long-term scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency.
This is a senior-level architecture role centered on solution design, infrastructure planning, and technical coordination. The individual will assess current-state environments, evaluate architectural alternatives, identify dependencies and risks, and develop actionable migration approaches in partnership with specialized engineering teams. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise infrastructure knowledge and the ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical architectural solutions.
Primary Responsibilities
  • Define and oversee enterprise infrastructure architecture supporting large-scale data center consolidation, migration, and modernization programs.
  • Establish end-to-end transition strategies covering server and compute environments, storage, network infrastructure, databases, virtualization, and disaster recovery.
  • Create comprehensive migration blueprints that account for system dependencies, resource allocation, equipment requirements, sequencing, capacity, and execution schedules.
  • Architect the relocation of virtualized workloads and physical infrastructure from legacy facilities into Equinix data center environments.
  • Review existing infrastructure designs and configurations, assess technical constraints, and recommend appropriate migration solutions based on risk, performance, and scalability.
  • Drive the evolution of disaster recovery architecture from traditional data center-based recovery toward application-specific recovery strategies.
  • Define repeatable disaster recovery standards and architectural patterns, with an initial emphasis on active-passive configurations and opportunities for future enhancement.
  • Work alongside infrastructure engineering teams to implement consistent architecture standards, reusable technology patterns, and automation practices.
  • Lead infrastructure forecasting and capacity assessments across compute, storage, networking, and physical data center resources.
  • Evaluate physical data center requirements, including cage space, equipment density, infrastructure footprint, and projected growth.
  • Establish ongoing capacity management practices to ensure available resources support business expansion and migration timelines.
  • Assess current network designs and develop modernization recommendations involving network isolation, traffic segmentation, and inter-data-center connectivity.
  • Define target-state network architecture to replace existing legacy blue/green/yellow segmentation models.
  • Partner with network engineering teams to improve segmentation across production, development/non-production, database, and shared infrastructure environments.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline infrastructure transitions through automation, orchestration, provisioning, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Coordinate architectural efforts across server, storage, network, database, and infrastructure engineering groups to maintain alignment throughout implementation.
  • Create and maintain technical architecture diagrams, migration strategies, capacity forecasts, roadmaps, and solution recommendations.
Required Experience & Qualifications
  • 15+ years of professional experience in enterprise infrastructure engineering, infrastructure architecture, or data center architecture.
  • Extensive background designing, supporting, and modernizing complex enterprise data center environments.
  • Demonstrated success developing architecture and migration strategies for large-scale infrastructure relocation or transformation initiatives.
  • Broad technical understanding across enterprise infrastructure disciplines, including:
    • Compute, server, and hardware architecture.
    • Enterprise storage technologies and platforms.
    • Network architecture, connectivity, and segmentation.
    • Virtualization and virtual machine environments.
    • Database infrastructure and enterprise appliances.
    • Disaster recovery, resiliency, and business continuity.
  • Strong architectural expertise with VMware and enterprise virtualization technologies.
  • Experience with Cisco infrastructure, including UCS platforms, routers, and switches.
  • Knowledge of enterprise storage solutions, ideally including Pure Storage and/or Dell PowerScale/PowerMax. Specific platform experience should be confirmed.
  • Experience working with Palo Alto firewalls and enterprise network security architectures.
  • Proven ability to perform infrastructure capacity assessments, resource forecasting, and long-term planning.
  • Strong understanding of disaster recovery design, including application-level recovery approaches and active-passive configurations.
  • Ability to assess complex existing environments, identify design limitations, and develop scalable future-state architecture.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical stakeholders and coordinate across multiple engineering organizations.
Preferred Background
  • Previous experience working within Equinix data center facilities.
  • Involvement in multi-location or geographically distributed data center migration initiatives.
  • Experience relocating physical server infrastructure and enterprise database appliances.
  • Background developing infrastructure automation, orchestration, and provisioning strategies.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated infrastructure deployment.
  • Experience redesigning legacy network environments and implementing modern segmentation strategies.
  • Success establishing enterprise architecture standards and repeatable disaster recovery frameworks across engineering teams.
  • Experience in financial services or another highly regulated enterprise environment.
Technology LandscapeThe environment includes a combination of established enterprise infrastructure technologies and modern data center platforms:
  • Virtualization: VMware
  • Compute Infrastructure: Cisco UCS
  • Networking: Cisco routers and switches
  • Storage: Pure Storage, Dell PowerScale / PowerMax
  • Network Security: Palo Alto firewalls
  • Data Center Facilities: Equinix
  • Disaster Recovery: Legacy VMware Site Recovery Manager (SRM), with a strategic shift toward application-level recovery architectures
  • Core Initiatives: Data center migration, infrastructure modernization, network segmentation, capacity management, automation, and orchestration

  • Demonstrate expertise in the Java frameworks (i.e. Spring, Hibernate, JSF, PrimeFaces, JPA, etc.) and architectures and actively work to enhance them

job.title: Head of Portfolio Architecture, Corporate Functions
job.description:
Head of Portfolio Architecture, Corporate Functions
Direct Hire (Base + Bonus)
Work Location (Hybrid): 3 days/week onsite — New York, NY, Holmdel, NJ, or Bethlehem, PA
 
We’re prioritizing candidates with:
  • Insurance industry architecture leadership experience
  • Architecture & technology alignment at portfolio scale (not just solution design)
  • Strong governance mindset that enables speed, not blocks it
  • Executive presence and proven ability to influence investment/roadmaps
 
Key Responsibilities
Portfolio Architecture Leadership
  • Drive cohesive architecture across multiple value streams, ensuring end-to-end design consistency across platforms, products, and capabilities.
  • Own the Corporate Functions target-state architecture, portfolio roadmap, architecture priorities, and investment influence.
  • Advance modern platform architecture across cloud, data, integration, and AI capabilities.
  • Improve engineering productivity and delivery speed by defining architecture patterns, guardrails, and operating models that scale.
  • Partner with Solution Architects to establish scalable patterns and with enterprise architecture leadership for cross-portfolio alignment and trade-offs.
  • Serve as the primary architecture advisor to the Corporate Functions digital/technology leadership team, shaping strategy, priorities, and transformation sequencing.
  • Manage and develop a team of Solution Architects; raise architecture maturity across the portfolio.
  • Be available for high-impact production incidents affecting business operations.
 
Investment & Roadmap Influence
  • Shape and influence strategic investments across Corporate Functions (HR, Legal, Finance, Risk, Investments).
  • Guide architecture across core enterprise platforms such as Workday, Oracle, and ServiceNow, plus integration/API ecosystem enablement.
  • Balance near-term delivery commitments with long-term sustainability.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, increase reuse, and accelerate time-to-market—driving simplification across business units, not just within the portfolio.
 
End-to-End Enterprise / Insurance Architecture Ownership
  • Drive holistic architecture across:
    • Business processes and operating value streams
    • Core and surrounding application ecosystems
    • Integration and event-driven architectures
    • AI/ML use cases (e.g., underwriting/claims automation, fraud, personalization)
    • Digital experiences for customers, distribution partners (agents/brokers), and internal users
  • Ensure solutions meet regulatory, risk, security, privacy, and resiliency requirements (e.g., SOX/SOC expectations, data privacy).
  • Promote cloud-native, API-first, data-centric, and AI-enabled patterns where appropriate.
 
Governance, Risk & Compliance
  • Define/enforce architecture principles and guardrails aligned to enterprise standards and insurance regulatory expectations.
  • Lead or participate in architecture review and governance forums; ensure decisions are auditable and practical.
  • Partner with security, risk, compliance, and legal stakeholders to support operational resilience and auditability.
 
Stakeholder & Leadership Engagement
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Corporate Functions leaders and senior technology leadership.
  • Represent architecture trade-offs in enterprise forums and influence outcomes across business units.
  • Communicate architectural direction, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Mentor and develop architects across the portfolio.
 
Required Qualifications
  • 7+ years in technology/architecture roles, with significant experience in the insurance industry (or similarly regulated financial services with deep insurance exposure).
  • Proven experience as a Portfolio / Domain / Product / Enterprise Architect in a large, regulated environment.
  • Deep understanding of insurance operations and systems (policy, underwriting, claims, billing, distribution) and how they connect to enterprise platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Corporate Functions ecosystems: HR, Legal, Finance, Risk, Investments.
  • Expertise across enterprise architecture domains: business, application, data, integration, AI, and digital.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders on technology strategy and investment decisions.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, modern integration patterns, data platforms, and applied AI capabilities.
  • Solid grasp of regulatory, risk, compliance, and resiliency expectations in regulated environments.
