job.title: Lead Business System Analyst | Private Credit | Allvue Platform
job.description:
TThe Role
Serve as the primary technology partner to the Private Credit business, advancing the platforms, data, integrations and workflows supporting front-office and investment-accounting capabilities, with a primary focus on Allvue.
This is a hands-on role. You will lead discovery with business and technology stakeholders, configure investment applications, analyze data using SQL, troubleshoot complex issues and work directly with developers and vendors on solutions. You will own workstreams from concept through implementation and stabilization, mentor analysts, establish delivery standards and help shape the multi-year Private Credit technology roadmap. You will collaborate with colleagues across the US and UK.
What You Will Do
Business Partnership and Solution Design
  • Act as the primary technology partner for Private Credit stakeholders and the business product manager.
  • Lead discovery through workshops, interviews and data analysis; translate business needs into requirements, process flows, data mappings, functional designs and user stories.
  • Challenge assumptions, identify requirement and control gaps, evaluate solution options and drive clear business and technology decisions.
  • Design end-to-end Private Credit workflows spanning deal and facility setup, trade execution, funding, interest and fee accruals, rate resets, paydowns, amendments, valuations, restructurings and reporting.
  • Translate Private Credit operating requirements into scalable platform configurations, integrations and data solutions.
Systems, Data and Delivery
  • Configure Allvue workflows, reference data, business rules and application behavior.
  • Use advanced SQL for data profiling, reconciliation, impact analysis, data lineage and root-cause investigation.
  • Trace data across front-office platforms, Security Master, IBOR, investment accounting and enterprise data platforms to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Understand and map relationships among sponsors, borrowers/issuers, deals, facilities/assets, trades, portfolios, positions/holdings and accounting records.
  • Validate REST APIs, JSON payloads, batch/file interfaces and data pipelines; define reconciliations, exception handling and data-quality controls.
  • Partner with engineering teams on integration design, implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Lead system, integration and user-acceptance testing with particular focus on business outcomes, accounting impact, financial calculations and data integrity.
  • Support implementation through production stabilization and ensure sustainable operational handoff.
That entity-level modeling matters in your environment. In Loan Tape process, CFO was discussed in terms of company roles such as sponsor, borrower and issuer, followed by asset creation, funding/trade activity and downstream investment-accounting integration.
Credit Data, Loan Tapes and Reporting
I would give this its own section because it is a meaningful capability rather than burying it under qualifications.
  • Design, configure and maintain Private Credit loan tapes, portfolio extracts and credit reporting datasets for operational, investor, lender and other downstream requirements.
  • Define source-to-target mappings and calculations covering borrower/issuer, facility type, commitment, funded and unfunded amounts, outstanding principal, benchmark/reference rate, spread, floor, maturity, PIK/cash-pay terms, seniority, lien, financial metrics and portfolio/holding information.
  • Build configurable templates capable of supporting different reporting requirements while maintaining consistent definitions, lineage and controls.
  • Reconcile loan-tape outputs to Allvue, investment accounting and other systems of record; investigate and resolve breaks.
  • Understand how term sheets and executed credit documentation translate into structured system attributes, transaction terms and downstream reporting.
  • Develop and maintain tear sheets or credit snapshots used for portfolio monitoring and investment review.
This separation is worthwhile because your Private_Credit_Interview_Scorecard already distinguishes a loan tape from a tear sheet: the loan tape is a structured schedule of facilities and loan attributes, while the tear sheet is a concise borrower/deal snapshot used by portfolio managers and analysts. 
Platform, Vendor and Team Leadership
  • Partner with Allvue engineering, product and support teams to troubleshoot defects and influence product enhancements.
  • Evaluate trade-offs among native configuration, custom development, integration, data solutions including Snowflake, and business-process change.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level analysts and establish standards for requirements, solution design, testing, documentation and production readiness.
  • Contribute to the Private Credit technology roadmap with an emphasis on platform simplification, automation, reduced manual processing and stronger data quality and controls.
What You Bring
Private Credit Domain
  • Strong understanding of the Private Credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting, closing and funding, servicing, portfolio monitoring, valuation, amendments, restructurings and exits.
  • Knowledge of instruments including unitranche, first- and second-lien direct lending, syndicated loans, term loans, delayed-draw term loans, revolving facilities, mezzanine and PIK/PIK-toggle debt.
  • Strong understanding of loan economics, including floating-rate structures, benchmarks/reference rates, spreads, floors, rate resets, OID, upfront and commitment fees, amendment fees, accruals, paydowns and funded/unfunded commitments.
  • Understanding of facility type, lien position and seniority, and how these characteristics affect transaction processing, accounting and reporting.
  • Understanding of how Security Master, IBOR and investment accounting support transaction processing, positions, controls and downstream data consumption.
  • Experience translating credit agreements, term sheets and other deal documentation into structured application and reporting requirements.
Analysis and Technical
  • Proven experience leading complex requirements analysis and solution design across business, product, data and engineering stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex querying, reconciliation, profiling and root-cause analysis.
  • Hands-on experience configuring investment platforms; Allvue Credit Front Office and/or Investment Accounting strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, file-based interfaces, data mappings and integration troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing data-quality controls, reconciliations and exception-management processes.
  • Agile/Scrum delivery experience, including system testing, UAT, implementation and post-production validation.
 
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of experience in business systems analysis, product technology, solution delivery or a similar role within financial services, with meaningful hands-on SQL and application configuration experience.
  • 3+ years working with private markets, leveraged finance or alternative investments, preferably Private Credit/direct lending.
Nice to Have
  • Hands-on experience with Allvue Credit Front Office and Allvue Investment Accounting.
  • Experience with Private Equity, fund-of-funds or broader alternative-investment platforms.
  • Experience with Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms and enterprise reporting/data-consumption patterns.
  • Experience with Security Master and IBOR implementations.
  • Experience integrating front-office investment platforms with accounting, enterprise data and downstream reporting systems.

job.title: IT - Desktop Support-Level II
job.description:
Desktop Support Analyst
12 month contract/contract to hire
Fort Mill, SC (Onsite)
 
Looking for someone with good attitude, self-driven, can come and work independently and hit the ground running. Culture, team fit and attitude is the biggest thing for this group!
 
Job Description:
We are seeking a qualified professional Analyst II, Home Office Tech to provide IT Support to our internal employees, resolving or escalating issues in a timely and professional manner over multiple channels of communication. Secondarily, this role will support and participate in internal IT activities such as helping rollout and drive user adoption to new technologies, ensuring new hires success with IT needs when they start, and assist in building a robust knowledge base that we be leveraged as we introduce automation and AI.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Provides Tier 2 support for end-user computing devices for employees and Contingent workers in multiple offices and functions as an escalation point for Tier 1 support.
  • Responds to incidents and requests within a ticketing system, providing resolution within a complex fast-paced business environment.
  • Deploys and troubleshoots end-user computing devices including laptops, desktops, printers, MFPs, and wireless devices that are aligned with the Home Office Security Policy.
  • Reimage computers/hard drives in accordance with standards using MS Intune Autopilot. Perform Move, Add, and Change functions including installation and decommission.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows-based operating systems, Microsoft Office and Internet browsers.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot MAC/Apple-based operating systems and proprietary applications.
  • Configures and supports remote users including VPN client and connectivity.
  • Provides customer training and knowledge documentation.
  • Complies with and supports ITIL change-incident-problem management processes and work instructions.
  • Troubleshoots incidents and fulfills requests within established SLAs.
  • Adheres to Desktop and End User Computing processes, procedures, policies, and job aids.
  • Provides a high touch, business-aware, personalized, world-class customer service that extends to executive and senior-level support.

job.description:
Client Service Associate
12+ month contract
Council Bluffs, IA (Onsite)


Job Overview:
The Client Service Associate plays a crucial role in supporting financial advisors and ensuring an exceptional client experience. This position is responsible for administrative tasks, client relationship management, and operational support within the branch office. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail oriented, and able to handle multiple responsibilities while maintaining a professional and client focused approach.

Responsibilities:
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing exceptional service and support through phone, email, and in-person interactions while addressing account inquiries and service requests.
Coordinate advisor calendars, schedule client meetings, prepare meeting materials, and manage follow-up communications to ensure a seamless client experience.

Maintain accurate client records within the CRM system and support compliance efforts by adhering to firm, FINRA, and SEC regulations while safeguarding confidential client information.
Collaborate with custodians, fund companies, and financial institutions to process transactions, resolve account issues, and monitor account accuracy.
Support overall office operations and client engagement initiatives through document preparation, mail management, event coordination, educational seminars, newsletters, social media updates, and administrative support.

We are looking for individuals with client service/administrative experience, preferably in financial services, who are comfortable supporting advisors, handling client requests, account maintenance, scheduling, and CRM documentation.

Requirements:
In-Office role M-F
Strong organizational skills with a keen attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
Ability to learn and use CRM systems.
Strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work both independently and with a team.
High level of professionalism, discretion, and ethical conduct.
Associate or bachelors degree, preferably in business, accounting or finance.

job.title: Materials Coordinator / Order & Emerging Markets Specialist Services – San Francisco
job.description:
Materials Coordinator / Order & Emerging Markets Specialist Services – San Francisco
Full-Time Weekday Morning Shift
Days/Shift Hours:
Monday–Friday, 8-hour shifts
8:00 AM–5:00 PM

The Materials Coordinator will support warehouse, inventory, order fulfillment, and materials operations in a fast-paced automotive environment. The role will also provide order specialist and emerging markets specialist services, including coordinating material requests, supporting new or evolving customer and market requirements, validating part information, and ensuring orders are accurately prepared and delivered.

Scope:
• Receive, unpack, inspect, and verify merchandise and products for accuracy.
• Process receiving exceptions and resolve discrepancies as needed.
• Use handheld RF tools to receive products into the warehouse management system.
• Perform stock checks, part-number verification, cycle counts, and physical inventory support.
• Coordinate material and parts requests associated with customer orders, service activities, production, and emerging market requirements.
• Review order details, confirm product availability, and help ensure orders are complete and accurate.
• Support the setup and fulfillment of new, nonstandard, or evolving order requirements.
• Communicate with internal teams to clarify material needs, priorities, delivery requirements, and documentation.
• Consolidate loads as required, including packing, repacking, wrapping, and preparing products for shipment.
• Label parts during put-away, picking, and shipping activities.
• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, work orders, and other material needs.
• Ensure orders and shipping materials include the appropriate documentation, including revised bills of lading, manual tags, packing slips, and delivery records.
• Fill requisitions, work orders, and material requests, and distribute materials, tools, or stock items to production workers or assembly-line personnel.
• Maintain accurate inventory records and support order tracking, reporting, and KPI documentation.
• Assist with materials research, part substitutions, availability checks, and basic market or product-line support for emerging requirements.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, quality standards, and safety guidelines.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
• Cross-train across warehouse and materials functions to support operational flexibility.
• Perform additional organization and support tasks during slower periods, including shop organization, tire stacking and disposal, delivery pickup, and related duties.

Required:
• Experience in the automotive industry, such as automotive parts, dealership wholesale parts, service or body shop operations, military maintenance, or large automotive manufacturing.
• Experience in roles such as Parts Advisor, Parts Specialist, Inventory Technician, Materials Handler, Materials Coordinator, Order Specialist, or similar.
• Experience using a DMS, ERP, or warehouse inventory system, such as CDK, Reynolds and Reynolds, Oracle JDE, Lightspeed, or similar. SAP experience is preferred but not required.
• Experience working with automotive technicians, production personnel, service teams, or other hands-on operational groups.
• Basic supply chain, inventory, shipping, receiving, and materials-handling knowledge.
• Ability to verify part numbers, interpret order information, and identify discrepancies.
• Experience creating and maintaining spreadsheets, tables, reports, and inventory records.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
• Ability to use pallet jacks safely; forklift experience is not required.
• Ability to work effectively as part of a team and adapt to changing priorities.
• Willingness to support additional operational tasks during periods of lower activity.

Estimated Max Rate: $25.00/hr+. Depends on work experience

We are seeking a Software Engineer III to develop Python backend services, manage GCP workloads, and support cloud-based data and deployment systems. The ideal candidate can independently execute tasks and deliver reliable production-ready solutions.

Pluses:
• Experience with Piper, Google3, Blaze, or Bazel.

job.title: Microarray Print Process Engineer II
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Microarray Print  Process Engineer in Longmont, CO for a leading diagnostic company. The Process Engineer will support transfer and development of new products and processes.  You will support manufacturing, while maintaining and improving upon existing equipment as well as ensuring product quality and yield. 

Position:  Microarray Print Process Engineer II
Pay: $84,000-105,000 DOE 
Location: Longmont, CO 
Duration: FTE


Responsibilities

  • Lead efforts to provide sustaining support to operations utilizing continuous improvement principles and technical support to operations utilizing root cause analysis to implement corrective actions.

  • Enables company growth by ensuring on-time equipment milestone deliveries.

  • Recommends and implements equipment and process modifications to improve production efficiencies, manufacturing techniques and production yields for existing products.

  • Assists in developing high level capital equipment integration protocols and procedures for manufacturing. 

  • Develops and conducts statistical analysis such as Design of Experiments (DOE) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) targeting physical cause of failure for yield loss and improving quality. Active database and data management allowing for process performance assessment via GR&R, Yield Tracking and Cpk analysis.

  • Accurately documents all work products to ensure equipment qualifications and in line with and follow IQ, OQ, PQ requirements.

  • Interacts with design staff to ensure that processes and designs are compatible with existing equipment.

  • Translate design requirements into production by defining, designing and/or communicating efficient and capable process tooling.

  • Utilizing GDP, author documents including but not limited to manufacturing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and detailed work instructions.

  • Trains manufacturing staff on proper processes to follow when operating equipment, including wave-guide instrument(s).

  • Ensures that team and staff members follow safety rules and protocol.

 

Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field required; master’s degree preferred.

  • Must have experience with Biodot equipment and microarray printing
  • Five to seven (5-7) years prior experience in an R&D or production environment with proven success of process improvement and scale-up projects.
  • Experience in a regulated environment (FDA, ISO, etc.), preferred.

  • Experience in project management preferred.

  • Experience in the medical device field, specifically invitro diagnostics, preferred.

  • Licenses or certifications such as ISO, PMP, LEAN, IFMA, MPS, Six Sigma, cGMP, preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical staff to ensure understanding.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate in problem solving.

  • Excellent data gathering and analysis skills.

  • Excellent electro-mechanical equipment development and troubleshooting skills.

  • Knowledge of QMS, including experience with deviation, CAPA, and other quality related objectives and requirements.

  • Software use and knowledge: Windows, MS Office products, SolidWorks (or similar).

job.title: Senior Separation Scientist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Sr. Separations Scientist in Bristol, PA.  The individual will serve as a technical expert in separations-based characterization and method development across process development and CMC activities. The Sr. Separations Scientist will develop and implement advanced chromatographic workflows for structural characterization, impurity analysis, linker-payload assessment, DAR determination, and comparability studies to support clinical development programs.

Position:  Sr. Separations Scientist
Duration: Contract to Perm
Pay: $40-$50/hr DOE
Shift: M-F 8-5pm


Key Responsibilities

• Lead development, optimization, and transfer of chromatographic analytical methods supporting ADCs and related bioconjugate therapeutics.

• Design and execute chromatographic studies for characterization of intact proteins/antibodies, fragment antibodies, small format proteins, peptides, linker-payloads, oligonucleotides, and conjugated species.

• Perform characterization activities including DAR analysis, aggregation, fragmentation and charge variant assessment, free payload and linker impurity analysis, and stability studies.

• Support analytical investigations related to process development, manufacturing deviations, comparability, and product quality assessments.

• Collaborate closely with process development, bioassay, formulation, and quality teams to establish analytical control strategies and critical quality attributes (CQAs).

• Develop robust sample preparation workflows for proteins, peptides, oligonucleotides, and conjugated modalities for chromatographic analyses.

• Interpret complex analytical datasets and communicate findings to cross-functional project teams and client sponsors.

Required Qualifications

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline with 0 years of industry experience; M.S. with 2+ years or B.S. with 4+ years of relevant experience.

• Extensive hands-on experience with LCUV characterization of biologics, ADCs, or related conjugated therapeutics.

• Experience with analytical characterization techniques including RPLC/UV, SEC-UV, IEX-UV, non-reduced/reduced cIEF.

• Strong understanding of protein chemistry, conjugation technologies, and biopharmaceutical analytical development.

• Experience with data analysis software such as Waters Empower or equivalent platforms.

job.title: Philanthropy, Social Impact & Environment Coordinator - Internship Opportunity!
job.description:
Philanthropy Social Impact & Environment Coordinator - Internship Opportunity!

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorhsip. No C2C!!!


Location: Los Angeles, CA

Industry: Music & Entertainment

Employment Type: Temporary, Part-Time, Internship

Schedule: Approximately 30 hours per week, M-Th

Assignment Duration: January 19, 2027 – Mid April 2027

Pay Rate: $18.42/hourly



About the Opportunity


Client is seeking a passionate, creative, and detail-oriented Philanthropy & Social Impact Intern to support meaningful initiatives that drive positive change.

This is an exciting opportunity for a college student interested in philanthropy, nonprofit partnerships, social responsibility, and community engagement to gain hands-on experience within the music and entertainment industry.

Working alongside the Philanthropy & Social Impact team, this individual will help research and develop charitable initiatives, support impactful campaigns, collaborate with nonprofit partners, and contribute to projects that align with Sony Music Group's commitment to corporate giving and social impact.


About the Department


The department is dedicated to advancing humanitarian efforts, building meaningful partnerships, and expanding philanthropic programs across the company's global footprint. The team also works closely with artists, songwriters, and business partners to support charitable initiatives, raise awareness, and inspire positive change.


Key Responsibilities


Research & Social Impact Initiatives
  • Research emerging social impact opportunities, nonprofit organizations, and potential community partners.
  • Monitor news, social media, and current events related to philanthropy, social justice, civic engagement, and humanitarian issues.
  • Develop profiles and research summaries on prospective nonprofit partners.
  • Assist with evaluating charitable initiatives and identifying opportunities for meaningful engagement.
  • Support data collection, analysis, and reporting to help measure program effectiveness and impact

Communications & Content Development
  • Assist in creating engaging written content, social media posts, and campaign materials.
  • Develop stories highlighting nonprofit partners, grant recipients, and the impact of philanthropic initiatives.
  • Support content development for Heritage Month celebrations, employee engagement initiatives, and other social impact campaigns.
  • Prepare presentations, reports, and supporting materials for internal and external audiences.
Campaigns, Partnerships & Events
  • Collaborate with the team on the planning and execution of philanthropic campaigns and initiatives.
  • Participate in meetings with nonprofit organizations and external partners.
  • Attend cross-functional meetings and contribute ideas to support department projects.
  • Assist with virtual and in-person event planning, coordination, and logistics.
  • Help maintain relationships and coordinate communications with internal and external stakeholders

Administrative & Project Support
  • Maintain organized databases, project trackers, and departmental records.
  • Draft professional emails and assist with ongoing project communications.
  • Help coordinate multiple projects, deadlines, and department priorities.
  • Provide additional administrative and project support as needed

Qualifications
  • Currently enrolled in a college or university program.
  • Strong interest in philanthropy, social impact, nonprofit organizations, or corporate social responsibility.
  • Excellent research, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Interest in international development, community engagement, humanitarian initiatives, or related social issues.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Experience with or exposure to grant management systems.
  • Previous involvement in volunteer programs, nonprofit organizations, campus initiatives, or community service projects.
  • Interest in the music and entertainment industry.

Why This Opportunity?This internship offers the chance to gain valuable, real-world experience at the intersection of music, philanthropy, and social impact. The selected candidate will contribute to meaningful initiatives, collaborate with experienced professionals, and gain exposure to how a global entertainment organization supports charitable causes and community engagement.

Estimated Max Rate: $18.42

job.title: Zscaler Analyst
job.description:
Position OverviewWe are seeking a hands-on Zscaler Operations Analyst / Engineer to support the rollout, administration, and ongoing operations of an enterprise Zscaler environment.

This individual will take ownership of the operational side of the Zscaler suite, including implementation support, day-to-day administration, troubleshooting, and break/fix activities. A key focus will be supporting the rollout of Zscaler for branch application connectivity, including App Connectors and Branch Connectors.
The ideal candidate will come from a strong network engineering or network operations background and have hands-on experience supporting Zscaler in a production environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own day-to-day operational support of the Zscaler platform.
  • Support the rollout of Zscaler across branch locations and branch application connectivity.
  • Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Zscaler App Connectors and Branch Connectors.
  • Provide hands-on break/fix support for Zscaler-related connectivity and operational issues.
  • Troubleshoot application access, connectivity, routing, DNS, and network-related issues involving Zscaler.
  • Support configuration changes, platform updates, testing, and ongoing optimization of the Zscaler environment.
  • Monitor the environment and investigate issues impacting users, branch locations, applications, or network connectivity.
  • Work closely with network, infrastructure, security, and application teams to troubleshoot cross-functional issues.
  • Help establish an internal Zscaler operational knowledge base, including configurations, troubleshooting procedures, known issues, and resolutions.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation and runbooks.
  • Serve as a subject-matter resource for ongoing Zscaler operational support.
  • Coordinate with Zscaler support and other vendors as needed to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Support the organization's broader network environment, which currently utilizes HPE/HP networking technology and is expected to transition toward Cisco Meraki.
Required Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience supporting Zscaler in a production enterprise environment.
  • Strong experience with Zscaler App Connector deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Zscaler Branch Connector or comparable branch connectivity implementations.
  • Strong network engineering or network operations background.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex network and application connectivity issues.
  • Solid understanding of:
    • TCP/IP
    • DNS
    • Routing
    • Network security
    • Firewalls
    • Application connectivity
    • SSL/TLS
    • Zero Trust networking concepts
  • Experience providing operational support and resolving production incidents.
  • Ability to independently investigate issues and drive problems through resolution.
  • Strong documentation skills with the ability to build technical procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multiple components of the Zscaler product suite.
  • Experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) and/or Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA).
  • Hands-on experience with HPE/HP networking technologies.
  • Cisco Meraki experience, especially supporting enterprise or branch networking environments.
  • Experience working within a Zero Trust or SASE architecture.
  • Experience supporting large, distributed environments with multiple branch locations.
  • Previous experience helping an organization establish operational processes around a newly implemented network/security platform.

job.title: Mass Spectrometry Scientist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Mass Spectrometry Scientist in Bristol, PA.   This individual will serve as a technical expert in mass spectrometry-based characterization and method development across process development and CMC activities.  The experienced LC-MS scientist will develop LC-MS methods for conjugate characterization activities supporting process development of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), oligonucleotide conjugates, radioconjugates, and other complex bioconjugate modalities.

Position: Mass Spec Scientist 
Duration: contract to perm 
Pay: $40-$45/DOE
Shift:  M-F 8-5pm 

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead development, optimization, and transfer of LC-MS analytical methods supporting ADCs and related bioconjugate therapeutics.
  • Design and execute mass spectrometry studies for characterization of intact proteins/antibodies, fragment antibodies, small format proteins, peptides, linker-payloads, oligonucleotides, and conjugated species.
  • Perform characterization activities including DAR analysis, peptide mapping, PTM identification, conjugation site analysis, aggregation and fragmentation assessment, disulfide scrambling, free payload and linker impurity analysis, and stability studies.
  • Support analytical investigations related to process development, manufacturing deviations, comparability, and product quality assessments.
  • Develop robust sample preparation workflows for proteins, peptides, oligonucleotides, and conjugated modalities for LC-MS analyses.
  • Interpret complex analytical datasets and communicate findings to cross-functional project teams and client sponsors.
  • Support regulatory submissions including IND, BLA, and IMPD analytical sections.

Required Qualifications
  • Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline with 0 years of industry experience; or M.S. with 2+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience with analytical characterization techniques including intact/reduced, subunit mass analysis, and peptide mapping.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with LC-MS characterization of biologics, ADCs, or related conjugated therapeutics.
  • Hands-on experience with high-resolution mass spectrometry techniques and interpretation of complex datasets.
  • Strong understanding of protein chemistry, conjugation technologies, and biopharmaceutical analytical development.
  • Experience with data analysis software such as Waters Connect, MassLynx, or equivalent platforms

job.title: Utilization Management Nurse Coordinator
job.description:
Utilization Management Nurse Coordinator (RN or LVN) needed for a temp 6+ month, remote contract opportunity with Yoh’s managed care health plan client based out of Redding or Fairfield, CA. Anticipating to be temporary for at least 6 months with potential for temp-to-hire. Multiple openings available!

Training will be onsite (in either Fairfield or Redding) for the first 3 weeks and then will transition to fully remote. 
--> Monday-Friday 8am to 5pm with one weekend per month.

Utilize your clinical expertise to support quality, cost-effective healthcare in a fully remote managed care setting. The UM RN Nurse Coordinator reviews outpatient authorization requests, assesses medical necessity, collaborates with interdisciplinary teams, and helps ensure members receive the right care at the right time while maintaining compliance with regulatory and health plan guidelines.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse or Licensed Vocational Nurse license in California
  • Experience in Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, Case Management, or Managed Care
  • Familiarity with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plan guidelines
  • High degree of independence, flexibility, initiative, and commitment
  • Solid critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, member-service oriented environment

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Review outpatient authorization requests using InterQual and established clinical guidelines
  • Evaluate medical necessity, appropriateness of treatment, and benefit coverage requirements
  • Analyze clinical documentation submitted by providers and facilities
  • Approve services within designated RN authority levels and refer complex cases to Medical Directors as needed
  • Communicate with providers to obtain additional clinical information required for determinations
  • Ensure compliance with CMS, NCQA, DHCS, state, federal, and health plan regulations
  • Accurately document review findings in the utilization management system
  • Meet turnaround time requirements for authorization decisions
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and audit activities
  • Collaborate with Case Management, Care Coordination, Disease Management, and Provider Relations teams

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

  • Must be able to work Monday - Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm with one weekend per month
  • At least 3-5 years of clinical nursing experience
  • Experience reviewing outpatient authorizations and medical necessity determinations.
  • Strong understanding of CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial health plan regulations.

What’s In It For You?

  • Great work-life balance with this being 100% remote and primarily Mon-Fri
  • Work at a company that focuses on mission-driven work with real community impact
  • Foot in the door at a company with strong name recognition in Bay Area healthcare
  • Competitive compensation with weekly direct deposit every Friday

KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Health Care specializes in occupational/employee health and case management services. We partner with well-known companies, hospitals, and managed care companies nationwide to place top healthcare professionals. To explore our current openings, visit www.yoh.com!

job.title: Finance & Operations Coordinator- Part Time- Media Industry
job.description:
Yoh has an immediate, 6 month contract opportunity, as a Finance & Operations Coordinator, Part-Time at our client, SONY Music Entertainment, to report from their office in New York, New York
  • $33-36/hr. max hourly rate
  • 20-29 hours a week, Monday-Thursday, Friday remote
  • You must have hands-on experience managing purchase orders, invoice processing, and vendor payments in a finance or accounting environment.
***Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Due to the client-site nature of this role, we are unable to support OPT or STEM OPT employment, including completion of Form I-983***

What You Will Be Doing
  • Manage purchase orders from creation through approval, processing, and closure.
  • Coordinate vendor onboarding, updates, and payment processing with Accounts Payable.
  • Review and process invoices, ensuring accurate coding and supporting documentation.
  • Track budgets and financial transactions to maintain accurate project and departmental spending.
  • Prepare recurring financial reports and assist with month-end close activities.
  • Research and resolve invoice, payment, and financial system discrepancies while maintaining accurate records.
Who You Are
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered
  • 1-3 years of experience in finance operations, accounts payable, procurement, accounting support, or a related function.
  • You must have hands-on experience processing purchase orders, invoices, and vendor payments in a finance, accounting, or procurement environment.
  • Experience managing purchase orders, invoice processing, vendor payments, and financial transactions.
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, expense tracking, general ledger coding, and financial documentation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to quickly learn new financial and reporting systems.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
*** Experience within the Entertainment, Music and Media Industries highly preferred***

job.title: Sr Data Engineer (AWS/Python/Scala)
job.description:
Title: Senior Data Engineer
Location: McLean, VA; NYC; Wilmington; Boston; Plano; Chicago; or Richmond
Work Arrangement: Hybrid - 3 days/week onsite 
Contract: 6+ month 

We are seeking a Senior Big Data/Machine Learning Engineer to support the design, development, and implementation of scalable data engineering and machine learning solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Python, Scala, AWS data services, distributed processing, streaming technologies, SQL, and REST APIs.

Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, test, and support scalable data engineering solutions.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services, including EMR and Glue.
  • Develop distributed data processing applications using Python and Scala.
  • Implement real-time and event-driven data solutions using Kafka and streaming technologies.
  • Create and integrate REST APIs to support data and application workflows.
  • Write complex SQL queries for data transformation, analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, architects, and business stakeholders.
  • Ensure solutions meet standards for performance, reliability, scalability, security, and data quality.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and support ongoing enhancements to data platforms.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, code reviews, testing, and Agile delivery practices.
  • Apply machine learning or artificial intelligence capabilities where appropriate.
Required Qualifications
  • Senior-level experience in data engineering, big data, or machine learning engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and/or Scala.
  • Experience developing solutions in AWS environments.
  • Practical experience with AWS EMR and AWS Glue.
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Experience with Kafka and streaming data architectures.
  • Strong SQL development and data manipulation skills.
  • Experience working with distributed data processing and large-scale data platforms.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence or machine learning techniques.
  • Experience with Spark, PySpark, or similar big data frameworks.
  • Familiarity with AWS data, storage, and security services.
  • Experience supporting production data pipelines and enterprise applications.
  • Prior experience in financial services or other highly regulated environments.

job.title: Structural Engineer
job.description:
Staff Structural Engineer  

Join our dynamic team as a Staff Structural Engineer and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of transmission tower infrastructure! In this engaging position, you will lead multiple phases of structural design, analysis, and project documentation for a diverse portfolio of transmission tower projects. Your expertise will directly influence innovative solutions in the energy sector, working on everything from conceptual design to detailed construction drawings. If you’re passionate about structural engineering and eager to work on impactful infrastructure projects, this opportunity offers a perfect blend of challenge and growth.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Structural Engineering or related from an ABET-accredited program, with 3+ years of experience; or successful FE exam completion with 3+ years’ experience; or Master’s Degree with 2+ years’ experience
  • Proficiency in structural analysis and modeling software such as RISA-3D, ETABS, SAFE, and BIM tools like Revit and Tekla
  • Strong knowledge of design codes, specifications, and engineering techniques
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and organizational abilities
  • Ability to work methodically, analyze complex data, and collaborate effectively with teams
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Engineers in Training (EIT) certification
  • Experience with PLS-Tower modeling, FEM structure modeling, and reinforcement design
  • Knowledge of retrofit or new construction projects for transmission towers
  • Familiarity with project management and proposal development processes
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or related field from an ABET-accredited institution
  • 2-3 years of relevant structural engineering experience, particularly in transmission towers or similar structures
  • Existing EIT certification is advantageous
Other Requirements:

  • Willingness to travel up to 10% for project site visits and meetings
  • Ability to obtain and maintain necessary certifications and work authorization
Ready to make an impact in a challenging and rewarding environment? Apply now to become a key contributor to innovative infrastructure projects that power our communities!

job.title: Certified Athletic Trainer
job.description:
Certified Athletic Trainer needed for a full-time, direct-hire opportunity with Yoh's occupational health clinic client located in Blue Springs, MS. Start as soon as possible. New graduates are encouraged to apply!

This position is located at a manufacturing company with an onsite clinic that provides occupational, primary, and preventive care services for employees. The Athletic Trainer will support approximately 10-15 patients through routine wellness and injury-prevention touchpoints. You will work alongside the clinical team to provide injury prevention, first aid, general wellness services, and health promotion. This role also includes non-appointment-based activities on the production floor, evaluating the physical demands of job tasks, and leading group fitness, stretching, and educational classes.

Schedule:
Monday-Friday, 2:30 PM-11:00 PM
(Second opening available: Monday-Friday 6:00AM-2:30PM)

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Certified Athletic Trainer (ATC) - BOC Certified
  • Current Mississippi Athletic Trainer License
  • Experience in occupational health and safety; knowledge of current OSHA regulations preferred
  • Experience with ergonomics preferred
What You'll Be Doing:
  • Develop and implement an early intervention program by performing comprehensive musculoskeletal examinations, providing first aid in accordance with OSHA standards, and educating employees on injury prevention
  • Perform physical demand and ergonomic assessments to identify high-risk tasks and recommend preventive strategies
  • Lead group and individual training sessions focused on functional movement, job simulation, and injury prevention programs
  • Collaborate with onsite medical and safety teams to coordinate care and recommend workplace countermeasures
  • Document assessments, recommendations, and outcomes in a timely and accurate manner
  • Maintain patient health records to ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation
  • Participate in meetings and task forces
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited Athletic Training Education Program
  • Active BLS/CPR certification (hands-on courses only)
  • Current annual TB screening (PPD or QuantiFERON Gold test)
  • Passion for promoting health and well-being in the workplace
  • Positive attitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work effectively as part of a team
What's In It for You?:
  • Excellent work-life balance with predictable hours and no weekends or holidays
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment where you can make a real difference in keeping workers safe, healthy, and productive
  • Opportunity to be part of a mission-driven company that prioritizes collaboration
Know a Great Healthcare Professional Looking for Work?
Refer them today! We work with companies nationwide.
Yoh Healthcare specializes in occupational and employee health and case management services. We partner with well-known companies, hospitals, and managed care organizations nationwide to place top healthcare professionals. To explore our current openings, visit Yoh Jobs.

job.description:
Business Analyst I/II ( Planning Analyst)

Duration: 12 months contract W2- Potential extension
Pay Rate: $41.08-$52.82 
Location: Remote

** Client is not able to do any sponsorship of visa or C2C** 

Essential Position Responsibilities 
  • Purchase Requisition Management: Prepare, submit, and track purchase requisitions for contractor resources supporting the team’s analytical activities, ensuring requests are accurate, timely, and aligned with anticipated resource needs and established procurement processes.

Ensure updates are completed in a timely manner and properly communicated to appropriate stakeholders.

  • 3+ years of experience performing a similar role 
  • Ability to produce high-quality work products with attention to detail 
  • Ability to communicate effectively in a team environment 
  • Maintains an exceptional level of customer focus, ability to multi-task, organize and prioritize tasks. 
  • Experience in quantitative and qualitative analysis  
  • Experience using verbal and written communications skills 
  • Ability to use Microsoft Office Suite (MS-Word, MS-Excel and MS-PowerPoint) 
  • Preferred:  
    • Experience with Utility/Energy operations, markets, and planning functions   
    • Experience supporting any of PJM Committees  
    • Experience with SAP

job.title: Machine Operator
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for Machine Operators for a rubber compounding facility in Elkton, MD.  You will support the batch process for rubber compounding involving weighing, mixing, and forming.  Physicals and drug screens are required in order to be eligible. 

Shift:  Rotating 12hr shifts, 6am - 6pm or 6pm -6am following a 2/3/2 rotation
Location: Elkton, MD

Responsibilities:
  • Process includes handling chemicals, polymers, and finished products like sheets and pellets. 
  • Rubber and Chemicals are staged in weigh up areas using a fork truck and a hand dolly respectively.
  • Rubber and Chemicals are weighed per work to make batches.
  • Rubber is weighed in pounds.
  • Chemicals are weighed in grams. Air Hoods are required for weighing some chemicals.
  • Operating mixers
  • Batches are discharged from the mixer and transported by sled to be formed in to Sheets or Pellets.
  • Sheets are cooled through a Ross Cooler, manually wrapped, weighed, placed on a conveyor and aut01naticaIly boxed.
  • They are manually taped and then are palletized using a box lifter.
  • Pellets are piped through the floor, cooled, screened, blended, and packed in 1 1 lb. bags or 27 lb. bags via a packing station. This is a manned station.
Requirements:
  • Must be able to sit, stand, walk, crouch, lift, and climb. 
  • Must be able to pass a drug screening and physical 
  • Position will require you to wear a supplied air hood, pulmonary physical test will be performed. 
#IND-SPG

The ideal candidate will have hands-on manufacturing or quality experience, strong attention to detail, and familiarity with operating inspection equipment and maintaining accurate production documentation.

Please see full details below. Only qualified applicants need apply.

Location: Pleasanton, CA

  • Generate inspection reports and maintain production documentation in accordance with GMP/GDP practices.

  • Transport materials between staging areas and manufacturing operations.

  • Follow established work instructions, quality control procedures, and safety protocols.

job.title: UM Nurse Coordinator (RN or LVN)
job.description:
Utilization Management Nurse Coordinator (RN or LVN) needed for a temp 6+ month, remote contract opportunity with Yoh’s managed care health plan client based out of Fairfield & Redding, CA. Anticipating to be temporary for at least 6 months with potential for temp-to-hire. Multiple openings available!

Training will be onsite (in either Fairfield or Redding) for the first 3 weeks and then will transition to fully remote. 
--> Monday-Friday 8am to 5pm with one weekend per month.

Utilize your clinical expertise to support quality, cost-effective healthcare in a fully remote managed care setting. The UM RN Nurse Coordinator reviews outpatient authorization requests, assesses medical necessity, collaborates with interdisciplinary teams, and helps ensure members receive the right care at the right time while maintaining compliance with regulatory and health plan guidelines.


Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse or Licensed Vocational Nurse license in California
  • Experience in Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, Case Management, or Managed Care
  • Familiarity with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plan guidelines
  • High degree of independence, flexibility, initiative, and commitment
  • Solid critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, member-service oriented environment

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Review outpatient authorization requests using InterQual and established clinical guidelines
  • Evaluate medical necessity, appropriateness of treatment, and benefit coverage requirements
  • Analyze clinical documentation submitted by providers and facilities
  • Approve services within designated RN authority levels and refer complex cases to Medical Directors as needed
  • Communicate with providers to obtain additional clinical information required for determinations
  • Ensure compliance with CMS, NCQA, DHCS, state, federal, and health plan regulations
  • Accurately document review findings in the utilization management system
  • Meet turnaround time requirements for authorization decisions
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and audit activities
  • Collaborate with Case Management, Care Coordination, Disease Management, and Provider Relations teams

What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Must be able to work Monday - Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm with one weekend per month
  • At least 3-5 years of clinical nursing experience
  • Experience reviewing outpatient authorizations and medical necessity determinations.
  • Strong understanding of CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial health plan regulations.

What’s In It For You?
  • Great work-life balance with this being 100% remote and primarily Mon-Fri
  • Work at a company that focuses on mission-driven work with real community impact
  • Foot in the door at a company with strong name recognition in Bay Area healthcare
  • Competitive compensation with weekly direct deposit every Friday

job.title: Mid-Level Automotive Technician – PM Shift
job.description:
Mid-Level Automotive Technician – PM Shift
12:00PM-9:00PM.

Looking for an auto technician to support a self-driving car initiative. This will be focused on general documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and general maintenance. The individual should have a general understanding of drivetrains in order to identify and investigate problems.

Scope:
• Solid experience tinkering with vehicles.
• Navigate databases to find repair modules and follow processes/procedures while keeping documentation on results.
• Work with OEM tooling/base car tooling, and have an understanding of how to work with it, read diagnostics, etc.

Required:
• Auto technician experience – Automotive, robotics, aerospace, etc.
• Strong electrical experience as well as strong fabrication abilities.
• Experience working in a shop and maintaining cleanliness, managing inventory, etc.
• Comfortable working in a team environment and leading others. This is NOT a solo position.
• Solid experience with tools – Saws, screw drivers, drill, spanners, etc.
• Experience reading and following schematics, manuals, repair guides, etc.
• Strong documentation abilities - Creating repair orders stating the diagnosis, the procedures performed, the parts required, etc.

Pluses:
• Autonomous vehicle background.
• Experience with auto mechanics, repair, and maintenance.
• Experience with sensors and calibration.

job.title: Per-Diem Corporate Health Registered Nurse
job.description:
Corporate Health Registered Nurse needed for an ongoing per-diem contract opportunity with Yoh’s corporate office client located in Plano & Fort Worth, TX.
*Must be able to cover both locations, depending on the need. Plano is the biggest location so likely will be there more.
 

This job is only on an as-needed basis with the schedule typically made in advance, but we are looking for flexibility to cover call-outs too. Must be able to work 0 to 5 shifts per week between Monday and Friday, 7:30am to 4:30pm. Average is a couple of shifts a month. The clinic offers occupational, primary, and preventative care for employees of a corporate office.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse license in state of Texas
  • Minimum (3) years' experience as a Registered Nurse
  • Prior experience in: Occupational Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, Family Medicine, Corrections, or School Nursing type setting
  • Recent clinical experience and strong first-aid skills
  • Professional, dedicated, friendly, and helpful employee

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Nursing assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Ambulatory care such as treating sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.
  • Travel health consultation, health coaching, and health education
  • Provide medical testing/biometric screenings such as EKGs, pulmonary function, phlebotomy, blood glucose, blood pressure, cholesterol, vision and hearing screening and perform limited interpretation of tests
  • Immunizations
  • Respond to emergencies onsite and provide emergency medical care as-needed (assist First Responders)

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

  • MUST HAVE A FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE between Monday and Friday, 7:30am - 4:30pm - this position is to cover for when full-time staff need time off of work so the schedule is very infrequent
  • BLS certified
  • Computer savvy (including prior EMR use)
  • Passionate about promoting health and wellbeing in the workplace
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time, go up and down multiple flights of stairs, and do a lot of fast-walking

What’s In It For You?

  • Gain experience working at a well-established company with a prestigious reputation
  • Great way to make extra $$$ with a flexible day shift schedule
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment getting to make a real impact on both individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday!

job.title: Medical Assistant - Pediatric Neurology
job.description:
Medical Assistant needed temporarily for a Pediatric Neurology clinic opportunity with Yoh’s well-known medical center client located in Pleasant Hill, CA.

This is a pediatric clinic role supporting the healthcare needs of children. Duties include administrative task, patient care, and clinical support! 

             Must be able to commit to the full 3-month (may extend past 3 months) entirety of the assignment 
Schedule:
Mondays-Fridays 7:30am-4:00p

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Registered or Certified Medical Assistant (CMA, RMA, CCMA) for 2 or more years
  • Experience working either in multiple specialties or preferably Neurology
  • Administering measuring vital signs and assessing patients

job.title: Quality Control Inspector
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking a Quality Control Inspector for a client in Reno, NV. In this hands-on role, we are looking for candidates with experience in quality inspection, and warehouse operations.  Candidates with experience in medical device manufacturing are preferred. This position combines quality inspection with hands-on warehouse support. You’ll inspect incoming materials and work in progress, maintain accurate records, and help keep materials and finished products moving through the operation. If you enjoy detailed work and variety in your day, this role offers exposure to quality, assembly, and inventory activities within a medical device environment.

Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: Onsite in Reno, NV
Pay: $23-$25/hr
Type: COntract-to-hire

What You’ll Do:
  • Inspect products during manufacturing to support consistent quality.
  • Perform receiving inspections on incoming raw materials.
  • Capture inspection results and maintain accurate quality control records.
  • Help develop and improve quality control processes.
  • Learn assembly processes and provide production support as needed.
  • Keep purchase orders and related records organized and accessible.
  • Maintain an organized warehouse and control raw material storage and handling.
  • Prepare, package, and ship finished products.
  • Complete inventory counts and keep inventory records accurate.
  • Follow quality system requirements and good documentation practices throughout daily work.

Experience That Can Help You Succeed:
  • Background in medical device manufacturing.
  • Must have experience with and knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485 quality systems.
  • Experience inspecting incoming materials, in-process products, and finished goods.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and blueprints.
  • Familiarity with precision inspection tools, including calipers, micrometers, and microscopes.
  • Experience recognizing and documenting nonconforming materials or products.
  • Hands-on experience with inventory control and warehouse activities.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing records and accurate production documentation.
  • Experience using ERP, electronic quality management, or similar business systems.
  • English/Spanish bilingual skills are a plus.

job.title: Certified Athletic Trainer
job.description:
Certified Athletic Trainer needed for a full-time, direct-hire opportunity with Yoh's occupational health clinic client located in Blue Springs, MS. Start as soon as possible. New graduates are encouraged to apply!

This position is located at a manufacturing company with an onsite clinic that provides occupational, primary, and preventive care services for employees. The Athletic Trainer will support approximately 10-15 patients through routine wellness and injury-prevention touchpoints. You will work alongside the clinical team to provide injury prevention, first aid, general wellness services, and health promotion. This role also includes non-appointment-based activities on the production floor, evaluating the physical demands of job tasks, and leading group fitness, stretching, and educational classes.

Schedule:
Monday-Friday, 6:00 AM-2:30 PM
(Second opening available: 2:30 PM-11:00 PM)

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Certified Athletic Trainer (ATC) - BOC Certified
  • Current Mississippi Athletic Trainer License
  • Experience in occupational health and safety; knowledge of current OSHA regulations preferred
  • Experience with ergonomics preferred
What You'll Be Doing:
  • Develop and implement an early intervention program by performing comprehensive musculoskeletal examinations, providing first aid in accordance with OSHA standards, and educating employees on injury prevention
  • Perform physical demand and ergonomic assessments to identify high-risk tasks and recommend preventive strategies
  • Lead group and individual training sessions focused on functional movement, job simulation, and injury prevention programs
  • Collaborate with onsite medical and safety teams to coordinate care and recommend workplace countermeasures
  • Document assessments, recommendations, and outcomes in a timely and accurate manner
  • Maintain patient health records to ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation
  • Participate in meetings and task forces
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited Athletic Training Education Program
  • Active BLS/CPR certification (hands-on courses only)
  • Current annual TB screening (PPD or QuantiFERON Gold test)
  • Passion for promoting health and well-being in the workplace
  • Positive attitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work effectively as part of a team
What's In It for You?:
  • Excellent work-life balance with predictable hours and no weekends or holidays
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment where you can make a real difference in keeping workers safe, healthy, and productive
  • Opportunity to be part of a mission-driven company that prioritizes collaboration

job.title: Engineering Technician
job.description:
Engineering Technician  
 
Engineering technicians are responsible for partnering closely with their engineering counterparts to design and build test assets including vehicles and benches. The team is responsible for leading the integration of sensors and computers for next generation automated driving systems into the development vehicle and test bench platforms.

What you’ll do:
- Build harnesses for vehicles and benches
- Build subassemblies for use on vehicles and test benches
- Perform vehicle teardowns to prepare for upfit with development hardware installation
- Perform vehicle modifications such as drilling added holes and cutting openings in fascia
- Assemble development hardware onto vehicles
- Build rack mounted bench setups with development hardware
- Work with engineering counterparts on hand-off of new test assets and troubleshooting any issues

What you'll need to succeed:
- Associate’s degree with two years of employment experience or a High School Diploma or GED equivalent with four years of employment experience is required.
- Expertise as a vehicle, mechanical, or electrical technician
- Electrical and mechanical skills for vehicle and bench builds
- Strong attention to detail. Follow all steps of detailed instruction docs and ensure repeatable end product.
- Willingness and mindset to ask critical questions and provide feedback to the engineering teams
- Puts safety first, taking proactive steps to minimize risk in all work and ensure any concerns are resolved
- Continuous improvement mindset developing and implementing ideas to improve the work environment and processes
- Teamwork and strong cross-functional communication skills are essential

Nice to have (optional):
- History working closely with engineering teams
- Experience building harnesses

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, ADAS/AV
job.description:
Senior Software Engineer, ADAS/AV

About You
You are a strong systems thinker and software engineer who enjoys designing, developing and solving complex problems across large-scale ADAS software platforms. You are comfortable working across components, platform, validation, simulation, and infrastructure teams to improve software quality, reliability, and release readiness.
You take ownership of ambiguous technical challenges, use data and engineering judgments to identify systemic issues, and drive improvements through software, automation, tooling, and process enhancements. You have a solid foundation in software development and system integration, along with a passion for building scalable solutions that improve engineering efficiency and product quality.
You thrive in a fast paced, collaborative environment and enjoy working across organizational boundaries to solve problems that span multiple software components and teams. You are motivated by building reliable software platforms, improving developer productivity, and enabling high quality releases throughout the software development lifecycle.
If you are passionate about ADAS software, platform engineering, and creating scalable solutions that improve software reliability from development through production, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain platform software, engineering tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that improve software quality, scalability, and developer productivity.
  • Drive software quality, reliability, and release readiness across the ADAS platform through software development, automation, validation, and data-driven engineering practices.
  • Define and evolve test and validation strategies across unit, integration, system, simulation, and vehicle-level testing.
  • Identify gaps in software quality, validation coverage, and platform capabilities, and develop solutions to address them.
  • Develop and integrate automated validation, qualification, and reliability checks into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows.
  • Analyze software defects, integration issues, and field/customer problems to identify root causes and drive long-term corrective actions.
  • Analyze dependencies across software components and identify risks that may impact system integration, performance, reliability, and release quality.
  • Define and track software quality metrics, reliability KPIs, and release readiness indicators to drive continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with software, architecture, validation, simulation, infrastructure, and release engineering teams to improve end-to-end software quality and development efficiency.
  • Support software integration across multiple ECUs, middleware components, and vehicle platforms.
  • Apply V-Model principles and modern software engineering practices to improve traceability from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, validation, and release.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering processes, tools, and development workflows based on lessons learned, test results, and operational data.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in embedded software development, automotive software, platform engineering, or software reliability.
  • Strong programming skills in C/C++, Python, and scripting languages such as Bash.
  • Experience designing, developing, integrating, and qualifying production-quality software for complex embedded systems on Linux/QNX/RTOS Platforms.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, component interfaces, dependency management, debugging, root-cause analysis, and software engineering best practices.
  • Experience analyzing dependencies and interactions across software components, identifying integration risks, and preventing system-level regressions.

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer -LI-ion Battery Management
job.description:
Electrical Design Engineer - LI-ion Battery Management

Are you passionate about advancing battery technology and driving innovation in aerospace applications? Join our dynamic team as an Electrical Design Engineer specializing in Lithium-ion Battery Management Systems (BMS). In this critical role, you'll be at the forefront of designing cutting-edge digital control, analog, and mixed-signal solutions for aviation batteries, impacting the future of sustainable flight and aerospace safety.

Role Overview:
As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will develop and refine BMS hardware from concept through certification, working on everything from voltage sensing to cell balancing and system integration. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring complex hardware and embedded software solutions to life, ensuring performance, reliability, and compliance in a high-stakes environment. Your expertise will contribute directly to safer, more efficient aerospace energy storage solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years experience designing lithium-ion battery management systems (BMS)
  • Proven experience in analog and mixed-signal circuit design and PCB schematic creation
  • Strong knowledge of cell sensing, protection, isolation, and balancing circuits for lithium batteries
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and results-driven focus
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to troubleshoot and validate hardware prototypes effectively
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience designing to environmental and EMI standards such as RTCA DO-160, MIL-STD-810/461, or RTCA DO-311
  • Familiarity with LiFePO4 chemistry and battery safety standards
  • Knowledge of DFM & DFT principles
  • Experience supporting embedded microcontroller software and certification processes
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (Master's preferred)
  • 5+ years designing BMS for aviation or similar high-reliability industries
  • Demonstrated success in product lifecycle management, from initial design to field application
Other Requirements:

  • On-site work in Wichita, KS
  • Willingness to work in a collaborative environment involving hardware, software, and mechanical teams
  • Good communication skills essential for team coordination
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any necessary security or certification clearances
Take your career to the next level by innovating in the rapidly evolving field of aviation battery technology. Apply now to become a vital part of our pioneering team—your expertise will shape the future of electric flight!

Fiber Field Technician

Join a dynamic team and play a vital role in the installation, maintenance, and monitoring of cutting-edge fiber optic networks in the IL Rockford, Dekalb, Rochelle, Peru and Lasalle areas.   • Expertise in DS3/DS1, SONET/DWDM installation and maintenance

  • Excellent PC skills and strong oral and written communication

VP - Business Operations & Strategy

Are you a visionary leader with a passion for transforming complex business operations and driving strategic growth? Join our client as the Vice President of Business Operations & Strategy and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our dynamic, rapidly scaling vacation rental platform. You will lead enterprise transformation initiatives, oversee high-impact M&A integrations, and deliver measurable results that fuel our mission to build the world’s best vacation rental company.

About the Role
As a key member of our executive team you will spearhead strategic initiatives across markets, brands, and functions. Your expertise will enable seamless integrations, operational improvements, and innovative solutions, all while collaborating with senior stakeholders to unlock value and accelerate growth. This is your chance to influence a company backed by seasoned investors and led by leaders with deep roots in hospitality, travel, and technology.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred
  • 5-8+ years in management consulting, strategy & transformation, or high-intensity business environments
  • Proven ability to structure complex problems, influence senior stakeholders, and lead initiatives end-to-end
  • Experience with M&A integration, multi-unit operations, or platform environments is advantageous
  • Exceptional analytical skills, with proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Strong executive communication and storytelling capabilities
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous settings

If you’re ready to lead transformative change at an exciting, fast-growing company and want to make a meaningful impact in the travel and hospitality industry, we invite you to apply now. job.title: Fraud Operations Manager
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, full-time opportunity for a Senior Manager, Fraud Operations to join our Financial Technology client in the Mountain View/Palo Alto area of California.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports initially. The ideal candidate brings deep fraud expertise and is comfortable building a program while personally managing investigations and daily casework.

Title: Senior Manager, Fraud Operations
Compensation: $160,000–$180,000 annual base salary, depending on experience and qualifications
Type: Full-Time / Direct Hire, Exempt
Location: Mountain View/Palo Alto area, CA
Work Arrangement: Onsite with limited hybrid flexibility; not remote
Industry: Financial Technology / Banking and Payments
Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k)
Reports To: Chief Compliance Officer

Responsibilities
  • Establish fraud prevention and investigation processes for consumer and business deposit accounts.
  • Review alerts, investigate suspicious activity, and prepare documented referrals in coordination with the BSA Officer and sponsor-bank partners.
  • Adjust detection rules and thresholds using loss trends, false positives, and customer impact to guide improvements.
  • Oversee disputes, chargebacks, claims, and recovery efforts, including applicable deadlines, provisional credits, and customer communications.
  • Develop procedures, quality controls, and executive reporting; support audits, examinations, and corrective actions.
  • Collaborate across business and technology teams to improve fraud tools and workflows, support fraud-related due diligence, and address urgent escalations.
Qualifications
  • 10+ years of direct fraud experience across strategy, detection, and investigations within financial services or technology.
  • Strong understanding of consumer and business account fraud, including payment fraud, account takeover, identity manipulation, first-party fraud, and scams.
  • Practical experience configuring fraud detection systems, developing rules, adjusting thresholds, and managing investigation cases.
  • Knowledge of BSA/AML, OFAC sanctions, Regulation E, NACHA, UCC Article 4A, and card-network requirements.
  • Experience coordinating with bank partners or BSA teams and supporting audits or regulatory reviews.
